title_zh: 丙氨酸扫描与 Val/Leu/Ile 构成的疏水腔
title_en: Alanine scanning, and the hydrophobic core built from Val/Leu/Ile

points.zh: 丙氨酸 Ala 的侧链就是一个甲基 methyl，是最小、但仍有一定体积的侧链，所以适合当作"替换基准"。
points.en: Alanine's side chain is a single methyl group: the smallest side chain that still has real volume, which is why it serves as the reference substitution.

points.zh: 丙氨酸扫描 alanine scanning 解决的问题：已知两个分子（比如一条多肽和一个蛋白质）能结合，但还没有解析出复合物结构 complex structure，不知道它们是怎么贴到一起的。
points.en: The problem alanine scanning solves: you know two molecules (say a peptide and a protein) bind, but you have no complex structure yet, so you do not know how they pack against each other.

points.zh: 做法：把你认为处在相互作用界面 interface 上的氨基酸，一个一个 one by one 替换成丙氨酸。
points.en: Method: mutate the residues you believe lie on the interaction interface to alanine, one at a time.

points.zh: 对每一个替换产物单独测定亲和力 affinity，得到每个位点的贡献。
points.en: Measure the binding affinity of each single mutant separately, giving a per-position contribution.

points.zh: 读结果：换成 Ala 后亲和力大幅下降，说明该残基对互作是关键的；亲和力几乎不变，说明该残基不关键。
points.en: Reading the result: a large loss of affinity means that residue is critical for the interaction; little change means it is not.

points.zh: 动机之一是进一步提高亲和力——先找出真正关键的接触残基，才知道该改造哪里。
points.en: One motivation is affinity improvement: you must first find the residues that actually contact, before you know what to engineer.

points.zh: 缬氨酸 Val、亮氨酸 Leu、异亮氨酸 Ile 是三个典型的非极性 nonpolar 氨基酸，主要存在于蛋白质的疏水腔 hydrophobic core 内，疏水腔基本上就是由它们组成的。
points.en: Valine, leucine and isoleucine are the three classic nonpolar residues; they sit in the protein's hydrophobic core, which is largely built from them.

points.zh: 关键限定在侧链：这三者的侧链不能形成任何氢键 hydrogen bond（主链仍然可以），侧链疏水且体积合适，所以正好填充疏水腔。
points.en: The key qualifier is side chain: their side chains form no hydrogen bonds at all (their backbones still can), they are hydrophobic, and their size fits, so they pack the core.

extra.tag: 课上未展开 · not covered
extra.zh: 为什么用 Ala 而不用 Gly：Ala 只切掉 Cβ 以外的侧链，主链构象和螺旋倾向基本不变，等于"只改一件事"；Gly 会额外增加主链柔性，把侧链效应和构象效应混在一起。同理，界面上原本就是 Gly 或 Pro 的位置通常不做扫描。
extra.en: Why alanine and not glycine: Ala truncates the side chain beyond Cbeta while leaving backbone conformation and helix propensity intact, so only one variable changes; Gly would also add backbone flexibility, confounding side-chain and conformational effects. For the same reason, positions that are already Gly or Pro are usually skipped.

extra.tag: 定量补充 · quantitative
extra.zh: hot spot 的常用判据：突变为 Ala 后结合自由能变化 ΔΔG ≥ 1–2 kcal/mol。经典的 hGH–受体界面研究显示，界面埋藏面积很大，但结合能却集中在少数几个 hot spot 残基上，大部分界面残基突变后几乎无影响。
extra.en: The usual hot-spot criterion is a binding free-energy change of about 1-2 kcal/mol or more on mutation to Ala. The classic hGH-receptor study showed that although the buried interface is large, the binding energy concentrates on a handful of hot-spot residues while most interface residues contribute almost nothing.

extra.tag: 考点延伸 · exam extension
extra.zh: Val 和 Ile 是 β-branched（Cβ 上就分支），空间位阻使它们不利于 α-helix、偏好 β-sheet；Ile 的侧链还含第二个手性中心，是与 Thr 并列的、含两个手性碳的常见氨基酸。
extra.en: Val and Ile are beta-branched (branching already at Cbeta); the steric bulk disfavours alpha-helix and favours beta-sheet. Ile also carries a second chiral centre in its side chain, making it and Thr the two standard amino acids with two stereocentres.

extra.tag: 易混淆 · common confusion
extra.zh: 严格说最小的侧链是甘氨酸 Gly（侧链只有一个 H）。老师说的"最小"要理解成"最小的、真正算得上侧链的侧链"。Gly 因为没有侧链，其主链自由度最大，是螺旋和转角里的特殊角色。
extra.en: Strictly the smallest side chain belongs to glycine (a single H). "Smallest" in the lecture means the smallest genuine side chain. Because Gly has none, its backbone is the most flexible, giving it a special role in turns and helices.

quiz.q_zh: 某个界面残基突变为 Ala 后，结合的 KD 基本不变。最合理的结论是什么？
quiz.q_en: Mutating an interface residue to Ala leaves the binding KD essentially unchanged. What is the most reasonable conclusion?

options.zh: 该突变已经破坏了整个蛋白的三维折叠
options.en: The mutation has destroyed the protein's overall three-dimensional fold

options.zh: 该残基只有带上电荷才可能参与结合界面
options.en: That residue could only take part in binding if it carried a charge

options.zh: 该残基的侧链对结合自由能的贡献很小
options.en: That residue's side chain contributes little to the binding free energy

options.zh: 该残基的侧链完全不与配体发生任何接触
options.en: That residue's side chain makes no contact whatsoever with the bound ligand

quiz.explain_zh: 亲和力不变只能说明该侧链对结合自由能的贡献小。最诱人的错误是“完全不与配体接触”：界面上存在大量埋藏面积很大、但突变后几乎无能量效应的残基，能量集中在少数 hot spot 上，所以物理接触与能量贡献不能画等号；题干已经说明它是界面残基。折叠若真被破坏，KD 不会不变。
quiz.explain_en: Unchanged affinity only shows the side chain contributes little binding energy. The tempting wrong answer is the one claiming no contact whatsoever: interfaces contain many residues that bury large surface area yet cost almost no energy when mutated, because the energy concentrates on a few hot spots. Physical contact and energetic contribution are not the same thing, and the stem already states the residue is at the interface. A destroyed fold would not leave KD unchanged.

quiz.q_zh: Val、Leu、Ile 之所以埋在疏水腔内，直接原因是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the direct reason Val, Leu and Ile are buried in the hydrophobic core?

options.zh: 它们的主链不能形成氢键，只能靠内埋来稳定
options.en: Their backbones cannot form hydrogen bonds and are stabilised only by burial

options.zh: 它们的侧链是非极性烷基，不能与水形成氢键
options.en: Their side chains are nonpolar alkyl groups that cannot hydrogen bond with water

options.zh: 它们的侧链在生理 pH 下带正电，彼此吸引成核
options.en: Their side chains carry a positive charge at physiological pH and attract one another

options.zh: 它们的侧链之间形成二硫键，把疏水核心锁死
options.en: Their side chains form disulfide bonds that lock the hydrophobic core tightly shut

quiz.explain_zh: 区别只在侧链：Val、Leu、Ile 的侧链是纯烷基，既不带电也不能与水形成氢键，因此被排到蛋白内部。说“主链不能形成氢键”是典型陷阱：所有氨基酸（Pro 除外的 N–H）的主链都能形成氢键，二级结构正是靠主链氢键稳定的；把主链和侧链混为一谈就会选错。二硫键只有 Cys 能形成，这三个残基的侧链在生理 pH 下也都不带电。
quiz.explain_en: The difference lies entirely in the side chain: those of Val, Leu and Ile are pure alkyl, neither charged nor able to hydrogen bond with water, so they are driven inward. The claim that their backbones cannot hydrogen bond is the classic trap: every residue's backbone can hydrogen bond (that is exactly what stabilises secondary structure), and confusing backbone with side chain leads straight to it. Disulfides are formed only by Cys, and none of these side chains is charged at physiological pH.

title_zh: 极性的化学定义；Cys、Met 的部分极性与 Ser、Thr 的羟基
title_en: What polarity means chemically; the partial polarity of Cys and Met, and the hydroxyls of Ser and Thr

points.zh: 侧链上含极性原子（如巯基 -SH、羟基 -OH）的氨基酸被称为极性 polar 氨基酸。
points.en: Residues whose side chains carry polar atoms such as a thiol or a hydroxyl are classed as polar amino acids.

points.zh: 半胱氨酸 Cys 和甲硫氨酸 Met 只是"部分极性"，这个概念本来就没有清晰界限，知道它们有一定极性但不高就够了。
points.en: Cysteine and methionine are only partially polar; the category has no sharp boundary, and it is enough to know they have some polarity but not much.

points.zh: 极性的化学定义：以丝氨酸的侧链为例，氧夺电子的能力比碳强，所以氧那一端带更多负电荷、另一端带更多正电荷——电荷分布不均匀，这才叫有极性。
points.en: The chemical definition of polarity: in a serine side chain the oxygen pulls electrons harder than carbon, so the oxygen end carries more negative charge and the other end more positive. Charge is unevenly distributed, and that is what polarity means.

points.zh: 推论：带羟基或带氨基的侧链，因为 O、N 的夺电子能力都比 C 强，一般都会造成电荷分布不均，因而都有极性，而且这类氨基酸通常能形成氢键 hydrogen bond。
points.en: It follows that side chains bearing hydroxyl or amino groups are polar, because O and N both outcompete C for electrons, and such residues can generally form hydrogen bonds.

points.zh: 老师同意学生的看法：实验里能直接体现出来的是亲水性 hydrophilicity，极性基本上体现不到，它只是化学角度描述电荷分布的定义。
points.en: The teacher agrees with the student that what shows up in experiments is hydrophilicity; polarity as such rarely does, being a chemists' way of describing charge distribution.

points.zh: 背景：生物化学最初是一群化学家用化学的传统思维去解释生物现象，所以很多概念带着化学的痕迹，不必过度纠结。
points.en: Context: biochemistry began with chemists explaining biological phenomena in chemical terms, so many of its concepts carry that heritage and need not be over-analysed.

points.zh: 丝氨酸 Ser 和苏氨酸 Thr 是典型的亲水氨基酸，侧链都是单羟基取代。
points.en: Serine and threonine are the typical hydrophilic residues; both side chains are single-hydroxyl substitutions.

points.zh: 羟基的第一个作用是催化水解 hydrolysis：有一大类蛋白酶就叫丝氨酸蛋白酶 serine protease，靠这个羟基来催化。
points.en: The first role of the hydroxyl is catalysing hydrolysis: an entire protease class, the serine proteases, catalyses through this hydroxyl.

points.zh: 羟基更常被考的作用是作为磷酸化 phosphorylation 位点：磷酸基团是一个磷连四个氧，其中一个氧可以被侧链的氧取代，因此 Ser/Thr 是最常见的磷酸化位点。
points.en: The more heavily examined role is as a phosphorylation site: phosphate is one phosphorus with four oxygens, one of which is exchanged for the side-chain oxygen, making Ser and Thr the commonest phospho-acceptors.

extra.tag: 课上未展开 · not covered
extra.zh: 真核磷酸化的第三个受体是酪氨酸 Tyr。哺乳动物磷酸化蛋白组中大致是 pSer ≈ 85–90%、pThr ≈ 10%、pTyr ≈ 1–2%；pTyr 虽然最少，却几乎主导受体酪氨酸激酶 RTK 的信号通路，也是绝大多数激酶抑制剂类抗肿瘤药的靶点。
extra.en: The third eukaryotic phospho-acceptor is tyrosine. In the mammalian phosphoproteome roughly 85-90% of sites are phosphoserine, about 10% phosphothreonine and only 1-2% phosphotyrosine, yet pTyr dominates receptor tyrosine kinase signalling and is the target of most kinase-inhibitor cancer drugs.

extra.tag: 定量补充 · quantitative
extra.zh: Cys 巯基的 pKa 约 8.3，远低于 Ser 羟基（约 13）。所以在生理 pH 下已有可观比例以硫醇负离子 thiolate 存在——这正是 Cys 能做亲核催化、能配位 Zn2+（锌指 zinc finger）、能被氧化成二硫键 disulfide bond 的化学基础，而 Ser 需要 His 帮忙夺质子才有类似的亲核性。
extra.en: The Cys thiol has a pKa of about 8.3, far below the roughly 13 of the Ser hydroxyl, so a meaningful fraction exists as thiolate at physiological pH. That is the chemical basis for Cys acting as a nucleophile, coordinating Zn2+ in zinc fingers, and being oxidised to disulfides, whereas Ser needs a His to abstract its proton before it becomes comparably nucleophilic.

extra.tag: 易混淆 · common confusion
extra.zh: Met 的硫是硫醚 thioether：不解离、不带电、也不参与二硫键，在 Kyte–Doolittle 疏水性标度里 Met 和 Cys 其实都被归为疏水残基，Met 常出现在疏水核心。把"含硫 = 极性"直接记会出错，老师说的"部分极性"就是这个意思。
extra.en: Methionine's sulfur is a thioether: it does not ionise, carries no charge and forms no disulfide. On the Kyte-Doolittle scale both Met and Cys score as hydrophobic, and Met is common in the hydrophobic core. Memorising "contains sulfur therefore polar" will mislead you, which is what the teacher's "partially polar" is guarding against.

extra.tag: 考点延伸 · exam extension
extra.zh: 丝氨酸蛋白酶的催化三联体 catalytic triad 是 Ser–His–Asp：His 夺走 Ser 羟基的质子，使其成为强亲核体去进攻肽键的羰基碳，Asp 稳定质子化的 His。只有一个羟基是不够的，这也是为什么胰凝乳蛋白酶 chymotrypsin、胰蛋白酶 trypsin、凝血酶 thrombin 共享同一套机制。
extra.en: Serine proteases use a Ser-His-Asp catalytic triad: His removes the proton from the Ser hydroxyl so it can attack the carbonyl carbon of the scissile peptide bond, and Asp stabilises the protonated His. A hydroxyl alone is not enough, which is why chymotrypsin, trypsin and thrombin all share this arrangement.

quiz.q_zh: 按照课上给的化学定义，为什么丝氨酸的侧链是极性的？
quiz.q_en: By the chemical definition given in the lecture, why is the serine side chain polar?

options.zh: 因为它的侧链羟基能被激酶磷酸化而带上电荷
options.en: Because its hydroxyl can be phosphorylated by a kinase and so gains charge

options.zh: 因为它的侧链羟基在生理 pH 下解离出净负电荷
options.en: Because its hydroxyl side chain ionises to a net negative charge at physiological pH

options.zh: 因为羟基中氧的电负性大于碳和氢，形成了偶极
options.en: Because oxygen is more electronegative than carbon and hydrogen, creating a dipole

options.zh: 因为它的侧链体积很小，可以被水分子完全包围
options.en: Because its side chain is small enough to be completely surrounded by water

quiz.explain_zh: 极性说的是基团内部电荷分布不均，即偶极，而不是净电荷。最诱人的错误是说它“在生理 pH 下解离出净负电荷”：Ser 侧链羟基的 pKa 约 13，在生理 pH 下完全不解离，净电荷为零，但它依然是极性的。把“体积小、能被水包围”当成原因也不对，Ala 的侧链更小却不极性。而“能被磷酸化”是把结果当成了原因：正因为羟基极性才能被磷酸化。
quiz.explain_en: Polarity refers to uneven charge distribution within the group, that is a dipole, not to net charge. The most tempting error is the claim that the hydroxyl ionises to a net negative charge: the Ser hydroxyl has a pKa near 13 and is entirely un-ionised at physiological pH, carrying zero net charge while still being polar. Explaining polarity by small size and water surrounding it also fails, since the smaller Ala side chain is not polar. Citing phosphorylation mistakes a consequence for the cause, because the hydroxyl can be phosphorylated precisely because it is polar.

quiz.q_zh: 下列关于 Cys 和 Met 的说法，哪一项正确？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about Cys and Met is correct?

options.zh: Cys 的巯基 pKa 约 8.3，可部分解离；Met 的硫醚不解离
options.en: The Cys thiol has a pKa near 8.3 and partly ionises, while the Met thioether cannot

options.zh: 两者在 Kyte–Doolittle 疏水性标度上都被归为强亲水的残基
options.en: On the Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy scale both rank among the strongly hydrophilic residues

options.zh: 两者的侧链都是细胞内激酶常用的磷酸化位点，可被可逆地修饰
options.en: Both side chains are common intracellular kinase phosphorylation sites and are reversible

options.zh: 两者的侧链硫都以自由巯基的形式存在，pKa 相近，都能形成二硫键
options.en: Both side-chain sulfurs exist as free thiols with similar pKa values, so both form disulfides

quiz.explain_zh: 只有 Cys 的自由巯基能被氧化成二硫键，Met 的硫夹在两个碳之间（硫醚），既不解离也不成二硫键，所以“两者都能形成二硫键”是错的——两者含硫不等于两者化学等价。把它们“归为强亲水残基”正好反了：Met 和 Cys 在 Kyte–Doolittle 标度上都偏疏水。磷酸化位点是 Ser/Thr/Tyr，不是含硫残基。
quiz.explain_en: Only the free Cys thiol can be oxidised to a disulfide; the Met sulfur sits between two carbons as a thioether, neither ionising nor forming disulfides, so the statement that both form disulfides is wrong: both containing sulfur does not make them chemically equivalent. Calling them strongly hydrophilic is inverted, since both score hydrophobic on Kyte-Doolittle. Phosphorylation sites are Ser, Thr and Tyr, not sulfur-containing residues.

title_zh: 酸性与酰胺型、碱性氨基酸、盐桥，His 的缓冲与 Pro 的刚性
title_en: Acidic and amide residues, basic residues, salt bridges, His buffering and Pro rigidity

points.zh: 天冬氨酸 Asp / 谷氨酸 Glu 与它们对应的酰胺化形式天冬酰胺 Asn / 谷氨酰胺 Gln 成对出现；Glu 比 Asp 的侧链多一个亚甲基 methylene（老师先说"甲基"随即改口为"亚甲基"），差别只在侧链长度。
points.en: Asp and Glu come paired with their amide forms Asn and Gln. Glu has one more methylene in its side chain than Asp (the teacher first said methyl and immediately corrected to methylene); the only difference is chain length.

points.zh: Asp 和 Glu 可以以带电的（去质子）形式存在，带负电，因此能形成盐桥 salt bridge。
points.en: Asp and Glu can exist in a charged, deprotonated form carrying negative charge, and therefore can form salt bridges.

points.zh: Asn 和 Gln 不能形成盐桥，因为羧基已被氨基取代成酰胺，无法形成带电形式。
points.en: Asn and Gln cannot form salt bridges: the carboxyl has been replaced by an amide, so no charged form is available.

points.zh: 赖氨酸 Lys 和精氨酸 Arg 是碱性较强的两个氨基酸，侧链都比较长，带正电，可以和带负电的 Asp/Glu 形成盐桥。
points.en: Lysine and arginine are the strongly basic pair; both have long side chains, carry positive charge, and can pair with negatively charged Asp or Glu in salt bridges.

points.zh: 老师给的记忆规则：氨基酸侧链上含氧原子的一般可以带负电，含氨基的一般带正电。
points.en: The teacher's rule of thumb: side chains containing oxygen tend to become negative, side chains containing amino groups tend to become positive.

points.zh: 组氨酸 His 是杂环氨基酸中比较特殊的一个：它有三种带电形式（+2、+1、0），所以能起缓冲 buffering 作用，通常也被归入碱性、带正电的一类。
points.en: Histidine is the special heterocyclic residue: it has three charge states (+2, +1, 0), which is why it buffers, and it is conventionally grouped with the basic, positively charged residues.

points.zh: 脯氨酸 Pro 是带有刚性 rigidity 的氨基酸：侧链成环、固定，不能随意摆动；它的作用在后面讲三级结构时还会用到。
points.en: Proline is the rigid residue: its side chain closes into a fixed ring that cannot swing freely, a property that returns when tertiary structure is discussed.

points.zh: 回头补的一点：水解有三种方式——酸水解、碱水解、酶水解；酸水解比较彻底，但水解过程中会把部分氨基酸本身破坏掉。
points.en: A point picked back up: there are three routes of hydrolysis, acid, alkaline and enzymatic. Acid hydrolysis is the more complete one but destroys some of the amino acids in the process.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 老师说 His 在 pH 7 时"基本上带一个正电荷"。标准值是咪唑 imidazole 侧链 pKa ≈ 6.0，因此在 pH 7.0 只有约 10% 的侧链被质子化，游离 His 的净电荷接近 0。真正的考点是：His 是唯一 pKa 落在生理 pH 附近的侧链，所以它既能做缓冲，又能在酶活性中心充当广义酸碱催化的质子中转站（如上一节的 Ser–His–Asp）。
extra.en: The lecture says His carries essentially one positive charge at pH 7. The standard value is an imidazole side-chain pKa of about 6.0, so at pH 7.0 only around 10% is protonated and free His has a net charge near zero. The examinable point is that His is the only side chain whose pKa sits near physiological pH, which is exactly why it both buffers and acts as the proton shuttle in general acid-base catalysis, as in the Ser-His-Asp triad.

extra.tag: 定量补充 · quantitative
extra.zh: 侧链 pKa 记忆值：Asp ≈ 3.9、Glu ≈ 4.25、His ≈ 6.0、Cys ≈ 8.3、Tyr ≈ 10.1、Lys ≈ 10.5、Arg ≈ 12.5。由此可直接推出：在 pH 7 时 Asp/Glu 已完全去质子带负电，Lys/Arg 完全质子化带正电，唯有 His 处在可切换状态——这是很多机制题的起点。
extra.en: Side-chain pKa values worth memorising: Asp about 3.9, Glu about 4.25, His about 6.0, Cys about 8.3, Tyr about 10.1, Lys about 10.5, Arg about 12.5. It follows directly that at pH 7 Asp and Glu are fully deprotonated and negative, Lys and Arg fully protonated and positive, and only His is switchable, which is the starting point of many mechanism questions.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: Lys 侧链是 4 个亚甲基 CH2 加一个末端 ε-氨基，Arg 是 3 个亚甲基加一个胍基 guanidinium；课上说成"四个甲基/三个甲基"是口误。Arg 的正电荷离域在胍基的三个氮上，因此几乎在任何生理 pH 下都带电，而且能同时做双齿氢键——这就是 Arg 常出现在核酸结合面和磷酸结合口袋的原因。
extra.en: The Lys side chain is four methylenes plus a terminal epsilon-amino group; Arg is three methylenes plus a guanidinium. The lecture's "four methyls / three methyls" is a slip. Arg's positive charge is delocalised over three nitrogens of the guanidinium, so it stays charged at essentially any physiological pH and can make bidentate hydrogen bonds, which is why Arg dominates nucleic-acid-binding surfaces and phosphate pockets.

extra.tag: 考点延伸 · exam extension
extra.zh: "酸水解会破坏氨基酸"的具体内容：6 M HCl、110 °C、24 h 的标准酸水解会完全破坏色氨酸 Trp，并把 Asn/Gln 脱酰胺成 Asp/Glu（所以氨基酸组成分析报的是 Asx 和 Glx）；碱水解能保住 Trp，却破坏 Ser、Thr、Cys 和 Arg，还会引起消旋 racemization。酶水解条件温和、特异性强，但往往切不完全。
extra.en: What "acid hydrolysis destroys amino acids" concretely means: standard 6 M HCl at 110 C for 24 h destroys tryptophan completely and deamidates Asn and Gln to Asp and Glu, which is why composition analyses report Asx and Glx. Alkaline hydrolysis preserves Trp but destroys Ser, Thr, Cys and Arg and causes racemisation. Enzymatic hydrolysis is mild and specific but often incomplete.

quiz.q_zh: 为什么谷氨酰胺 Gln 不能与赖氨酸 Lys 形成盐桥，而谷氨酸 Glu 可以？
quiz.q_en: Why can Glu form a salt bridge with Lys while Gln cannot?

options.zh: Gln 的侧链在生理 pH 下带正电，与 Lys 静电排斥
options.en: The Gln side chain is positively charged at physiological pH and repels Lys

options.zh: Gln 只能形成疏水作用，不能参与任何静电相互作用
options.en: Gln can only make hydrophobic contacts and no electrostatic interactions at all

options.zh: Gln 的侧链比 Glu 短一个亚甲基，距离上够不到 Lys
options.en: The Gln side chain is one methylene shorter than Glu's and cannot reach Lys

options.zh: Gln 的侧链是中性酰胺，不能解离出带负电的形式
options.en: The Gln side chain is a neutral amide and cannot ionise to a negative form

quiz.explain_zh: 盐桥的本质是正负电荷之间的静电吸引，前提是双方都能带电。Gln 的侧链羧基已被酰胺化，没有可解离的质子，因此在任何生理 pH 下都不带电。说它“不能参与任何静电相互作用”则是过头的说法：Gln 虽不能形成盐桥，但它的酰胺仍是很好的氢键供体和受体，氢键本身也是静电性的。Gln 就是 Glu 的酰胺形式，两者侧链长度完全相同，所以“短一个亚甲基、够不到”同样错。
quiz.explain_en: A salt bridge is electrostatic attraction between opposite charges, which requires both partners to be charged. The Gln side-chain carboxyl has been amidated and has no ionisable proton, so it stays neutral at any physiological pH. Saying Gln makes no electrostatic interactions at all overshoots: it forms no salt bridge, yet its amide is an excellent hydrogen-bond donor and acceptor, and hydrogen bonds are themselves electrostatic. The claim that it is one methylene too short also fails, because Gln is simply the amide of Glu and has exactly the same side-chain length.

quiz.q_zh: 关于组氨酸 His，下列哪一项最准确？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about histidine is most accurate?

options.zh: 它的咪唑侧链 pKa 高达 12，在任何生理条件下都不可能带上电荷
options.en: Its imidazole side chain has a pKa of 12 and stays uncharged under all physiological conditions

options.zh: 它和 Asp、Glu 一样都属于酸性氨基酸，因为咪唑环上含有氮原子
options.en: Like Asp and Glu it counts as an acidic amino acid, because the imidazole ring contains nitrogen

options.zh: 在 pH 7.0 时它的咪唑侧链绝大部分都处于质子化的带正电形式
options.en: At pH 7.0 the overwhelming majority of its imidazole side chains are protonated and charged

options.zh: 它的咪唑 pKa 约 6.0，中性附近可在质子化与去质子化间切换
options.en: Its imidazole pKa is about 6.0, so near neutral pH it toggles between protonated and neutral

quiz.explain_zh: 咪唑 pKa ≈ 6.0，按 Henderson–Hasselbalch，在 pH 7.0 时质子化比例只有约 10%，所以“绝大部分都处于质子化带正电形式”这个课上常见的说法并不准确。真正让 His 重要的正是它“卡在生理 pH 上”这一点：既能缓冲，也能在催化中一会儿当酸一会儿当碱。把 pKa 说成 12、断言它永不带电，是走到了另一个极端；把含氮当成酸性则方向反了，含氮杂环恰恰是碱性基团。
quiz.explain_en: With an imidazole pKa of about 6.0, Henderson-Hasselbalch gives roughly 10% protonation at pH 7.0, so the familiar phrasing that most side chains are protonated and charged is inaccurate. What makes His important is precisely that its pKa straddles physiological pH, letting it buffer and act alternately as acid and base in catalysis. Putting the pKa at 12 and declaring it never charged runs to the opposite extreme, while calling it acidic because the ring contains nitrogen has the direction backwards: a nitrogen heterocycle is in fact the basic group.

title_zh: 芳香族氨基酸的紫外吸收、nanodrop 与比尔-朗伯定律
title_en: Aromatic residues, UV absorbance, the nanodrop and Beer-Lambert

points.zh: 三个芳香族氨基酸（苯丙氨酸 Phe、酪氨酸 Tyr、色氨酸 Trp）只需记住一个特点：在 250–280 nm 波长有紫外光吸收 UV absorption。
points.en: For the three aromatic residues (Phe, Tyr, Trp) you need remember one property: they absorb ultraviolet light in the 250-280 nm range.

points.zh: 老师的论证：这三种氨基酸在不同蛋白里所占的比重基本一致，所以可以用 280 nm 附近的吸光度来判断蛋白质含量。
points.en: The teacher's argument: these three occur in roughly constant proportion across different proteins, so absorbance near 280 nm can report protein amount.

points.zh: 这就是 nanodrop 测蛋白浓度的原理。
points.en: This is the operating principle of the nanodrop protein measurement.

points.zh: 换算依据是比尔-朗伯定律 Beer–Lambert law，它是一个定义式，涉及在 1 cm 光程内有多少吸光度。
points.en: The conversion rests on the Beer-Lambert law, which is stated as a definition involving how much absorbance occurs over a 1 cm path length.

points.zh: OD 是 optical density（光密度），指在某个特定波长下的吸光读数；实验室常说 OD600、OD450，其中最常用的是 OD600。
points.en: OD stands for optical density, the absorbance reading at a particular wavelength; the lab commonly quotes OD600 or OD450, with OD600 the most used.

points.zh: 老师的判断：比尔-朗伯定律本身"应该不是特别特别重要"，但既然定义较长，建议课后自己再看一遍。
points.en: The teacher's judgement is that Beer-Lambert itself is probably not a major exam item, but since the definition is long he suggests reading it again afterwards.

extra.tag: 定量补充 · quantitative
extra.zh: 比尔-朗伯定律写作 A = ε·c·l（吸光度 = 摩尔消光系数 × 浓度 × 光程）。蛋白在 280 nm 的 ε 几乎可以直接由序列算出：ε280 ≈ 5500 × (Trp 数) + 1490 × (Tyr 数) + 125 × (胱氨酸对数)，单位 M⁻¹cm⁻¹。所以规范做法是用 ProtParam 按序列算 ε，而不是套通用系数。
extra.en: Beer-Lambert is A = epsilon times c times l (absorbance equals molar extinction coefficient times concentration times path length). A protein's epsilon at 280 nm can be computed straight from sequence: roughly 5500 per Trp plus 1490 per Tyr plus 125 per cystine, in units of per molar per cm. The proper practice is therefore to compute epsilon from the sequence with ProtParam rather than assume a generic factor.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: "各蛋白中芳香族比重基本一致"只是粗略近似。280 nm 的吸收几乎全部来自 Trp 和 Tyr，苯丙氨酸 Phe 的 λmax 约 257 nm，在 280 nm 几乎不吸收。因此不含 Trp 的蛋白用 A280 定量会严重偏低甚至测不到，必须改用 BCA 或 Bradford 等显色法。
extra.en: "Roughly constant aromatic content" is only a crude approximation. Absorbance at 280 nm comes almost entirely from Trp and Tyr; phenylalanine peaks near 257 nm and barely absorbs at 280. A protein with no Trp is therefore badly underestimated or invisible by A280 and must be quantified by a colorimetric method such as BCA or Bradford.

extra.tag: 易混淆 · common confusion
extra.zh: 细菌的 OD600 和蛋白的 A280 不是一回事。OD600 测的主要是细胞对光的散射 scattering 而不是分子吸收，严格说不服从比尔-朗伯定律；读数超过约 0.6–0.8 就明显偏离线性，正确做法是稀释后测量再乘回稀释倍数。
extra.en: Bacterial OD600 and protein A280 are not the same measurement. OD600 mostly reports light scattering by cells, not molecular absorption, so it does not strictly obey Beer-Lambert and departs visibly from linearity above about 0.6-0.8. The correct practice is to dilute, read, and multiply back.

extra.tag: 考点延伸 · exam extension
extra.zh: 紫外吸收的物理来源是芳香环的 π→π* 跃迁。同一化学基础的另一应用是色氨酸荧光（激发约 280 nm、发射约 340 nm）：Trp 的发射波长对它所处的微环境极敏感，埋在疏水核心时蓝移，暴露到水中时红移，因此是监测蛋白去折叠和配体结合的常规手段。
extra.en: The UV absorbance arises physically from pi to pi-star transitions of the aromatic ring. The same chemistry underlies tryptophan fluorescence (excitation near 280 nm, emission near 340 nm): the emission wavelength is highly sensitive to environment, blue-shifting when Trp is buried and red-shifting on exposure to water, which makes it a routine probe of unfolding and ligand binding.

quiz.q_zh: 一个目的蛋白的序列里一个色氨酸 Trp 也没有，只有少数几个 Tyr。用 nanodrop 的 A280 测浓度，最可能的结果是什么？
quiz.q_en: A target protein's sequence contains no tryptophan at all and only a few tyrosines. What is the most likely outcome of quantifying it by A280 on a nanodrop?

options.zh: 浓度被明显高估，因为 Tyr 在 280 nm 的消光系数远大于 Trp
options.en: The concentration is markedly overestimated, because Tyr has a larger extinction coefficient than Trp

options.zh: 读数完全不受影响，因为芳香族氨基酸在所有蛋白中的占比都是恒定的
options.en: There is no effect at all, because aromatic residues occur at a constant proportion in every protein

options.zh: 完全测不到信号，因为在 280 nm 处只有 Phe 才有明显吸收
options.en: Nothing is detected at all, because at 280 nm only Phe absorbs among the three aromatics

options.zh: 浓度被明显低估，应改用 BCA 或 Bradford 等方法测定
options.en: The concentration is markedly underestimated, so a method such as BCA or Bradford is needed

quiz.explain_zh: 280 nm 的吸收几乎全部来自 Trp（ε ≈ 5500）和 Tyr（ε ≈ 1490），缺 Trp 会让 ε280 大幅下降，同样浓度读出的 A280 就低，于是浓度被低估。最诱人的错误是“芳香族氨基酸占比恒定、读数不受影响”，它照搬了课上那句近似；实际不同蛋白的 Trp/Tyr 含量差别很大，正因如此才要按序列逐个算 ε280。说“浓度被高估、Tyr 的消光系数更大”把两个数值说反了；说“只有 Phe 在 280 nm 吸收”也说反了，Phe 在此处基本不吸收。
quiz.explain_en: Absorbance at 280 nm comes almost entirely from Trp (epsilon about 5500) and Tyr (about 1490). Losing Trp collapses epsilon280, so the same concentration reads lower and is underestimated. The most tempting error is the claim that aromatics occur at a constant proportion so nothing changes, which repeats the lecture's approximation; in reality Trp and Tyr content varies widely between proteins, which is exactly why epsilon280 is computed per sequence. Saying the value is overestimated because Tyr absorbs more strongly inverts the two extinction coefficients, and saying only Phe absorbs at 280 nm is backwards as well, since Phe barely absorbs there.

quiz.q_zh: 为什么细菌培养的 OD600 不能像蛋白 A280 那样简单套用比尔-朗伯定律？
quiz.q_en: Why can a bacterial culture's OD600 not be plugged into Beer-Lambert the way a protein's A280 can?

options.zh: 因为培养液的光程随培养体积变化，不再是固定的 1 cm
options.en: Because the culture's path length changes with volume and is no longer a fixed 1 cm

options.zh: 因为 600 nm 属于可见光，而比尔-朗伯定律只适用于紫外区
options.en: Because 600 nm lies in the visible range and Beer-Lambert applies only in the ultraviolet

options.zh: 因为读数主要来自细胞对光的散射，而非溶质分子的吸收
options.en: Because the reading comes mainly from light scattered by cells, not absorbed by solutes

options.zh: 因为细菌细胞内不含芳香族氨基酸，600 nm 处没有吸收
options.en: Because bacterial cells contain no aromatic amino acids and cannot absorb at 600 nm

quiz.explain_zh: 比尔-朗伯定律描述的是溶质吸收光子导致的衰减；细胞悬液让光偏离原方向（散射），检测器同样读到“变暗”，但机制不同，因此线性范围很窄，高于约 0.6–0.8 就要稀释。最常见的误解是“定律只适用于紫外区”：它与波长区间无关，可见光同样适用。把原因归给光程也不成立：光程由比色皿决定，与培养体积无关，而且即使不同也可以直接校正。
quiz.explain_en: Beer-Lambert describes attenuation by solute molecules absorbing photons. A cell suspension deflects light out of the beam by scattering, which the detector also records as dimming but by a different mechanism, so linearity holds only over a narrow range and above about 0.6-0.8 you must dilute. The common misconception is that the law works only in the ultraviolet: it is not wavelength-restricted and applies in the visible too. Blaming the path length also fails, since path length is set by the cuvette rather than the culture volume and would in any case be a simple correction.

title_zh: 稀有氨基酸、pKa 的含义、A260/A280 判核酸污染与 Edman
title_en: Rare amino acids, the meaning of pKa, A260/A280 and nucleic acid contamination, Edman

points.zh: 两种不常见的稀有氨基酸都是经典氨基酸的修饰产物。第一种是硒代半胱氨酸 selenocysteine：硒 Se 原子取代了半胱氨酸里的硫 S。
points.en: The two rare amino acids are both modifications of standard residues. The first is selenocysteine, in which a selenium atom replaces the sulfur of cysteine.

points.zh: 第二种是吡咯赖氨酸 pyrrolysine：在赖氨酸侧链末端的碱性氨基上额外连接一个吡咯型杂环。老师说这两个"知道有这个东西就 OK 了"。
points.en: The second is pyrrolysine, in which a pyrroline-type heterocycle is attached to the basic side-chain amino group of lysine. The teacher says it is enough to know these exist.

points.zh: 氨基酸的等电点 pI 和相关公式"其实不太重要"，因为实际工作中很少讨论这些。
points.en: Isoelectric point and its formulas are called not very important, because they are seldom discussed in practice.

points.zh: 真正要记的是：不同氨基酸有不同的 pKa，pKa 代表该基团接受或释放氢离子 H+ 的能力，pKa 越低表示越容易释放出氢离子。
points.en: What matters is that different residues have different pKa values; pKa expresses the group's tendency to take up or release a proton, and a lower pKa means the proton is released more readily.

points.zh: 判断蛋白样品质量：在 nanodrop 上看 OD260/OD280，经典的蛋白样品这个数值在 0.6–0.7 之间。
points.en: To judge a protein sample: read OD260/OD280 on the nanodrop; a clean protein sample sits between 0.6 and 0.7.

points.zh: 如果该比值远高于 0.8 甚至到 1，就说明有核酸 nucleic acid 污染（核酸在 260 nm 吸收强）。
points.en: If the ratio runs well above 0.8 or reaches 1, there is nucleic acid contamination, because nucleic acid absorbs strongly at 260 nm.

points.zh: 去核酸污染的两个实验手段：一是超级核酸酶（benzonase 一类），无差别地把所有核酸消化掉；二是肝素柱 heparin column，一种多糖亲和柱，与核酸有较好的亲和作用，用来把核酸分开。
points.en: Two ways to remove it: a broad-spectrum nuclease of the benzonase type that digests all nucleic acid indiscriminately, or a heparin column, a polysaccharide affinity resin with good affinity in this system, used to separate the nucleic acid away.

points.zh: 氨基酸的化学反应部分只需记一个 Edman：这是商业上现在仍在使用的、从 N 端（氮端）开始一个一个氨基酸测序的化学反应；具体机理不必知道，记住"Edman 测序法"这个名字即可。
points.en: Of the amino acid chemistry, remember only Edman: a chemical sequencing reaction still used commercially that reads residues one at a time from the N-terminus. The mechanism need not be memorised; the name is enough.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 硒代半胱氨酸（第 21 种氨基酸）确实存在于人体，出现在谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶 GPX、硫氧还蛋白还原酶 TrxR 和脱碘酶中，由 UGA 密码子在 mRNA 的 SECIS 元件参与下重编码翻译。但吡咯赖氨酸（第 22 种，由 UAG 编码）只见于部分产甲烷古菌和少数细菌，人体内并不存在——课上把两者一并说成"人体内也存在"。
extra.en: Selenocysteine, the 21st amino acid, really is present in humans, in glutathione peroxidases, thioredoxin reductase and the deiodinases, recoded from a UGA codon with help from a SECIS element in the mRNA. Pyrrolysine, the 22nd, encoded by UAG, occurs only in some methanogenic archaea and a few bacteria and is absent from humans, although the lecture groups both as present in the body.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 肝素柱的机制其实是反过来的：肝素是高度硫酸化的多糖，作为 DNA 的"负电模拟物"，结合的是核酸结合蛋白（你的目标蛋白）。上样后核酸和不结合的杂质流穿 flow-through，目标蛋白被保留，再用高盐梯度洗脱。它不是把核酸吸住洗掉。
extra.en: The heparin column works the other way round: heparin is a heavily sulfated polysaccharide that mimics the polyanionic backbone of DNA and binds nucleic-acid-binding proteins, meaning your target. Nucleic acid and non-binders pass through in the flow-through, the protein is retained, and a salt gradient elutes it. It does not capture the nucleic acid.

extra.tag: 定量补充 · quantitative
extra.zh: 对照值：纯 DNA 的 A260/A280 = 1.8，纯 RNA = 2.0，纯蛋白约 0.57。所以课上说的 0.6–0.7 就是接近纯蛋白的区间，比值越往 1 以上走核酸占比越高。要注意这个比值只能回答"有没有核酸"，回答不了蛋白纯不纯、有没有降解——那要靠 SDS-PAGE 和 SEC。
extra.en: Reference values: pure DNA gives A260/A280 of 1.8, pure RNA 2.0, pure protein about 0.57. The lecture's 0.6-0.7 is therefore the near-pure protein window, and the further above 1 it climbs the more nucleic acid is present. Note the ratio answers only whether nucleic acid is present, not whether the protein is pure or intact; that needs SDS-PAGE and size-exclusion chromatography.

extra.tag: 考点延伸 · exam extension
extra.zh: Edman 降解的三步：苯异硫氰酸酯 PITC 在碱性下与游离 α-氨基反应、酸性条件切下末端残基、鉴定生成的 PTH-氨基酸，然后重复。两个限制常考：一是 N 端若被封闭（乙酰化、焦谷氨酸等）就完全测不动；二是每轮效率不到 100%，累积下来实际只能连续读约 30–50 个残基，这正是长蛋白必须先酶切再测的原因。
extra.en: Edman degradation runs in three steps: phenylisothiocyanate couples to the free alpha-amino group under alkaline conditions, acid cleaves off the terminal residue, and the resulting PTH-amino acid is identified, then the cycle repeats. Two limits are examined often: a blocked N-terminus, from acetylation or pyroglutamate, stops it dead, and per-cycle efficiency below 100% limits a run to roughly 30-50 residues, which is exactly why long proteins must be cleaved into peptides first.

quiz.q_zh: 一份纯化后的蛋白样品在 nanodrop 上读到 A260/A280 = 1.2。最合理的解读是什么？
quiz.q_en: A purified protein sample reads A260/A280 = 1.2 on the nanodrop. What is the most reasonable interpretation?

options.zh: 蛋白已经大量降解成小肽，芳香族残基的紫外吸收随之下降了
options.en: The protein has degraded into small peptides, lowering the aromatic absorbance

options.zh: 蛋白浓度过高，两个波长下的读数都已经超出了线性范围
options.en: The protein is far too concentrated and both readings exceed the linear range

options.zh: 这是一份纯度很好的蛋白样品，比值正好落在理想区间内
options.en: This is a very pure protein sample and its ratio sits in the ideal range

options.zh: 样品中残留了大量核酸，把 260 nm 的读数拉高了
options.en: The sample retains substantial nucleic acid, which raises the 260 nm reading

quiz.explain_zh: 纯蛋白的 A260/A280 约 0.57–0.7，纯核酸是 1.8–2.0；读到 1.2 说明 260 nm 的贡献被大量核酸拉高了，样品正处在两者之间。诱人的错误是“蛋白降解成小肽”：降解不改变芳香族残基的总量，因而基本不改变这个比值，判降解要靠 SDS-PAGE。浓度过高只会让绝对读数超范围，而比值是两个读数相除、在一定范围内不受浓度影响。
quiz.explain_en: Pure protein reads about 0.57-0.7 and pure nucleic acid 1.8-2.0, so 1.2 sits between them and means the 260 nm signal has been pulled up by a lot of nucleic acid. The tempting error is the degradation-into-small-peptides reading: degradation does not change the total aromatic content and so barely moves this ratio, and degradation is judged on SDS-PAGE. Excess concentration pushes absolute readings out of range, but the ratio divides two readings and is largely concentration-independent within range.

quiz.q_zh: “某基团的 pKa 比另一个低”意味着什么？
quiz.q_en: What does it mean for one group to have a lower pKa than another?

options.zh: 它在水中的溶解度一定更大，更容易被溶剂化
options.en: It must be more water-soluble and is therefore more readily solvated

options.zh: 它更容易释放出质子，也就是酸性更强
options.en: It gives up a proton more readily, that is, it is the stronger acid

options.zh: 它更容易结合上质子，也就是碱性更强
options.en: It takes up a proton more readily, that is, it is the stronger base

options.zh: 它的等电点一定更高，净电荷为零的 pH 更大
options.en: Its isoelectric point must be higher, at a pH where net charge is zero

quiz.explain_zh: pKa 是解离常数的负对数，pKa 越低解离越彻底，即质子越容易离开。说它“更容易结合质子、碱性更强”正好说反，是最常见的记混。pKa 与 pI 有关但不是同一件事：pI 是所有可解离基团共同决定的净电荷为零的 pH，低 pKa 的酸性侧链反而把 pI 拉低，所以“等电点一定更高”方向也是反的。溶解度由整个分子决定，与单个基团的 pKa 没有固定关系。
quiz.explain_en: pKa is the negative logarithm of the dissociation constant, so a lower pKa means more complete dissociation and a proton that leaves more easily. Saying it takes up protons more readily and is more basic states the reverse, and is the commonest confusion. pKa relates to pI but is not the same thing: pI is the pH at which all ionisable groups together give zero net charge, and low-pKa acidic side chains pull pI down rather than up, so the claim about a higher isoelectric point is inverted too. Solubility depends on the whole molecule and has no fixed relation to one group's pKa.

quiz.q_zh: 用 Edman 降解测一个纯化蛋白的 N 端序列，结果第一轮就没有任何信号。最可能的原因是什么？
quiz.q_en: Edman degradation of a purified protein gives no signal even in the first cycle. What is the most likely reason?

options.zh: 蛋白的脯氨酸含量过高，肽链无法牢固地固定在载体上
options.en: The protein is proline-rich, so the peptide chain cannot be immobilised on the support

options.zh: N 端被乙酰化或焦谷氨酸封闭，没有游离 α-氨基
options.en: The N-terminus is blocked by acetylation or pyroglutamate, with no free alpha-amino group

options.zh: 蛋白链实在太长，第一轮偶联反应的效率已低于检测下限
options.en: The chain is far too long, so even the very first coupling falls below the detection limit

options.zh: 蛋白的 C 端被酰胺化封闭了，降解反应因此无法启动
options.en: The C-terminus has been blocked by amidation, so the degradation cannot get started

quiz.explain_zh: Edman 的第一步是 PITC 与游离 α-氨基反应，N 端一旦被乙酰化或环化成焦谷氨酸，这一步就无法进行，因此第一轮就无信号。“链太长、第一轮效率低于检测限”很诱人，但它描述的是另一种现象：每轮效率不到 100%，信号是随轮次累积衰减的，几十轮之后才变差，不会让第一轮就是空的，而且链长并不影响第一轮偶联。C 端的修饰与 Edman 无关，那是羧肽酶或 CNBr 的领域。
quiz.explain_en: Edman begins with PITC coupling to a free alpha-amino group; once the N-terminus is acetylated or cyclised to pyroglutamate that step cannot occur and cycle one is already blank. The chain-too-long explanation is tempting but describes a different phenomenon: per-cycle efficiency below 100% makes the signal decay cumulatively over dozens of cycles, never blanking the very first, and chain length does not affect the initial coupling. A modified C-terminus is irrelevant to Edman, being the domain of carboxypeptidases or CNBr chemistry.

title_zh: 一级结构：凯氏定氮、肽键的共振与平面性、双缩脲、谷胱甘肽、鸟枪法测序
title_en: Primary structure: Kjeldahl, peptide bond resonance and planarity, biuret, glutathione, shotgun sequencing

points.zh: 蛋白质的共价结构就是它的一级结构 primary structure，即氨基酸的组成与排列序列。
points.en: A protein's covalent structure is its primary structure: the composition and order of its amino acids.

points.zh: 凯氏定氮法 Kjeldahl：氮元素在蛋白质中约占重量的 16%，把蛋白"烧掉"后测无机氮的重量，乘以 6.25（即 100/16）就能推算蛋白质量；这是比较古老的方法，现在不常用。
points.en: The Kjeldahl method: nitrogen makes up about 16% of a protein by weight, so after combustion you measure the inorganic nitrogen and multiply by 6.25 (that is 100 over 16) to get protein mass. It is an old method, now seldom used.

points.zh: 老师给的大小界限：最小的蛋白质认为是胰岛素 insulin，分子量 6733 道尔顿（见 extra 更正）；小于 6000 Da 的一般算小多肽 polypeptide，但这个界限并不严格。
points.en: The size boundary given: insulin is taken as the smallest protein at 6733 daltons (see the correction in extra), and anything below 6000 Da counts as a small polypeptide, though the line is not sharp.

points.zh: 肽键的书写惯例：一般从 N 端（氮端）写到 C 端（碳端）。
points.en: The writing convention for peptides is from the N-terminus to the C-terminus.

points.zh: 肽键存在两种共振式 resonance：碳氧双键 C=O 可以共振成碳氮双键 C=N 的形式，因此肽键实际上介于单键与双键之间，可以理解为"1.5 个键"。
points.en: The peptide bond has two resonance forms: the C=O double bond can shift to a C=N double bond, so the bond is intermediate between single and double, roughly a bond and a half.

points.zh: 后果：肽键比普通的 C–N 单键更稳定，但没有真正的双键那么稳定，是一种中间状态；同时肽键是典型的平面 planar 的键。
points.en: The consequence: the peptide bond is more stable than an ordinary C-N single bond but less than a true double bond, an intermediate state, and it is a classically planar bond.

points.zh: 双缩脲反应 biuret reaction：必须是二肽以上，在碱性条件下用铜离子 Cu2+ 络合形成配合物，呈紫色，用来鉴定蛋白质的存在。
points.en: The biuret reaction requires more than a dipeptide, uses Cu2+ under alkaline conditions to form a coloured complex, and turns violet, identifying the presence of protein.

points.zh: 谷胱甘肽 glutathione 是一个特殊小肽：其中的谷氨酸是用 γ-羧基而不是经典的 α-羧基参与成肽键——这是必记的点；它在蛋白变性-复性 refolding 过程中很重要，能解开错误形成的二硫键、促成正确折叠的二硫键。
points.en: Glutathione is a special small peptide: its glutamate forms the peptide bond through its gamma-carboxyl rather than the usual alpha-carboxyl, which is the point to memorise. It matters in denaturation and refolding because it can undo wrongly formed disulfides and promote correct ones.

points.zh: 测序方法：Edman 是从 N 端开始的连续测序；现在更常用的是酶裂解 + HPLC + MS 的鸟枪法 shotgun——用不同的酶把蛋白水解成肽段，用高效液相色谱 HPLC 分离，逐段打分子量确定组成，最后按重叠区拼接还原全长序列。肼解法一类的老方法现在没人再用。
points.en: Sequencing: Edman reads continuously from the N-terminus, while the now more common approach is the shotgun method combining enzymatic cleavage, HPLC and MS. Different enzymes hydrolyse the protein into peptides, HPLC separates them, each fragment's mass and composition is determined, and overlaps are used to reassemble the full sequence. Older routes such as hydrazinolysis are no longer used.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 胰岛素的分子量教材通常给约 5.8 kDa：人胰岛素 5808 Da，牛胰岛素 5733 Da，共 51 个残基（A 链 21 + B 链 30，由二硫键连接）。课上的 6733 应是口误。另外"最小的蛋白质"只是习惯说法：胰岛素之所以经典，真正的原因是它是第一个被完整测定氨基酸序列的蛋白（Sanger，1950 年代），证明了蛋白质有确定的序列。
extra.en: Textbooks give insulin at about 5.8 kDa: human insulin 5808 Da and bovine 5733 Da, 51 residues in total as a 21-residue A chain and a 30-residue B chain joined by disulfides. The lecture's 6733 is a slip. Also, calling insulin the smallest protein is only convention; what makes it canonical is that it was the first protein fully sequenced (Sanger, 1950s), proving that proteins have defined sequences.

extra.tag: 定量补充 · quantitative
extra.zh: "1.5 个键"的定量版本：肽键的 C–N 键长约 1.32 Å，介于 C–N 单键 1.49 Å 与 C=N 双键 1.27 Å 之间，双键成分约 40%。绕这个键旋转的能垒约 20 kcal/mol，所以 ω 二面角基本被锁在 180°（trans）；唯一的显著例外是 X–Pro 肽键，其 cis 形式可占百分之几到十几。
extra.en: The quantitative version of "a bond and a half": the peptide C-N bond is about 1.32 angstrom, between the 1.49 of a C-N single bond and the 1.27 of a C=N double bond, giving roughly 40% double-bond character. The rotational barrier is about 20 kcal/mol, so the omega dihedral is locked near 180 degrees, trans. The one notable exception is the X-Pro bond, where the cis form can reach several to over ten percent.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 课上把 β-sheet 有平行 parallel 与反平行 antiparallel 两种归因于肽键的平面性。实际上平行/反平行取决于相邻两条链的走向（N→C 方向相同还是相反），与平面性无直接因果。肽键平面性真正的后果是：主链上每个残基只剩 φ 和 ψ 两个可转二面角，这正是 Ramachandran plot 能用二维图穷尽主链构象的前提。
extra.en: The lecture attributes the existence of parallel and antiparallel beta-sheets to peptide-bond planarity. In fact parallel versus antiparallel depends on whether neighbouring strands run in the same or opposite N-to-C direction, with no direct causal link to planarity. What planarity really does is leave each residue only two rotatable backbone dihedrals, phi and psi, which is precisely why a two-dimensional Ramachandran plot can exhaust backbone conformational space.

extra.tag: 考点延伸 · exam extension
extra.zh: 两个方法的细节：双缩脲反应需要至少 2 个肽键，所以三肽以上才显色、二肽不显色（这正是"二肽以上"的含义），产物在 540 nm 比色定量。凯氏定氮测的是总氮而不是蛋白，任何含氮杂质都会被折算成蛋白——三聚氰胺奶粉事件正是钻这个空子，也说明为什么现代蛋白定量已改用 BCA、Bradford 或 A280。
extra.en: Two method details. The biuret reaction needs at least two peptide bonds, so tripeptides and larger give colour while dipeptides do not, which is what "more than a dipeptide" means, and the product is read at 540 nm. Kjeldahl measures total nitrogen, not protein, so any nitrogen-rich adulterant counts as protein, which is exactly the loophole the melamine milk scandal exploited and why modern quantification uses BCA, Bradford or A280.

quiz.q_zh: 肽键不能自由旋转，主要原因是什么？
quiz.q_en: Why can the peptide bond not rotate freely?

options.zh: 两侧残基的侧链空间位阻很大，使这个肽键无法自由转动
options.en: Steric hindrance from the side chains on either side stops the bond turning

options.zh: 共振使 C–N 键有 40% 双键性质，旋转能垒很高
options.en: Resonance gives the C-N bond 40% double-bond character, raising the barrier

options.zh: 相邻残基之间的主链氢键把这个肽键锁定在平面构象上
options.en: Backbone hydrogen bonds between neighbouring residues lock it into a plane

options.zh: 羰基氧的电负性很强，它产生的偶极在静电上阻碍了键的旋转
options.en: The carbonyl oxygen is strongly electronegative and its dipole blocks rotation

quiz.explain_zh: 共振把电子离域到 O–C–N 上，C–N 键长缩短到约 1.32 Å，旋转能垒约 20 kcal/mol，室温下基本不转，所以肽键单元是刚性平面。诱人的错误是把原因归给“侧链空间位阻”：侧链位阻限制的是 φ 和 ψ（Ramachandran 图的形状就是它造成的），而不是 ω；把两件事混起来会导致“甘氨酸的肽键可以自由旋转”这类错误推论。主链氢键和羰基偶极都真实存在，但强度远不足以造成 20 kcal/mol 的能垒。
quiz.explain_en: Resonance delocalises electrons across O-C-N, shortening the C-N bond to about 1.32 angstrom and raising the rotational barrier to about 20 kcal/mol, effectively frozen at room temperature, so the peptide unit is a rigid plane. The tempting error is to blame side-chain steric hindrance: sterics restrict phi and psi, which is what shapes the Ramachandran plot, not omega. Conflating them leads to wrong inferences such as glycine having a freely rotating peptide bond. Backbone hydrogen bonds and the carbonyl dipole are real but far too weak to account for a 20 kcal/mol barrier.

quiz.q_zh: 用凯氏定氮法检测某奶粉，测得“蛋白含量”很高，但实际蛋白很少。这最可能说明什么？
quiz.q_en: Kjeldahl analysis of a milk powder reports a high protein content although it actually contains little protein. What does this most likely indicate?

options.zh: 样品中芳香族氨基酸比例偏高，抬高了最终测得的读数
options.en: The sample is unusually rich in aromatic amino acids, which raised the final reading

options.zh: 样品脂肪含量过高，干扰了消化与蒸馏步骤的回收率
options.en: Excess fat in the sample interfered with digestion and distillation recovery

options.zh: 掺入了高含氮的非蛋白物质，被折算系数当成了蛋白
options.en: A nitrogen-rich non-protein additive was counted as protein by the conversion factor

options.zh: 样品中的蛋白发生了严重变性，暴露出更多可测的氮原子
options.en: The protein in the sample was heavily denatured, exposing more nitrogen atoms to measure

quiz.explain_zh: 凯氏定氮测的是总氮，再假设“氮占蛋白 16%”按 ×6.25 反推，因此任何高氮化合物都会被记成蛋白。诱人的错误是“变性暴露出更多氮原子”：变性只改变构象，不改变元素组成，消化燃烧后的总氮完全一样。把原因归给“芳香族氨基酸比例偏高”则混淆了 A280 法与定氮法——氨基酸带不带苯环，不影响它含几个氮。
quiz.explain_en: Kjeldahl measures total nitrogen and back-calculates with a factor of 6.25 on the assumption that nitrogen is 16% of protein, so any nitrogen-rich compound is scored as protein. The tempting error is that denaturation exposes more nitrogen: denaturation changes conformation, not elemental composition, and digestion yields exactly the same nitrogen. Blaming a high aromatic content confuses the A280 method, which does depend on aromatics, with nitrogen determination, since whether a residue carries a ring does not change how many nitrogens it has.

quiz.q_zh: 谷胱甘肽与普通三肽最本质的结构区别是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the fundamental structural difference between glutathione and an ordinary tripeptide?

options.zh: 它的三个残基当中有一个是自然界中罕见的非蛋白氨基酸
options.en: One of its three residues is a rare amino acid never used in protein synthesis

options.zh: 它的谷氨酸用 γ-羧基而不是 α-羧基形成肽键
options.en: Its glutamate forms the peptide bond from its gamma-carboxyl, not the alpha one

options.zh: 它是首尾相连的环状肽，没有游离的 N 端和 C 端
options.en: It is a head-to-tail cyclic peptide, having neither a free N- nor a C-terminus

options.zh: 它的半胱氨酸是 D-构型，因此完全不被普通蛋白酶识别
options.en: Its cysteine is a D-enantiomer, which is why no ordinary protease will recognise it

quiz.explain_zh: 谷胱甘肽是 γ-Glu–Cys–Gly，第一个肽键用的是 Glu 侧链的 γ-羧基。这不是文字游戏：γ-肽键不被常规的氨肽酶识别，所以谷胱甘肽在胞内不易被降解，可以维持很高的浓度去做还原缓冲。最诱人的错误是“半胱氨酸是 D-构型”，因为它给出的抗降解结论是对的，原因却错了——三个氨基酸都是标准的 L-型蛋白氨基酸，抗降解来自键的连接方式而不是手性。它也不含非蛋白氨基酸、并不成环，所以另外两项同样错。
quiz.explain_en: Glutathione is gamma-Glu-Cys-Gly, with the first peptide bond formed from the side-chain gamma-carboxyl of Glu. This is not a technicality: a gamma-peptide bond is not recognised by ordinary aminopeptidases, so glutathione resists degradation and can be maintained at high intracellular concentration as a redox buffer. The most tempting error is the D-cysteine claim, because its conclusion about resisting proteases is right while its reason is wrong: all three residues are standard L-amino acids, and the resistance comes from how the bond is made, not from chirality. The peptide contains no non-proteinogenic residue and is not cyclic either, so those two claims fail as well.

title_zh: 蛋白质结构的层次：二级、三级、四级与超二级结构
title_en: Levels of protein structure: secondary, tertiary, quaternary and supersecondary

points.zh: 讲蛋白质的三维结构时，二级、三级、四级结构其实都可以归到"蛋白质空间结构"这一话题下。
points.en: When three-dimensional structure is discussed, secondary, tertiary and quaternary all fall under the same heading of the protein's spatial structure.

points.zh: 经典定义：蛋白质由多肽折叠形成，具有一定的空间结构，而且这个特殊的空间结构要对应特殊的生物学功能——也就是老生常谈的"结构影响功能"。
points.en: The classic definition: a protein is formed by the folding of a polypeptide, has a defined spatial structure, and that particular structure corresponds to a particular biological function, the familiar idea that structure determines function.

points.zh: 记号：生化里用 1°、2°、3°、4°（数字右上角一个度）表示各级结构；现在的文献一般不这样写了。
points.en: Notation: biochemistry writes the levels as 1, 2, 3, 4 with a degree sign, though current literature generally no longer does.

points.zh: 一级结构是氨基酸的排列顺序，不属于高级结构；高级结构只包括二、三、四级。
points.en: Primary structure is the amino acid sequence and does not count as higher-order structure; only the second, third and fourth levels do.

points.zh: 二级结构 secondary structure 是多肽链主链 backbone 的折叠方式。
points.en: Secondary structure is the way the polypeptide's backbone folds.

points.zh: 三级结构 tertiary structure 是一整条完整多肽链的折叠，这是与二级结构最明显的区分；一个三级结构上可以存在许多个相互独立的二级结构，很多个二级结构串起来才形成一条完整的肽链、一个完整的三级结构。
points.en: Tertiary structure is the folding of one entire polypeptide chain, which is the clearest distinction from secondary structure. A single tertiary structure can contain many independent secondary structures strung together to make one complete chain.

points.zh: 四级结构 quaternary structure 描述寡聚 oligomeric 蛋白各亚基之间的空间相对位置排布；不是所有蛋白都有，因为不是所有蛋白都是寡聚形式的——只有好几个单体（好几个三级结构）通过相互作用连成寡聚体时才谈四级结构。有四级结构的蛋白一般都对应一些特殊的生物学功能，因为生物不会白白花费能量去做没有意义的事情；血红蛋白 hemoglobin 是后面要详细讲的例子。
points.en: Quaternary structure describes the relative spatial arrangement of the subunits of an oligomeric protein. Not every protein has one, because not every protein is oligomeric; only when several monomers, several tertiary structures, associate into an oligomer does the term apply. Proteins that do have it generally have some special biological function, since organisms do not spend energy pointlessly, and haemoglobin is the worked example to come.

points.zh: 超二级结构 supersecondary structure 是一个较古早、现在已不常提的概念：两三个二级结构以某种特殊方式排列起来，但还没有达到"一整条多肽链折叠"的三级结构层次。
points.en: Supersecondary structure is an older term now rarely used: two or three secondary structures arranged in a particular way, but not yet reaching the tertiary level of a whole folded chain.

points.zh: 例子：SARS-CoV-2 的聚合酶 polymerase (RdRp) 是典型的有四级结构的蛋白，由好几个小亚基组成，也因此比较难表达制备；生化上把聚合酶的形状叫作"手掌状"，其中 palm（手掌）主要用来贴住核酸链，另有 thumb 等区域。
points.en: The example: the SARS-CoV-2 polymerase (RdRp) is a classic protein with quaternary structure, built from several small subunits, which is also why it is hard to produce. Biochemistry calls the polymerase shape a right hand, with the palm gripping the nucleic acid strand and further regions such as the thumb.

extra.tag: 易混淆 · common confusion
extra.zh: 超二级结构（即 motif，如 βαβ、helix-turn-helix、β-hairpin、Greek key）和结构域 domain 是两个不同概念，课上口误说成"超二级结构域"很容易把它们混在一起。domain 指能独立折叠、常常能独立行使功能的模块，通常 100–200 个残基，可以被剪切出来单独表达；motif 只是几个二级结构单元的固定排列，本身不要求能独立折叠。一个结构域里通常含多个 motif。
extra.en: Supersecondary structure, that is a motif such as beta-alpha-beta, helix-turn-helix, beta-hairpin or Greek key, and a domain are two different concepts; the lecture's slip of running the two words together invites confusion. A domain is an independently folding, often independently functional module, typically 100-200 residues, which can be excised and expressed on its own. A motif is just a fixed arrangement of a few secondary-structure elements and need not fold independently. One domain usually contains several motifs.

extra.tag: 课上未展开 · not covered
extra.zh: 二级结构之所以被定义为"主链的折叠方式"，是因为稳定它的氢键全部发生在主链的 N–H 与 C=O 之间，与侧链是什么无关（这也是为什么可以只看 φ/ψ 就判断 α-helix 还是 β-sheet）；而三级结构主要靠侧链之间的作用力稳定：疏水作用 hydrophobic effect（主要驱动力）、盐桥、氢键、二硫键。这条"主链 vs 侧链"的区分是判别二级/三级最可靠的标准。
extra.en: Secondary structure is defined as backbone folding because every hydrogen bond stabilising it runs between backbone N-H and C=O groups, independent of side-chain identity, which is why phi and psi alone distinguish an alpha-helix from a beta-sheet. Tertiary structure is instead stabilised by side-chain interactions: the hydrophobic effect as the main driving force, plus salt bridges, hydrogen bonds and disulfides. This backbone-versus-side-chain distinction is the most reliable test of which level you are looking at.

extra.tag: 考点延伸 · exam extension
extra.zh: Anfinsen 用核糖核酸酶 A 做的复性实验说明：一级结构决定三级结构——用尿素加 β-巯基乙醇变性、打开四对二硫键后，除去变性剂让它自发复性，活性可以恢复。把这条和上一段的谷胱甘肽/二硫键重排连起来，其实是同一个实验体系的两面：折叠信息在序列里，谷胱甘肽只是提供让错误二硫键有机会重排的化学环境。
extra.en: Anfinsen's ribonuclease A experiment showed that primary structure determines tertiary structure: denature with urea and beta-mercaptoethanol to break all four disulfides, then remove the denaturant and let it refold spontaneously, and activity returns. Joined with the glutathione and disulfide-shuffling point earlier, these are two faces of one system: the folding information lies in the sequence, and glutathione merely supplies the chemical environment in which wrong disulfides can be reshuffled.

extra.tag: 课上未展开 · not covered
extra.zh: 聚合酶的"右手"比喻有三个标准部分：fingers 结合进入的核苷三磷酸 NTP 和模板链，palm 是催化中心、含两个金属离子（two-metal-ion mechanism），thumb 夹住已合成的双链产物。SARS-CoV-2 的 RdRp 具体是 nsp12 与 nsp7 和两拷贝 nsp8 组成的复合物，正是四级结构的实例；瑞德西韦 remdesivir 就是作用于这个活性中心的核苷类似物。
extra.en: The right-hand metaphor for polymerases has three standard parts: fingers bind the incoming NTP and the template, palm holds the catalytic centre with its two metal ions (the two-metal-ion mechanism), and thumb clamps the double-stranded product. The SARS-CoV-2 RdRp is specifically a complex of nsp12 with nsp7 and two copies of nsp8, a concrete instance of quaternary structure, and remdesivir is a nucleoside analogue acting at that catalytic centre.

quiz.q_zh: 区分二级结构和三级结构，最可靠的标准是下列哪一项？
quiz.q_en: Which is the most reliable criterion for distinguishing secondary from tertiary structure?

options.zh: 二级结构是主链的局部构象，三级是整条链的空间折叠
options.en: Secondary structure is local backbone conformation, tertiary is the whole chain's fold

options.zh: 二级结构自发形成，而三级结构必须消耗 ATP 才能形成
options.en: Secondary structure forms spontaneously whereas tertiary structure has to consume ATP

options.zh: 二级结构只见于可溶蛋白，三级结构只见于膜蛋白中
options.en: Secondary structure occurs only in soluble proteins and tertiary only in membrane proteins

options.zh: α-helix 属于二级结构，而 β-sheet 属于三级结构
options.en: Alpha-helices count as secondary structure while beta-sheets count as tertiary structure

quiz.explain_zh: 二级结构的定义就是主链的局部构象，其氢键全部在主链 N–H 与 C=O 之间；三级结构是整条链的空间排布，靠疏水作用、盐桥、二硫键等侧链相互作用维持。最常见的死记错误是把 β-sheet 划给三级结构：α-helix 和 β-sheet 同属二级结构，二者的区别是主链构象不同，不是层级不同。折叠是自发的热力学过程，不直接消耗 ATP；可溶蛋白和膜蛋白也都同时具有二级和三级结构。
quiz.explain_en: Secondary structure is by definition local backbone conformation, with all its hydrogen bonds between backbone N-H and C=O. Tertiary structure is the spatial arrangement of the whole chain, held together by side-chain interactions such as the hydrophobic effect, salt bridges and disulfides. The commonest rote error is assigning beta-sheets to the tertiary level: alpha-helix and beta-sheet are both secondary structure, differing in backbone conformation rather than in level. Folding is a spontaneous thermodynamic process that does not itself consume ATP, and soluble and membrane proteins alike have both levels.

quiz.q_zh: 为什么说“不是所有蛋白质都有四级结构”？
quiz.q_en: Why is it said that not every protein has quaternary structure?

options.zh: 因为只有多亚基寡聚蛋白才谈四级结构，单体到三级为止
options.en: Because quaternary structure applies only to oligomers; a monomer stops at tertiary

options.zh: 因为四级结构只在晶体的堆积中出现，在溶液里都会解离
options.en: Because quaternary structure appears only in crystal packing and dissociates in solution

options.zh: 因为只有含有链间二硫键的蛋白质才可能形成四级结构
options.en: Because only proteins with interchain disulfide bonds can form quaternary structure

options.zh: 因为只有那些具有特殊生物学功能的蛋白质才需要四级结构
options.en: Because only proteins with a special biological function ever need quaternary structure

quiz.explain_zh: 判据是“是不是寡聚”这个结构事实：单条多肽链折叠完就到三级结构为止，无从谈亚基间的相对排布。最诱人的错误是“只有具有特殊生物学功能的蛋白才需要四级结构”，它把课上那句“有四级结构的一般都有特殊功能”的因果说反了——功能相关性是随之而来的观察，不是四级结构存在与否的判据。血红蛋白等寡聚体在溶液中同样是四聚体，所以“只在晶体堆积中出现”不成立；四级结构的界面主要靠非共价作用维持，链间二硫键并非必需。
quiz.explain_en: The criterion is the structural fact of whether the protein is oligomeric: a single folded chain stops at the tertiary level and there is no inter-subunit arrangement to describe. The most tempting error is the claim that only proteins with a special function need quaternary structure, which inverts the lecture's remark that proteins with quaternary structure usually have a special function; that correlation is an observation that follows, not the test for whether quaternary structure exists. Oligomers such as haemoglobin stay assembled in solution, so the crystal-packing claim fails, and quaternary interfaces are held mainly by non-covalent forces with interchain disulfides not required.

quiz.q_zh: 关于聚合酶“手掌状”结构，下列说法正确的是？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about the right-hand architecture of a polymerase is correct?

options.zh: thumb 区才是真正的催化中心，palm 只负责结合核苷酸底物
options.en: The thumb is the real catalytic centre while the palm merely binds the nucleotide substrate

options.zh: “手掌状”描述的是四级结构中若干个亚基之间的相对排列方式
options.en: The hand shape describes how the separate subunits are arranged in the quaternary structure

options.zh: 只有 DNA 聚合酶采用右手型折叠，RNA 依赖的 RNA 聚合酶不是
options.en: Only DNA polymerases adopt the right-hand fold, while RNA-dependent RNA polymerases do not

options.zh: palm 有催化中心，thumb 夹双链，fingers 结合核苷酸
options.en: The palm holds the catalytic centre, the thumb grips the duplex, the fingers bind NTP

quiz.explain_zh: fingers/palm/thumb 是同一条催化亚基内部的三级结构分区，palm 里有保守的天冬氨酸配位两个金属离子完成催化，thumb 抱住已合成的双链保证持续性，fingers 结合进入的 NTP。诱人的混淆是把“手掌状”当成亚基之间的排列方式：课上先讲四级结构再讲手掌状，容易误以为二者是一回事，其实“手掌”描述的是单个催化亚基（如 nsp12）的折叠，四级结构说的是它与 nsp7/nsp8 的组装。这一右手折叠在 DNA 聚合酶和 RdRp 中都高度保守，所以“只有 DNA 聚合酶才有”也错。
quiz.explain_en: Fingers, palm and thumb are subdivisions of the tertiary fold within one catalytic subunit: the palm carries the conserved aspartates that coordinate the two catalytic metal ions, the thumb wraps the synthesised duplex to keep the enzyme processive, and the fingers bind the incoming NTP. The tempting confusion is reading the hand as an arrangement of subunits: the lecture moves from quaternary structure straight to the hand metaphor, but the hand describes the fold of a single catalytic subunit such as nsp12, while quaternary structure refers to its assembly with nsp7 and nsp8. The right-hand fold is highly conserved in both DNA polymerases and RdRps, so restricting it to DNA polymerases is wrong too.

title_zh: 聚合酶的结构域分工与四级结构
title_en: Polymerase domains and quaternary structure

points.zh: 聚合酶的核心 core 由三个结构域组成:palm 手掌区、fingers 手指区、thumb 拇指区。文献里说的 core protein / 复制 core 就是指这个核心部分。
points.en: The polymerase core consists of three domains: palm, fingers and thumb. What the literature calls the core protein or the replication core refers to this catalytic core.

points.zh: 老师的讲法是:palm 主要用来贴住 DNA 链,fingers 是催化区,thumb 是拇指区(见 extra 的更正)。
points.en: As stated in the lecture: the palm holds onto the DNA strand, the fingers are the catalytic region, and the thumb is the thumb region (see extra for the correction).

points.zh: 复制 core 只负责把双链解开、让新的单链进来配对延伸;其他与复制相关的功能由别的亚基或结构域承担。
points.en: The replication core is only responsible for opening the duplex and letting the new single strand come in, pair and extend; other replication-related functions are carried by other subunits or domains.

points.zh: 在病毒里,特别是 SARS-CoV-2,聚合酶是一个复合物 complex,除了聚合还承接给新转录出的 mRNA 加帽 capping 和加 poly(A) 尾巴的功能。
points.en: In viruses, especially SARS-CoV-2, the polymerase is a complex that, besides polymerising, also carries out capping of the newly transcribed mRNA and addition of the poly(A) tail.

points.zh: 原因是病毒 mRNA 要在真核宿主体内被翻译,必须有 5' 帽子 cap 和 poly(A) 尾巴才能被真核翻译机器识别。
points.en: The reason is that for the viral mRNA to be translated inside a eukaryotic host it must carry a 5' cap and a poly(A) tail to be recognised by the eukaryotic translation machinery.

points.zh: 这些不同的功能由不同的结构域 domain(即不同的三级结构单位)分别承担。
points.en: These different functions are each carried by a different domain, i.e. a distinct tertiary-structure unit.

points.zh: 因为这些酶行使的功能在时间和空间上非常接近(前一个刚把 RNA 转录/复制出来,下一个马上拿过去加帽、加 poly(A)),它们会组装到一起,形成具有四级结构 quaternary structure 的寡聚体 oligomer。
points.en: Because these activities are very close in time and space (one has just transcribed or replicated the RNA, the next immediately takes it for capping and poly(A) addition), they assemble together into an oligomer with a genuine quaternary structure.

points.zh: 寡聚 oligomer 的“寡”就是几个,一般不超过十个;中文只有“寡聚”一个词,英文分同聚 homo- 和异聚 hetero- 两个词。
points.en: Oligomer means a few subunits, generally not more than ten. Chinese has a single word, while English distinguishes homo-oligomer from hetero-oligomer.

extra.tag: 课上说法有出入 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 标准分工是:催化中心在 palm 区,两个保守的 aspartate 配位两个 Mg2+,走 two-metal-ion mechanism;fingers 区负责结合进入的 NTP/dNTP 并读取模板碱基,在每一轮催化中开合;thumb 区抓住已合成的双链产物,决定 processivity 持续合成能力。课上把 palm 和 fingers 的分工说反了。
extra.en: The standard assignment: the catalytic centre is in the palm, where two conserved aspartates coordinate two Mg2+ in the two-metal-ion mechanism; the fingers bind the incoming NTP/dNTP and read the templating base, opening and closing each cycle; the thumb grips the synthesised duplex and sets processivity. The lecture swapped palm and fingers.

extra.tag: 四级结构定义 · definition of quaternary
extra.zh: 四级结构指两条或以上独立多肽链(亚基 subunit)通过非共价作用组装成的整体。同一条链上折叠出的多个 domain,无论多少个,都仍然只是三级结构。所以“多结构域”不等于“有四级结构”,这是常考陷阱。
extra.en: Quaternary structure means two or more separate polypeptide chains (subunits) assembled non-covalently. Multiple domains folded within a single chain, however many, are still only tertiary structure. Multi-domain does not equal quaternary, and this is a favourite exam trap.

extra.tag: 冠状病毒加帽 · coronavirus capping
extra.zh: SARS-CoV-2 的加帽不是 RdRp 一个结构域完成的:nsp12 的 NiRAN 结构域负责 GTP 转移这一步,nsp14 做 N7-甲基化,nsp16(需 nsp10 辅助)做 2'-O-甲基化,nsp13 兼有 RNA 三磷酸酶活性。而冠状病毒的 poly(A) 尾是从负链的 poly(U) 模板复制出来的,并不是酶在转录后加上去的。
extra.en: SARS-CoV-2 capping is not done by one RdRp domain: the NiRAN domain of nsp12 performs the GTP transfer step, nsp14 is the N7-methyltransferase, nsp16 (with nsp10) the 2'-O-methyltransferase, and nsp13 also has RNA triphosphatase activity. The coronavirus poly(A) tail is copied from a poly(U) stretch on the negative strand, not appended enzymatically after transcription.

extra.tag: 解旋不是聚合酶 · unwinding is not the pol
extra.zh: 打开双链靠的是解旋酶 helicase(SARS-CoV-2 里是 nsp13),聚合酶本身没有解旋活性。RdRp 的核心复合物是 nsp12 + nsp7 + 两份 nsp8 的异源四聚体,本身就是 hetero-oligomer 的教科书例子。
extra.en: Unwinding the duplex is the job of a helicase (nsp13 in SARS-CoV-2); the polymerase itself has no helicase activity. The RdRp core is a heterotetramer of nsp12 + nsp7 + two copies of nsp8, a textbook hetero-oligomer.

quiz.q_zh: 某蛋白由一条多肽链折叠出 palm、fingers、thumb 三个结构域。它具有几级结构？
quiz.q_en: A protein folds a single polypeptide chain into palm, fingers and thumb domains. What is its highest level of structure?

options.zh: 三级结构，因为这几个结构域仍在同一条链上
options.en: Tertiary, because the several domains all lie on the same chain

options.zh: 四级结构，因为它含有三个独立的功能结构单位
options.en: Quaternary, because it contains three independent functional units

options.zh: 一级结构，因为整个分子只由一条多肽链构成
options.en: Primary, because the whole molecule is built from a single polypeptide chain

options.zh: 二级结构，因为三个结构域都由螺旋和折叠片构成
options.en: Secondary, because all three domains are built from helices and sheets

quiz.explain_zh: 四级结构的判据是有两条或以上独立多肽链非共价组装。一条链上折叠出多少个结构域都只是三级结构。答“四级”的人是把 domain 当成了 subunit，这正是要区分的两个概念：domain 是一条链内可独立折叠的片段，subunit 是一条独立的链。答“二级”则把组成成分当成了层级——三级结构本来就是由 helix 和 sheet 搭起来的。
quiz.explain_en: Quaternary structure requires two or more separate polypeptide chains assembled non-covalently. Any number of domains within one chain is still tertiary. Answering quaternary means confusing a domain with a subunit, which is exactly the distinction being tested: a domain is an independently folding segment of one chain, a subunit is a separate chain. Answering secondary mistakes the building blocks for the level, since a tertiary fold is of course assembled from helices and sheets.

quiz.q_zh: 在经典的“右手型”聚合酶中，催化所需的两个 Mg2+ 由哪个区域的保守天冬氨酸配位？
quiz.q_en: In a classic right-hand polymerase fold, which region provides the conserved aspartates that coordinate the two catalytic Mg2+ ions?

options.zh: thumb 拇指区
options.en: The thumb domain

options.zh: N 端延伸区
options.en: The N-terminal arm

options.zh: palm 手掌区
options.en: The palm domain

options.zh: fingers 手指区
options.en: The finger domain

quiz.explain_zh: 催化中心在 palm 区，保守 Asp 配位两个 Mg2+，即 two-metal-ion mechanism。fingers 看上去“很活跃”所以最容易被误选，但它的作用是结合进入的核苷酸并读取模板碱基、在每轮催化中开合，不提供催化残基。thumb 抱住产物双链维持持续合成，也不参与化学步骤。
quiz.explain_en: The catalytic centre sits in the palm, where conserved aspartates coordinate the two Mg2+ of the two-metal-ion mechanism. The fingers look like the active part and are the most tempting pick, but they bind the incoming nucleotide and read the templating base, opening and closing each cycle, without supplying the catalytic residues. The thumb holds the product duplex for processivity and likewise takes no part in the chemistry.

quiz.q_zh: 病毒 mRNA 需要 5' 帽子 cap 的最直接原因是什么?
quiz.q_en: What is the most direct reason a viral mRNA needs a 5' cap?

options.zh: 被起始 tRNA 识别，为翻译起始提供所需的第一个甲硫氨酸
options.en: So the initiator tRNA recognises it and supplies the first methionine for translation

options.zh: 被 RNA 聚合酶识别，从而加快整个病毒基因组的转录延伸速度
options.en: So RNA polymerase recognises it and speeds up transcription of the whole viral genome

options.zh: 被 eIF4E 识别以起始翻译，并保护 5' 端不被外切酶降解
options.en: So eIF4E recognises it to start translation and protects the 5' end from exonucleases

options.zh: 被核输入受体识别，从而把病毒 RNA 从细胞质运送进入细胞核内部
options.en: So a nuclear import receptor recognises it and carries the viral RNA into the nucleus

quiz.explain_zh: 帽子是真核翻译起始复合物的识别标志(eIF4E 结合帽子)，并阻挡 5'→3' 外切酶。选“提供第一个甲硫氨酸”是把帽子和起始密码子 AUG 所对应的 Met-tRNA 混淆了：帽子是修饰的鸟苷，不编码氨基酸。核输入受体识别的是蛋白上的 NLS，而且成熟 mRNA 的方向是出核而不是入核。
quiz.explain_en: The cap is the recognition mark for eukaryotic initiation (eIF4E binds it) and it blocks 5'-to-3' exonucleases. Choosing the initiator methionine confuses the cap with the Met-tRNA at the AUG codon: the cap is a modified guanosine and encodes no amino acid. Nuclear import receptors read protein NLS signals, and mature mRNA travels out of the nucleus, not into it.

title_zh: 多亚基聚合酶为什么难表达纯化 · cryo-EM 解析流程
title_en: Why multi-subunit polymerases are hard to produce, and the cryo-EM workflow

points.zh: 聚合酶难生产的根本原因:它不是一个单独的个体,而是很多亚基组合到一起,这意味着每个亚基单独存在时往往不稳定。
points.en: The root reason polymerases are hard to make: it is not a single entity but many subunits combined, which means each subunit on its own is often unstable.

points.zh: 亚基之间像积木、像榫卯结构一样拼插起来,拼插好以后整体才形成稳定的结构。
points.en: The subunits fit together like building blocks or mortise-and-tenon joints, and only once fitted does the whole form a stable structure.

points.zh: 第一个难点:要把不同的亚基分别表达并纯化得到。
points.en: First difficulty: each of the different subunits has to be expressed and purified.

points.zh: 第二个难点:还要在合适的条件下让它们正确组装起来,组装起来以后才能发挥生理功能。
points.en: Second difficulty: they must then be correctly assembled under suitable conditions, and only after assembly can they perform their physiological function.

points.zh: 老师以猴痘病毒 monkeypox 的聚合酶为例,他和该文章的一作聊过:这个聚合酶难就难在它组装得不完全。
points.en: The lecturer uses the monkeypox virus polymerase as the example, having spoken with the paper's first author: the hard part is that this polymerase does not assemble completely.

points.zh: 冷冻电镜 cryo-EM 的解析流程:图 A 是原始拍摄的照片 micrograph;图 B 是把照片里的颗粒 particles 抠出来做 2D classification,得到蛋白在不同角度下的样貌。
points.en: The cryo-EM workflow shown: panel A is the raw micrograph; panel B is particles picked out of the images and 2D classified, giving the appearance of the protein from different orientations.

points.zh: 然后把图 B 里所有不同角度的颗粒重新排列到一起,做三维重构 3D reconstruction。
points.en: Then all the differently oriented particles from panel B are recombined into a three-dimensional reconstruction.

points.zh: 组装不完全的后果:假如聚合酶由 A、B、C 三个组分构成,有些颗粒只是 A+B(C 没有正确贴上去),有些颗粒是 B+C。
points.en: The consequence of incomplete assembly: if the polymerase has components A, B and C, some particles are only A+B (C did not attach correctly) and others are B+C.

points.zh: 人为体外组装做不到生物体内那样精妙,体内基本能百分之百正确组装,人为组装最后总会有一点问题。
points.en: Artificial in vitro assembly cannot match the precision of the cell, which assembles essentially 100% correctly; man-made assembly always leaves some fraction wrong.

extra.tag: 单颗粒流程补全 · full SPA workflow
extra.zh: 完整的单颗粒流程是:冻样 → 采图 micrographs → 运动矫正 motion correction 与 CTF 估计 → 挑颗粒 particle picking → 2D classification(剔除冰、碎片、坏颗粒)→ 初始模型 → 3D classification(分出不同构象和不同组装状态)→ refinement → 分辨率用 gold-standard FSC = 0.143 判定。课上讲的图 A、图 B 只是其中两步。
extra.en: The full single-particle workflow is: vitrify sample, collect micrographs, motion correction and CTF estimation, particle picking, 2D classification (removing ice, debris and bad particles), initial model, 3D classification (separating conformations and assembly states), refinement, and resolution judged by the gold-standard FSC = 0.143 criterion. The lecture's panels A and B are only two of these steps.

extra.tag: 为什么用冷冻电镜 · why cryo-EM here
extra.zh: 冷冻电镜不需要结晶,而多亚基、柔性、部分组装的复合物恰恰最难长晶体。更关键的是 3D classification 能在计算上把“组装完整”和“组装不完整”的颗粒分开——晶体学做不到这一点,样品不均一时要么长不出晶体,要么只能得到一个被平均掉的模型。
extra.en: Cryo-EM needs no crystals, and multi-subunit, flexible, partly assembled complexes are precisely the ones that refuse to crystallise. More importantly, 3D classification can computationally separate fully assembled from partially assembled particles, which crystallography cannot: a heterogeneous sample either fails to crystallise or yields one averaged model.

extra.tag: 共表达是标准解法 · co-expression
extra.zh: 让多亚基复合物正确组装的常规做法不是分别纯化再混合,而是共表达 co-expression:昆虫细胞 baculovirus/Sf9 的 MultiBac 系统,或大肠杆菌的多顺反子/双质粒共转,让各亚基在同一个细胞里同时折叠、边合成边组装(co-translational assembly)。辅助手段还有共表达分子伴侣 chaperone、加可溶性融合标签、降低诱导温度。
extra.en: The standard way to get a multi-subunit complex assembled is not separate purification followed by mixing, but co-expression: MultiBac in baculovirus/Sf9 insect cells, or polycistronic and dual-plasmid systems in E. coli, so subunits fold in the same cell and assemble co-translationally. Supporting tricks include co-expressed chaperones, solubility fusion tags, and lowering the induction temperature.

extra.tag: 亚基与结构域要分清 · subunit vs domain
extra.zh: 亚基 subunit 是一条独立的多肽链;结构域 domain 是一条链内可以独立折叠的单位。课上有时把结构图上颜色不同的“一段功能”称作二级或三级结构,严格说图上每个颜色通常是一个 domain,而“几个亚基”才决定四级结构。
extra.en: A subunit is a separate polypeptide chain; a domain is an independently folding unit within a chain. The lecture sometimes calls each coloured functional stretch in the figure a secondary or tertiary structure; strictly, each colour is usually a domain, and it is the number of subunits that defines quaternary structure.

quiz.q_zh: 一个由三个不同亚基组成的复合物，在大肠杆菌里分别表达、分别纯化后再体外混合，几乎没有活性。最可能的原因是?
quiz.q_en: A three-subunit complex is expressed and purified separately in E. coli, then mixed in vitro, and shows almost no activity. What is the most likely reason?

options.zh: 各亚基单独存在时折叠不稳定，需在合成时被伙伴相互稳定
options.en: Each subunit alone is unstable or misfolded and must stabilise its partners during synthesis

options.zh: 纯化用的缓冲液 pH 偏低，酶在酸性条件下已经变性失活
options.en: The purification buffer pH was too low and the enzyme was acid-denatured before mixing

options.zh: 复合物分子量过大，在活性测定的体系里无法扩散接触底物
options.en: The complex is too large to diffuse and reach its substrate in the activity assay system

options.zh: 大肠杆菌的密码子偏好造成翻译错误，产物序列不正确
options.en: E. coli codon bias caused mistranslation, so the purified subunits all have the wrong sequence

quiz.explain_zh: 多亚基复合物常常是 co-translational assembly：亚基一边合成一边被伙伴稳定。单独纯化时暴露的界面会导致错折叠或聚集，事后混合已经来不及，解决办法是共表达。最诱人的错误是密码子偏好：它主要影响产量、偶尔造成错误掺入，但不会让三个亚基同时丧失组装能力，而且题目说三个蛋白都已经纯化出来了。
quiz.explain_en: Multi-subunit complexes often assemble co-translationally, each subunit stabilised by its partner as it is made. Purified alone, the exposed interfaces drive misfolding or aggregation, and later mixing is too late; the fix is co-expression. Codon bias is the tempting wrong answer: it mainly costs yield and occasionally misincorporates, but it would not strip all three subunits of the ability to assemble, and the question states all three proteins were obtained.

quiz.q_zh: 冷冻电镜数据处理中，2D classification 这一步的直接目的是什么?
quiz.q_en: In cryo-EM data processing, what is the direct purpose of 2D classification?

options.zh: 根据颗粒图像的投影面积计算复合物准确的分子量大小
options.en: To calculate the exact molecular weight of the complex from the projected particle area

options.zh: 从二维平均图的形状直接判断螺旋与折叠的含量比例
options.en: To judge the helix and sheet content of the sample directly from the averaged shapes

options.zh: 把所有颗粒直接重建成三维密度图，从而得到最终结构模型
options.en: To reconstruct all the collected particles directly into the final three-dimensional map

options.zh: 把同一取向的颗粒对齐平均以提高信噪比，并剔除坏颗粒
options.en: To align and average particles of one view, raising signal-to-noise and cutting debris

quiz.explain_zh: 单颗粒图像信噪比极低，2D classification 把相同取向的颗粒对齐平均，既提高信噪比又充当质量筛，冰、碎片和变性颗粒在这一步被剔除。三维密度图要等到 3D reconstruction 和 refinement 才有；分子量靠质谱或 SEC-MALS；二级结构含量是圆二色谱的活，二维平均图的轮廓并不能给出螺旋比例。
quiz.explain_en: Individual particle images have very low signal-to-noise; 2D classification aligns and averages particles of the same view, both boosting signal and acting as a quality filter that removes ice, debris and denatured particles. The 3D map only comes at reconstruction and refinement, molecular weight comes from mass spectrometry or SEC-MALS, and secondary-structure content is what circular dichroism measures — the outline of a 2D average cannot give helix percentages.

title_zh: 聚合酶活性验证、发 Science 的理由与 3D classification 判断组装
title_en: Testing polymerase activity, why the paper made Science, and 3D classification of assembly states

points.zh: 功能验证做的是延伸实验:给一个模板 template、一个引物 primer,体系里再加入四种核苷酸(课上说的 A、T、C、G)和纯化的聚合酶。
points.en: The functional test is an extension assay: a template, a primer, the four nucleotides (the lecture says A, T, C, G) and the purified polymerase are put in one reaction.

points.zh: 如果聚合酶真的有功能,它会顺着 template、从 primer 的位置往后把这条链补全。
points.en: If the polymerase is genuinely functional it will follow the template and extend from the primer to complete the strand.

points.zh: 这篇文章能发 Science 的最主要原因:在此之前没有人解析过这个病毒的 polymerase,真正的难点是没有人表达纯化出有活性的酶;他们第一个拿到有活性的纯化酶,并解析了比较完整的结构。
points.en: The main reason the paper made Science: no one had solved this virus's polymerase before, and the real bottleneck was that no one had expressed and purified an active enzyme. This group was the first to obtain active purified enzyme and to solve a relatively complete structure.

points.zh: 这篇文章其实图不多、实验也不多,工作量全在摸条件:要试不同的方法、不同的 buffer 条件,才能拿到有活性的蛋白。
points.en: The paper actually contains few figures and few experiments; the labour was all in screening conditions, trying different methods and different buffers to obtain active protein.

points.zh: 蛋白表达纯化很“玄学”,靠的是经验和不断试错。高福院士实验室会同时派三四个、四五个人做同一个没人表达过的蛋白,最后可能只有一两个经验丰富或运气好的人做出来,别人照着基本相同的方法也做不出来。
points.en: Protein expression and purification is close to alchemy, driven by experience and trial and error. Academician Gao Fu's lab may put four or five people on the same never-before-expressed protein; one or two with more experience or luck succeed, while the others fail with essentially the same protocol.

points.zh: 黄色框里是 3D classification:把拍到的所有蛋白颗粒分成四类。
points.en: The yellow box shows 3D classification: all the imaged particles sorted into four classes.

points.zh: 其中 13%(黄色)和 14%(灰色)这两类,下面的一段密度是缺失的,说明那一段没有正确组装起来,这些颗粒可能没有正确的生物学功能。
points.en: Two of them, 13% (yellow) and 14% (grey), are missing the lower portion of the density, meaning that part did not assemble correctly and these particles may lack proper biological function.

points.zh: 只有左边的紫色和青色两类下面比较清楚,只有这两类是正确的、有活性的形式。
points.en: Only the purple and cyan classes on the left have a clear lower region; only these two represent the correctly assembled, active form.

points.zh: 结论:聚合酶难就难在组分多——弄一个蛋白已经不容易,还要保证每个组分都正确折叠,并且都处在恰当的环境里形成有功能的复合物。
points.en: Conclusion: the difficulty is the number of components. One protein alone is already hard; here every component must fold correctly and all of them must sit in the right environment to form a functional complex.

extra.tag: 底物要写对 · dNTP vs NTP
extra.zh: 课上笼统说“加 ATCG”。DNA 聚合酶(痘病毒是 DNA 病毒,用的是 DNA polymerase)底物是 dNTP:dATP、dTTP、dGTP、dCTP;而 RNA 病毒的 RdRp 底物是 NTP:ATP、UTP、GTP、CTP,产物里是 U 不是 T。答题写底物一定要区分。
extra.en: The lecture loosely says add A, T, C, G. A DNA polymerase (poxviruses are DNA viruses) uses dNTPs: dATP, dTTP, dGTP, dCTP. An RNA virus RdRp uses NTPs: ATP, UTP, GTP, CTP, and the product contains U, not T. Always distinguish the two in an exam answer.

extra.tag: 延伸实验的隐含条件 · assay requirements
extra.zh: primer extension 还必须满足:引物有游离的 3'-OH(链只能 5'→3' 延伸)、体系里有二价金属离子 Mg2+(two-metal-ion 催化)、有检测手段(引物 5' 端荧光或 32P 标记),产物在变性 PAGE 上按长度分辨。必需对照是不加酶、以及加催化位点突变体(保守 Asp 突成 Ala),用来排除样品里污染的宿主聚合酶。
extra.en: A primer extension assay also requires a free 3'-OH on the primer (chains only grow 5' to 3'), divalent Mg2+ for two-metal-ion catalysis, and a readout (fluorescent or 32P label on the primer's 5' end), with products resolved by length on denaturing PAGE. Essential controls are no-enzyme and a catalytic-site mutant (conserved Asp to Ala), which rule out a contaminating host polymerase.

extra.tag: 百分比的含义 · what the percentages mean
extra.zh: 3D classification 里的 13%、14% 是颗粒数的占比,反映样品中该组装状态/构象的比例,既不是分辨率也不是活性比例。而且冰层厚度、取向偏好 preferred orientation、挑颗粒的偏差都会影响这些数字,所以它只能作为定性证据,不能当作严格的定量。
extra.en: The 13% and 14% in 3D classification are fractions of the particle count, reflecting how many particles are in that assembly state or conformation. They are neither a resolution nor a fraction of activity, and ice thickness, preferred orientation and picking bias all skew them, so they are qualitative evidence rather than a strict quantification.

extra.tag: 密度缺失不等于蛋白缺失 · missing density
extra.zh: 冷冻电镜图上“下面一段看不见”有两种可能:这个亚基/结构域真的没有组装上去,或者它组装上了但高度柔性,在多颗粒平均时被抹平。两者在图上长得一样,要靠交联质谱 XL-MS、SDS-PAGE 组分分析或生化实验区分,不能只凭密度下结论。
extra.en: Missing density at the bottom of a cryo-EM map has two possible causes: the subunit or domain genuinely failed to assemble, or it assembled but is so flexible that averaging washes it out. They look identical in the map; crosslinking mass spectrometry, SDS-PAGE of the sample, or biochemistry are needed to tell them apart, and density alone cannot decide.

quiz.q_zh: 体外聚合反应里含有模板、引物、四种核苷酸和纯化的聚合酶。下列哪一项若缺失，反应一定不能进行?
quiz.q_en: An in vitro polymerisation reaction contains template, primer, the four nucleotides and purified polymerase. Which missing component would definitely abolish the reaction?

options.zh: 引物 5' 末端上携带的游离磷酸基团
options.en: The free phosphate group carried on the primer 5' end

options.zh: 用于维持巯基还原状态的还原剂 DTT
options.en: The reducing agent DTT that keeps thiols reduced

options.zh: 用于封闭管壁吸附位点的牛血清白蛋白 BSA
options.en: Bovine serum albumin used to block tube-wall adsorption

options.zh: 作为辅因子的 Mg2+ 等二价金属离子
options.en: Divalent metal ions such as Mg2+ acting as cofactor

quiz.explain_zh: 聚合酶用 two-metal-ion mechanism，两个 Mg2+ 分别活化引物 3'-OH 并稳定离去的焦磷酸，没有二价金属离子催化根本不发生。选“5' 磷酸”是常见混淆：延伸需要的是游离的 3'-OH，5' 磷酸只在连接酶 ligase 封口时才是必需的。DTT 和 BSA 是稳定性/防吸附的辅助成分，缺了可能降低效率，但不是催化必需。
quiz.explain_en: Polymerases use the two-metal-ion mechanism: one Mg2+ activates the primer 3'-OH, the other stabilises the leaving pyrophosphate, so without divalent metal nothing happens. The 5' phosphate is the classic confusion: extension needs a free 3'-OH, while a 5' phosphate is only required for ligase to seal a nick. DTT and BSA are stabilising and anti-adsorption additives whose absence may cost efficiency but is not catalytically fatal.

quiz.q_zh: 3D classification 显示 13% 和 14% 的颗粒下半部分密度缺失。最恰当的解读是?
quiz.q_en: 3D classification shows that 13% and 14% of particles are missing the lower half of the density. What is the most appropriate interpretation?

options.zh: 这些颗粒中的该部分已被蛋白酶降解成小片段并从复合物脱落
options.en: The protein in those particles was cut into small fragments by proteases and lost

options.zh: 该部分亚基未组装上去，或已组装但高度柔性而被平均掉
options.en: That subunit failed to assemble, or assembled but is so flexible it averages out

options.zh: 说明整体结构的分辨率只有 13-14 埃，需要重新采数据
