options.en: It means the resolution of the whole reconstruction is only 13 to 14 angstrom

options.zh: 说明样品纯度只有 73%，其余 27% 是杂质蛋白
options.en: It means the sample is only 73% pure and the rest is contaminating protein

quiz.explain_zh: 密度缺失反映的是该区域在颗粒平均中没有一致的信号，原因可以是没组装上，也可以是柔性摆动被平均掉。选“分辨率 13-14 埃”是把颗粒占比误读成分辨率——百分比来自颗粒计数，与分辨率无关，分辨率是用 FSC 曲线判定的。蛋白酶降解会在 SDS-PAGE 上直接看到，也无法解释同一区域整体缺失而其余部分完好。
quiz.explain_en: Missing density means that region gives no consistent signal on averaging, which can result from failed assembly or from flexibility. Reading 13-14% as 13-14 angstrom resolution confuses a particle count with resolution; the percentages come from particle numbers, while resolution is judged from the FSC curve. Proteolysis would show up directly on SDS-PAGE and would not explain one whole region vanishing while the rest stays intact.

quiz.q_zh: 按照课上的说法，这项工作能发 Science 最核心的理由是什么?
quiz.q_en: According to the lecture, what was the core reason this work made Science?

options.zh: 首次从临床样本中分离、鉴定并命名了这种新的病毒
options.en: It was the first to isolate and name this new virus from clinical samples

options.zh: 其冷冻电镜的分辨率打破了当时冷冻电镜的世界纪录
options.en: Its cryo-EM resolution broke the world record for a structure of this kind

options.zh: 文章综合使用了非常多种类的实验方法，总工作量极大
options.en: It combined an unusually wide range of experimental methods in a single paper

options.zh: 首次拿到有活性的纯化酶，并解析其复合物结构
options.en: It was first to obtain the active purified enzyme and solve its structure

quiz.explain_zh: 老师强调这篇文章图不多、实验不多，价值在于“第一个做出来”：别人卡在拿不到有活性的蛋白，他们摸出了条件并给出结构。选“方法多、工作量大”恰好和事实相反，这正是老师用来说明重要性不等于工作量的例子；分辨率也不是卖点，该结构的分辨率在当时属于常规水平。
quiz.explain_en: The lecturer stresses that the paper has few figures and few experiments; its value is being first. Others were stuck at obtaining active protein, and this group found the conditions and delivered the structure. The many-methods option is precisely the opposite of the facts, which is the lecturer's point that importance is not the same as volume of work; resolution was not the selling point either, being ordinary for its time.

title_zh: 蛋白质高级结构的测定:分辨率极限、X 射线、核磁共振、圆二色谱
title_en: Determining higher-order protein structure: resolution limits, X-ray, NMR and circular dichroism

points.zh: 老师说明这里列的是比较古早的、书上的方法。
points.en: The lecturer notes that the methods listed here are the older, textbook ones.

points.zh: 常规光学显微镜的分辨率一般只能看到 0.2 微米以上的东西,因为可见光的波长决定了能达到的分辨率,而可见光波长比较大。低于 0.2 微米的小分子就看不见了。
points.en: An ordinary light microscope can generally only resolve objects above 0.2 micrometre, because the wavelength of visible light sets the achievable resolution and visible wavelengths are relatively long. Molecules smaller than 0.2 micrometre are invisible to it.

points.zh: 解决办法是改用波长更短的 X 射线衍射 X-ray diffraction,波长更短理论上就能分辨更小的物体。
points.en: The solution is X-ray diffraction, whose shorter wavelength should in principle resolve smaller objects.

points.zh: X 射线的 lambda 基本在 0.01 到 10 纳米之间,所以分辨率也可以达到这个级别。
points.en: The lambda of X-rays lies roughly between 0.01 and 10 nanometres, so resolutions of that order become possible.

points.zh: 0.01 纳米就是 0.1 埃 angstrom;一个氢原子大约零点几埃,所以理论上到 0.1 埃时可以看到氢原子。X 射线是目前分辨率比较高的一种方法。
points.en: 0.01 nanometre is 0.1 angstrom; a hydrogen atom is a few tenths of an angstrom, so at 0.1 angstrom hydrogen atoms would in principle be visible. X-ray remains one of the higher-resolution methods.

points.zh: 另一种解析高级结构的方法是核磁共振法 NMR,主要用于在溶液中测定比较小的肽的结构,好处是可以直接在溶液里测。
points.en: Another method for higher-order structure is NMR, used mainly to determine the structure of relatively small peptides in solution, with the advantage of working directly in solution.

points.zh: NMR 的缺点是只能测分子量比较小的肽:它检测的是氢原子和碳原子的信号,蛋白一旦太大,氢和碳的信号太多就很难分析;而且方法本身比较难,所以用得比较少,但在小肽里还是会用。
points.en: The drawback of NMR is the molecular weight limit: it detects hydrogen and carbon signals, and once the protein is large there are too many of them to analyse. The technique is also demanding, so it is used less often, though still for small peptides.

points.zh: 再往后是一些测不了三维结构、但能大概知道组成的方法,比如紫外 UV 和荧光 fluorescence。
points.en: Beyond these come methods that cannot give a three-dimensional structure but do report roughly on composition, such as UV and fluorescence.

points.zh: 圆二色谱 circular dichroism(CD)基本也基于 UV 和荧光的原理,它可以测出一个蛋白里 alpha helix 和 beta sheet 各占百分之多少,所以在一定程度上也算是提供三维结构信息。
points.en: Circular dichroism is based on the same UV and fluorescence principles and can measure what percentage of a protein is alpha helix and what percentage is beta sheet, so to some degree it also reports on three-dimensional structure.

extra.tag: 分辨率极限公式 · Abbe limit
extra.zh: 0.2 微米不是仪器做工不够,而是衍射决定的物理极限:Abbe 判据 d = lambda / (2 x NA)。可见光 lambda 约 400-700 nm,油镜数值孔径 NA 约 1.4,代入正好得到 d 约 200 nm。超分辨显微镜 STED / PALM / STORM 是靠荧光分子的开关和定位绕过这个极限,而不是靠更短的波长。
extra.en: The 0.2 micrometre limit is not poor engineering but diffraction physics: the Abbe criterion d = lambda / (2 x NA). With visible light at 400-700 nm and an oil objective of NA about 1.4, d works out to about 200 nm. Super-resolution methods (STED, PALM, STORM) get past it by switching and localising fluorophores, not by using shorter wavelengths.

extra.tag: 埃与实际分辨率 · real-world resolution
extra.zh: 1 埃 = 0.1 纳米。实际的蛋白晶体结构常见分辨率是 1.5-3 埃;要真正看到氢原子需要优于约 1.0 埃的“原子分辨率”,现实中很少见,常规结构里的氢原子是按几何关系计算加上去的,不是看到的。另外,X 射线源常用波长约 1.0-1.54 埃(Cu K-alpha 1.54 埃),但结构分辨率取决于衍射数据的质量和晶体的有序程度,并不等于光源波长。
extra.en: One angstrom is 0.1 nanometre. Real protein crystal structures are typically 1.5-3 angstrom; seeing actual hydrogen atoms needs atomic resolution better than about 1.0 angstrom, which is rare, and hydrogens in routine structures are added by geometry rather than observed. Also, X-ray sources typically use about 1.0-1.54 angstrom (Cu K-alpha at 1.54), but the structural resolution depends on data quality and crystal order, not on the source wavelength.

extra.tag: 圆二色谱只给二级结构 · CD is not a 3D method
extra.zh: CD 只给二级结构的含量比例,不给任何原子坐标,也不告诉你哪一段是螺旋。远紫外区 190-250 nm 反映主链构象:alpha helix 在 208 nm 和 222 nm 有双负峰,beta sheet 在约 218 nm 有单负峰,无规卷曲在约 195 nm 有负峰。近紫外区 250-320 nm 反映芳香族侧链所处环境,可用来判断三级结构是否折叠好。所以课上“UV/荧光也可以测定三维结构”这句讲得偏松。
extra.en: CD gives only the proportions of secondary structure, no atomic coordinates and no information about which segment is helical. The far-UV region 190-250 nm reports backbone conformation: alpha helix has twin minima at 208 and 222 nm, beta sheet a single minimum near 218 nm, random coil a minimum near 195 nm. The near-UV region 250-320 nm reports the environment of aromatic side chains and indicates whether tertiary structure is folded. The lecture's claim that UV and fluorescence can determine three-dimensional structure is therefore loose.

extra.tag: 今天实际用什么 · what is used today
extra.zh: 这份清单确实偏古早。今天大复合物和膜蛋白基本靠冷冻电镜 cryo-EM,不需要结晶,常规能到 2-3 埃;溶液 NMR 的实用分子量上限大约 30-40 kDa(用氘代标记和 TROSY 技术可以推得更高),它独有的价值是给出构象系综和动力学信息,这是晶体学看不到的。AlphaFold 等预测能给模型,但预测不能替代实验测定。
extra.en: The list is genuinely dated. Today large complexes and membrane proteins go to cryo-EM, which needs no crystals and routinely reaches 2-3 angstrom. Solution NMR has a practical limit around 30-40 kDa (extendable with deuteration and TROSY), and its unique value is conformational ensembles and dynamics, which crystallography cannot see. AlphaFold and similar tools give models, but prediction does not replace experimental determination.

quiz.q_zh: 为什么普通可见光显微镜看不到单个蛋白质分子?
quiz.q_en: Why can an ordinary visible-light microscope not see a single protein molecule?

options.zh: 单个蛋白质在溶液中的布朗运动过快，在整个曝光时间内被完全抹平
options.en: Brownian motion in solution is so fast that a protein is smeared out during the exposure

options.zh: 蛋白质本身透明无色，在普通可见光下缺乏任何足以成像的光学反差
options.en: Proteins are transparent and colourless, giving too little contrast under visible light

options.zh: 受衍射极限限制，可见光分辨率约 200 nm，蛋白仅几纳米
options.en: The diffraction limit caps visible-light resolution near 200 nm, while a protein is a few nm

options.zh: 蛋白质在强光照射下会迅速漂白，成像完成前就全部失去了信号
options.en: Proteins are bleached so fast by strong illumination that all the signal is gone before imaging

quiz.explain_zh: 这是波动光学的硬性限制：d = lambda/(2NA)，可见光下约 200 nm，而一个球状蛋白直径只有几纳米，差了将近两个数量级。透明缺反差可以用染色或相差解决，布朗运动可以用固定或短曝光解决，漂白说的是荧光团而不是蛋白本身——三者都是可以规避的技术问题，只有衍射极限是原理性的。
quiz.explain_en: This is a hard limit of wave optics: d = lambda/(2NA), about 200 nm for visible light, while a globular protein is only a few nanometres, nearly two orders of magnitude smaller. Lack of contrast can be handled by staining or phase contrast, Brownian motion by fixation or short exposures, and bleaching concerns fluorophores rather than the protein itself. All three are technical problems that can be worked around; only the diffraction limit is fundamental.

quiz.q_zh: 手上有一个 60 kDa 的纯化蛋白，只想快速知道它 alpha helix 的大致含量。最合适的方法是?
quiz.q_en: You have a purified 60 kDa protein and simply want a quick estimate of its alpha-helix content. Which method fits best?

options.zh: X 射线单晶衍射法
options.en: X-ray crystallography

options.zh: 稳态荧光偏振测定
options.en: Fluorescence polarisation

options.zh: 溶液核磁共振 NMR 谱
options.en: Solution NMR spectroscopy

options.zh: 远紫外圆二色谱 CD
options.en: Far-UV circular dichroism

quiz.explain_zh: 远紫外 CD 几分钟、微克级样品就能给出二级结构含量比例，正是为这个问题设计的。60 kDa 已经超出常规溶液 NMR 的舒适区，而且解谱要花数周；X 射线要先长晶体，周期以月计，而且题目只要“大致含量”，用它属于杀鸡用牛刀；荧光偏振测的是分子转动/结合，不给二级结构。
quiz.explain_en: Far-UV CD gives secondary-structure proportions in minutes from microgram amounts and is designed for exactly this question. 60 kDa is beyond the comfortable range of routine solution NMR and assignment takes weeks; X-ray requires crystals and months of work, which is overkill for a rough percentage; fluorescence polarisation reports tumbling and binding, not secondary structure.

quiz.q_zh: 关于用核磁共振测定蛋白结构，下列说法正确的是?
quiz.q_en: Which statement about determining protein structure by NMR is correct?

options.zh: 在溶液中进行，可给出构象系综与动力学，但受分子量限制
options.en: Done in solution, it reports conformational ensembles and dynamics, but is size-limited

options.zh: 分辨率高于 X 射线衍射，可以直接观察到原子外的电子云
options.en: Its resolution beats X-ray diffraction and it images the electron clouds directly

options.zh: 它主要检测样品中磷原子的核自旋信号，因此需磷标记
options.en: It mainly detects nuclear spins of phosphorus, so the sample must be phosphorus-labelled

options.zh: 只能用于固体粉末或晶体样品，不能测定溶液中的蛋白
options.en: It works only on solid powders or crystals and cannot study proteins in solution

quiz.explain_zh: 溶液 NMR 的核心优势就是在近生理的溶液条件下测，并且能看到晶体学看不到的运动和多构象，代价是分子量一大信号就重叠、弛豫变快。选“分辨率高于 X 射线、能看电子云”是把两种原理混了：能看到电子密度的是 X 射线衍射。固体 NMR 确实存在，但它是溶液 NMR 之外的另一种技术，并非 NMR 只能测固体；蛋白 NMR 检测的是 1H、13C、15N 等核自旋而不是磷。
quiz.explain_en: The core advantage of solution NMR is working under near-physiological solution conditions and revealing motions and multiple conformations that crystallography averages away, at the cost of crowding and fast relaxation as size grows. The option about exceeding X-ray and imaging electron clouds mixes up the principles: electron density comes from X-ray diffraction. Solid-state NMR does exist, but as a separate technique rather than a restriction on NMR, and protein NMR detects nuclear spins such as 1H, 13C and 15N, not phosphorus.

title_zh: 维持三维结构的非共价作用力与二硫键
title_en: Non-covalent forces that maintain three-dimensional structure, and the disulfide bond

points.zh: 维持蛋白三维结构的主要是弱相互作用 weak interactions,也就是非共价力;共价力才算强相互作用,除共价键以外的作用都归到弱相互作用。
points.en: Three-dimensional protein structure is held together mainly by weak interactions, that is non-covalent forces; covalent bonds count as strong interactions, and everything other than covalent bonds is grouped as weak.

points.zh: 第一条是盐键 salt bridge,我们通常叫离子键 ionic bond 或盐桥:单个盐桥的能量是比较高的。
points.en: First on the list is the salt bridge, usually called an ionic bond or salt bridge: the energy of a single salt bridge is relatively high.

points.zh: 氢键 hydrogen bond 是主要的作用力,原因是数量多:它的能量量级比盐桥低一个数量级(大约十倍),但数量可能是离子键的一千倍、一万倍,所以总体上对维持三级结构贡献很大。
points.en: Hydrogen bonds are the main force, because of their number: each is about an order of magnitude (roughly tenfold) weaker than a salt bridge, but there may be a thousand or ten thousand times more of them, so overall they contribute a great deal to maintaining tertiary structure.

points.zh: 疏水作用 hydrophobic effect 不是一个明确的“键”,但它是一个广泛存在的作用力;范德华力 van der Waals 排在最后,基本上不会太考虑。
points.en: The hydrophobic effect is not a definite bond but a broadly present force; van der Waals forces come last and are generally not given much weight.

points.zh: 二硫键 disulfide bond:老师给的应试答案是它主要影响蛋白质的一级和三级结构。
points.en: Disulfide bond: the exam answer the lecturer gives is that it mainly affects the primary and tertiary levels of protein structure.

points.zh: 为什么不影响二级结构?因为二级结构就是 alpha helix、beta sheet 和无规卷曲那几种,基本不涉及二硫键;涉及二硫键的一般是三级结构。
points.en: Why not secondary structure? Because secondary structure is just alpha helix, beta sheet and random coil, which essentially never involve disulfides; disulfides normally appear at the tertiary level.

points.zh: 为什么算到一级结构?因为二硫键形成的是共价键,某种程度上也参与决定这个蛋白氨基酸的连接和排列。
points.en: Why is it counted at the primary level? Because a disulfide is a covalent bond and to some degree participates in defining how the amino acids of the protein are linked and arranged.

points.zh: 盐桥最重要的特点:必须发生在一个带正电荷的原子和一个带负电荷的原子之间。生物化学里一般是氧带负电、氮带正电,盐桥就在这两类原子之间形成。
points.en: The most important feature of a salt bridge: it must form between one positively charged atom and one negatively charged atom. In biochemistry, oxygen typically carries the negative charge and nitrogen the positive, and the salt bridge forms between these.

points.zh: 盐桥没有方向性,两个原子只要靠近到大约 4 到 5 埃之内(老师强调这个数字不一定精确,大概是这个数量级),一般就认为可以形成离子相互作用。
points.en: A salt bridge has no directionality: as long as the two atoms come within roughly 4 to 5 angstrom (the lecturer stresses the figure is approximate, an order-of-magnitude statement), an ionic interaction is generally considered to form.

extra.tag: 能量数量级 · bond energy scale
extra.zh: 记住量级:共价键约 200-450 kJ/mol(C-C 约 348,S-S 约 250);氢键约 4-20 kJ/mol;范德华约 0.4-4 kJ/mol。离子对在真空中能量极大,但在水里介电常数约 80 会强烈屏蔽,加上形成盐桥要先脱去水化壳,一个暴露在蛋白表面的盐桥净贡献常常只有几 kJ/mol,有时甚至不稳定;埋在疏水核心里(局部低介电)的盐桥才明显更强。所以“盐桥一定比氢键强十倍”要看它在哪儿。另外方向性也要分清:纯静电作用确实无方向性(课上这句物理上成立),但结构生物学定义的盐桥几乎总是同时满足氢键几何,常用判据是带电的 N 与 O 原子间距小于等于 4 埃;真正强方向性的是氢键,D-H...A 越接近 180 度越强。
extra.en: Orders of magnitude worth memorising: covalent bonds 200-450 kJ/mol (C-C about 348, S-S about 250); hydrogen bonds 4-20 kJ/mol; van der Waals 0.4-4 kJ/mol. An ion pair is enormously strong in vacuum, but water's dielectric constant of about 80 screens it heavily and forming the bridge costs desolvation, so a surface-exposed salt bridge often nets only a few kJ/mol and can even be destabilising. Buried salt bridges in the low-dielectric core are much stronger. So whether a salt bridge is ten times a hydrogen bond depends on where it sits. Directionality also needs care: pure electrostatics really is non-directional (the lecture is physically right), but a salt bridge as defined in structural biology almost always also satisfies hydrogen-bond geometry, the usual criterion being a charged N to O distance of 4 angstrom or less; the strongly directional interaction is the hydrogen bond, strongest as D-H...A approaches 180 degrees.

extra.tag: 折叠的主要驱动力 · main driving force
extra.zh: 考试问“对球状蛋白折叠贡献最大的作用力”,标准答案是疏水作用 hydrophobic effect,不是氢键。机制是熵:非极性侧链暴露在水中会迫使周围水分子排成有序的笼状结构,把它们埋进核心可以释放这些水,溶剂熵增(delta S > 0)驱动 delta G < 0。氢键虽然数量多,但折叠时形成的链内氢键要以打断原来与水的氢键为代价,净收益有限——这正是课上按“数量多”排序时没有说透的地方。
extra.en: When an exam asks which force contributes most to folding a globular protein, the standard answer is the hydrophobic effect, not hydrogen bonding. The mechanism is entropic: non-polar side chains exposed to water force the surrounding water into ordered cage-like arrangements, and burying them in the core releases that water, so solvent entropy rises and drives delta G negative. Hydrogen bonds are numerous, but each intramolecular one formed on folding costs a hydrogen bond to water, so the net gain is small. This is what the lecture's numbers-based ranking leaves out.

extra.tag: 二硫键在哪里形成 · where S-S forms
extra.zh: 二硫键由两个半胱氨酸 cysteine 的巯基 -SH 氧化生成,需要氧化环境:真核在内质网 ER 由 PDI(蛋白二硫键异构酶)催化,原核在周质 periplasm 由 Dsb 系统催化。细胞质是还原环境(谷胱甘肽 GSH),所以胞质蛋白几乎没有二硫键——这也是分泌型蛋白在大肠杆菌胞质中表达常常形成包涵体的原因。链间二硫键(如抗体的重链-轻链、重链-重链)则稳定四级结构。
extra.en: Disulfides form by oxidation of two cysteine thiols and require an oxidising environment: the endoplasmic reticulum with PDI in eukaryotes, the periplasm with the Dsb system in bacteria. The cytoplasm is reducing (glutathione), so cytoplasmic proteins have essentially no disulfides, which is why secreted proteins expressed in the E. coli cytoplasm so often end up in inclusion bodies. Interchain disulfides, such as antibody heavy-light and heavy-heavy links, stabilise quaternary structure.

extra.tag: 一级结构是约定 · a convention, not a rearrangement
extra.zh: 把二硫键算进一级结构是教科书的定义约定:一级结构 = 氨基酸序列 + 二硫键的位置。它并不改变氨基酸的先后顺序,课上“改变了氨基酸的排列顺序”这个理由不准确。另外要注意国内外教材不一致:很多英文教材只把序列算作一级结构,而把二硫键的贡献归到三级/四级。答中文题按中文教材写“一、三级”,答英文题要写清楚是链内还是链间。
extra.en: Counting the disulfide as part of primary structure is a textbook convention: primary structure equals the amino acid sequence plus the positions of the disulfide bonds. It does not change the order of the residues, so the lecture's reasoning that it rearranges the sequence is inaccurate. Note also that textbooks differ: many English texts restrict primary structure to the sequence and assign disulfide effects to tertiary or quaternary structure. Answer Chinese exams with primary and tertiary, and in English specify intrachain versus interchain.

quiz.q_zh: 对球状蛋白折叠贡献最大的作用力是?
quiz.q_en: Which force contributes most to the folding of a globular protein?

options.zh: 疏水作用
options.en: Hydrophobic effect

options.zh: 二硫键
options.en: Disulfide bonds

options.zh: 范德华力
options.en: Van der Waals forces

options.zh: 氢键作用
options.en: Hydrogen bonding

quiz.explain_zh: 疏水作用是熵驱动的：埋藏非极性侧链释放了原来包裹它们的有序水分子，溶剂熵增足以补偿链构象熵的损失。选氢键是最有诱惑力的错误——氢键数量确实最多，但折叠时每形成一个链内氢键，就要打断一个与水的氢键，净贡献远小于总量看上去的规模。二硫键多数是折叠完成后的“锁定”，不是驱动力；范德华力只在已经贴紧的核心内部起补充作用。
quiz.explain_en: The hydrophobic effect is entropy-driven: burying non-polar side chains releases the ordered water that caged them, and the gain in solvent entropy outweighs the loss of chain conformational entropy. Hydrogen bonding is the tempting wrong answer, since hydrogen bonds are indeed the most numerous, but each intramolecular one formed on folding breaks one to water, so the net contribution is far smaller than the raw count suggests. Disulfides mostly lock in an already folded structure rather than drive folding, and van der Waals forces only top up packing in an already collapsed core.

quiz.q_zh: 关于氢键与盐桥的比较，下列说法正确的是?
quiz.q_en: Which comparison of hydrogen bonds and salt bridges is correct?

options.zh: 盐桥具有严格的方向性，而氢键的强度与几何角度完全无关
options.en: Salt bridges are strictly directional, while hydrogen bond strength is angle-independent

options.zh: 两者本质上都属于共价键，区别只在于键能大小的不同而已
options.en: Both are fundamentally covalent bonds and differ only in the magnitude of their bond energy

options.zh: 单个氢键的强度明显大于单个盐桥，因此氢键的总贡献更大
options.en: A single hydrogen bond is stronger than a single salt bridge, so it contributes more overall

options.zh: 单个氢键弱但数量远多故总贡献大，盐桥在水中被屏蔽削弱
options.en: Hydrogen bonds are weak but numerous so their total wins, while water screens salt bridges

quiz.explain_zh: 这正是课上“单个更弱、但数量取胜”的意思，再补上水环境对盐桥的削弱：高介电常数的水屏蔽静电，形成盐桥还要先付脱水化的代价。选“盐桥有方向性、氢键没有”正好把两者说反了：静电作用本身无方向性，而氢键的强度强烈依赖 D-H...A 的角度。两者都是非共价作用，不是共价键。
quiz.explain_en: This is exactly the lecture's point that each is weaker but numbers win, with the added fact that water weakens salt bridges: its high dielectric constant screens the charges and forming the pair costs a desolvation penalty first. The option that salt bridges are directional and hydrogen bonds are not has it backwards: electrostatics itself is non-directional, whereas hydrogen-bond strength depends strongly on the D-H...A angle. Both are non-covalent, not covalent.

quiz.q_zh: 一个含 4 对二硫键的分泌型蛋白，在大肠杆菌细胞质中高表达却全部进入包涵体、没有活性。最可能的原因是?
quiz.q_en: A secreted protein with four disulfide bonds is highly expressed in the E. coli cytoplasm but goes entirely into inclusion bodies with no activity. What is the most likely reason?

options.zh: 该基因含大量大肠杆菌稀有密码子，翻译中途频繁停滞
options.en: The gene has many rare E. coli codons, so translation stalls repeatedly all along the message

options.zh: 细胞质是还原环境，二硫键无法形成，蛋白错折叠并聚集
options.en: The cytoplasm is reducing, so disulfides cannot form and the protein misfolds and aggregates

options.zh: 大肠杆菌核糖体不识别真核 mRNA，产物为截短的多肽
options.en: E. coli ribosomes do not recognise eukaryotic mRNA, so the products are truncated peptides

options.zh: 蛋白分子量过大，超出大肠杆菌核糖体的合成能力上限
options.en: The protein is too large, beyond what E. coli ribosomes are able to synthesise at all

quiz.explain_zh: 大肠杆菌胞质由硫氧还蛋白和谷胱甘肽系统维持还原状态，巯基无法氧化成二硫键，富含二硫键的分泌蛋白因此错折叠聚集。常规解法是分泌到周质、用 SHuffle/Origami 这类氧化型胞质菌株，或包涵体变性后体外复性。选“稀有密码子”不成立：题目说的是高表达，翻译停滞会直接压低产量而不是让高产的蛋白全进包涵体。核糖体识别的是原核 SD 序列，用的是重组表达载体，这一条与真核 mRNA 无关。
quiz.explain_en: The E. coli cytoplasm is kept reduced by the thioredoxin and glutathione systems, so thiols cannot be oxidised to disulfides and disulfide-rich secreted proteins misfold and aggregate. The usual fixes are periplasmic secretion, oxidising cytoplasm strains such as SHuffle or Origami, or refolding from inclusion bodies. Rare codons do not fit: the question states expression was high, and stalling would cut yield rather than send an abundant product into inclusion bodies. The ribosome reads a prokaryotic SD sequence on the expression vector, so eukaryotic mRNA recognition is not at issue.

title_zh: 肽键平面、φ/ψ 二面角与拉氏图
title_en: The planar peptide bond, the phi/psi dihedral angles and the Ramachandran plot

points.zh: 三级结构里有一条重要限制:多肽主链的折叠在空间上是有一定限制的,不能任意扭。
points.en: A key constraint at the tertiary level: folding of the polypeptide main chain is spatially restricted and cannot twist arbitrarily.

points.zh: 肽键 peptide bond 一般处在一个平面上;但肽键以外的那些键并不一定在这个平面里,它们可以转动。
points.en: The peptide bond itself lies in a plane; the bonds outside the peptide bond are not confined to that plane and can rotate.

points.zh: 这就导致存在二面角 dihedral angle,两个角分别用希腊字母 phi(φ)和 psi(ψ)表示。
points.en: This gives rise to dihedral angles, the two of them denoted by the Greek letters phi and psi.

points.zh: 老师说不必死记这两个符号具体指主链上哪个位置的二面角,只需要知道它们是肽键以外、氨基酸主链上的二面角。
points.en: The lecturer says you need not memorise exactly which main-chain position each symbol refers to, only that they are the dihedral angles on the amino acid main chain outside the peptide bond.

points.zh: 比较早的时候人们对 phi 角和 psi 角的空间取向做了很精细的测定,发现它们必须符合拉氏图(拉曼图)Ramachandran plot。
points.en: Long ago these two angles were measured in fine detail and found to have to conform to the Ramachandran plot.

points.zh: 拉氏图的坐标:纵坐标是 psi 角,横坐标是 phi 角;蛋白主链上所有残基的 psi 和 phi 都必须落在一定的范围内。
points.en: Axes of the plot: psi on the vertical axis, phi on the horizontal; every residue's psi and phi on the protein main chain must fall within certain regions.

points.zh: 图上有淡色区和红色区:淡色代表这个二面角在特殊情况下可以扭转到的位置(allowed);红色代表比较 favorable 的区域,二面角落在红色区时能量比较低。
points.en: The plot has pale and red regions: pale marks positions the dihedral can twist into under special circumstances (allowed), while red marks the favourable region where the dihedral has low energy.

points.zh: 背后的道理:每个原子的运动最后都趋向维持能量最低的构型;如果一个构象能量高,就需要额外做功、额外的能量去维持它,自然界不倾向于这样,所以体系会自发转换到能量比较低的位置。
points.en: The underlying reason: the motion of every atom tends toward the lowest-energy conformation; a high-energy conformation requires extra work and extra energy to maintain, which nature does not favour, so the system converts spontaneously to a lower-energy position.

extra.tag: 肽键为什么是平面 · why the peptide bond is planar
extra.zh: 因为 C-N 之间存在共振,带有约 40% 的双键性质:键长比正常 C-N 单键短、比 C=N 长,不能自由旋转。结果 Calpha、C、O、N、H、下一个 Calpha 这六个原子共面。这个转角叫 omega,通常约等于 180 度(trans)。所以每个残基的主链只剩两个自由度:phi 是绕 N-Calpha 的旋转,psi 是绕 Calpha-C 的旋转。
extra.en: Resonance gives the C-N bond about 40% double-bond character: it is shorter than a normal C-N single bond and longer than C=N, and it cannot rotate freely. As a result six atoms are coplanar: the two flanking C-alphas plus C, O, N and H. That torsion is called omega and is normally about 180 degrees (trans). Each residue therefore has only two main-chain degrees of freedom: phi, rotation about N-C-alpha, and psi, rotation about C-alpha-C.

extra.tag: 记住三个坐标 · landmark phi/psi values
extra.zh: 考试常给一组 (phi, psi) 让你判断二级结构,记住三个地标:右手 alpha helix 约 (-57, -47),在图的左下象限;反平行 beta sheet 约 (-139, +135),在左上象限;左手 alpha helix 约 (+57, +47),在右上的小岛,几乎只有甘氨酸能占据。
extra.en: Exams often give a (phi, psi) pair and ask which secondary structure it is. Memorise three landmarks: right-handed alpha helix at about (-57, -47), lower-left quadrant; antiparallel beta sheet at about (-139, +135), upper-left quadrant; left-handed alpha helix at about (+57, +47), the small upper-right island, occupied almost exclusively by glycine.

extra.tag: 两个特殊残基 · glycine and proline
extra.zh: 甘氨酸 Gly 的侧链只是一个氢,空间位阻最小,允许区大得多,可以出现在别的残基进不去的区域——所以结构验证时通常把 Gly 单独画一张拉氏图。脯氨酸 Pro 的侧链环回到主链氮上,phi 被锁定在约 -60 度正负 25 度,自由度大幅受限,是典型的螺旋终止子 helix breaker,常出现在转角处。
extra.en: Glycine's side chain is a single hydrogen, so steric hindrance is minimal, its allowed region is much larger, and it can occupy areas forbidden to other residues, which is why validation software plots glycine on its own Ramachandran diagram. Proline's side chain loops back onto the backbone nitrogen, locking phi near -60 plus or minus 25 degrees, severely restricting its freedom and making it a classic helix breaker often found at turns.

extra.tag: 禁区来自位阻 · steric origin of the forbidden zones
extra.zh: 拉氏图的禁区不是什么神秘规则,就是硬球位阻:某些 phi/psi 组合会让相邻肽平面上的羰基氧、酰胺 NH 和 Cbeta 原子相互碰撞。这也是为什么允许区只占整个 (phi, psi) 平面的一小部分,对非甘氨酸残基大约只有四分之一左右。Ramachandran 当年就是用硬球模型算出来的,不是先有实验统计。
extra.en: The forbidden regions are not a mysterious rule but plain hard-sphere sterics: certain phi/psi combinations make the carbonyl oxygen, amide NH and C-beta atoms of adjacent peptide planes collide. That is why the allowed area covers only a small fraction of the (phi, psi) plane, roughly a quarter for non-glycine residues. Ramachandran originally derived it from a hard-sphere model rather than from experimental statistics.

quiz.q_zh: 多肽主链上每个氨基酸残基有几个可以自由旋转的主链二面角，为什么?
quiz.q_en: How many freely rotatable main-chain dihedral angles does each residue have, and why?

options.zh: 1 个，只有 phi 能自由转，psi 被侧链位阻完全锁死
options.en: One: only phi turns, since psi is locked by side-chain sterics

options.zh: 个数取决于侧链的大小，侧链越小可自由旋转的二面角越多
options.en: It depends on side-chain size: smaller chains leave more free angles

options.zh: 3 个，phi、psi、omega 三个二面角都能自由旋转
options.en: Three: phi, psi and omega are all free to rotate about their bonds

options.zh: 2 个，肽键 C-N 有部分双键性质，omega 被锁定
options.en: Two: the peptide C-N is a partial double bond, so omega is locked

quiz.explain_zh: 共振使肽键 C-N 带约 40% 双键性质，omega 被锁在约 180 度，所以主链自由度是 phi 和 psi 两个。选“3 个”正是没注意到肽键平面这一前提。psi 绕的是 Calpha-C 键，侧链再大也不会把它完全锁死；侧链大小影响的是哪些 phi/psi 组合被允许(拉氏图的允许区大小)，而不是自由度的个数。
quiz.explain_en: Resonance gives the peptide C-N about 40% double-bond character and locks omega near 180 degrees, so the main chain has two degrees of freedom, phi and psi. Answering three misses the planarity of the peptide bond. Psi rotates about the C-alpha to C bond and no side chain locks it completely; side-chain size affects which phi/psi combinations are allowed, that is the size of the allowed region, not the number of degrees of freedom.

quiz.q_zh: 某个残基的 (phi, psi) 约为 (-60 度, -45 度)。它最可能处于哪种二级结构?
quiz.q_en: A residue has (phi, psi) of about (-60, -45) degrees. Which secondary structure is it most likely in?

options.zh: 反平行 beta sheet
options.en: Antiparallel beta sheet

options.zh: 左手 alpha helix
options.en: Left-handed alpha helix

options.zh: 无规卷曲 random coil
options.en: An unstructured random coil

options.zh: 右手 alpha helix
options.en: Right-handed alpha helix

quiz.explain_zh: (-57, -47) 是右手 alpha helix 的标准坐标，题给数值几乎重合。选反平行 beta sheet 的人记住了“负 phi”，但 beta sheet 的 psi 是正的、约 +135 度，落在图的左上象限，与本题左下象限完全不同。左手螺旋两个角都是正的；无规卷曲没有固定的 (phi, psi)，题目给出确定值本身就排除了它。
quiz.explain_en: (-57, -47) are the canonical coordinates of a right-handed alpha helix and the given values essentially match. Choosing antiparallel beta sheet remembers the negative phi but forgets that beta sheet has a positive psi near +135, placing it in the upper-left quadrant rather than the lower-left one here. A left-handed helix has both angles positive, and a random coil has no defined (phi, psi) at all, so quoting a single pair already rules it out.

quiz.q_zh: 在拉氏图上，甘氨酸的允许区明显比其他残基大，原因是?
quiz.q_en: Glycine's allowed region on the Ramachandran plot is much larger than other residues'. Why?

options.zh: 甘氨酸比其他残基能多形成若干个主链内部的氢键
options.en: Glycine can form several more backbone hydrogen bonds than any other residue does

options.zh: 甘氨酸更亲水，溶剂化更好，主链更容易被水稳定
options.en: Glycine is more hydrophilic and better solvated, so water stabilises the backbone there

options.zh: 甘氨酸侧链只是一个氢原子，主链周围的位阻最小
options.en: Glycine's side chain is one hydrogen atom, so backbone steric hindrance is minimal

options.zh: 甘氨酸侧链带电荷，可与主链形成额外的静电吸引
options.en: Glycine's side chain is charged and adds extra electrostatic contacts to the backbone

quiz.explain_zh: 拉氏图的禁区来自硬球位阻，主要是 Cbeta 与相邻肽平面原子的碰撞。甘氨酸没有 Cbeta，这一类碰撞消失，所以允许区大得多，还能占据左手螺旋区。甘氨酸侧链就是一个氢，既不带电荷也不提供额外氢键供体或受体，主链氢键能力和其他残基一样；溶剂化好坏改变的是它出现在表面的倾向，而不是允许的二面角范围。这三个错误选项都是把侧链化学性质当成了位阻原因。
quiz.explain_en: The forbidden regions come from hard-sphere sterics, chiefly clashes of the C-beta atom with atoms of the neighbouring peptide planes. Glycine has no C-beta, so that class of clash disappears, its allowed region is far larger, and it can even occupy the left-handed helical region. Its side chain is a single hydrogen: uncharged, offering no extra donor or acceptor, with the same backbone hydrogen-bonding capacity as any residue, and better solvation would change where it sits on the surface, not which dihedral angles are allowed. All three wrong options confuse side-chain chemistry with steric bulk.

title_zh: 结构精修、Ramachandran outlier 与 loop 区的柔性
title_en: Structure refinement, Ramachandran outliers and the flexibility of loops

points.zh: phi 角和 psi 角在实际的蛋白结构工作里特别重要:解析到结构以后有一步叫精修 refinement。
points.en: Phi and psi matter a great deal in practical structural work: after a structure is solved there is a step called refinement.

points.zh: 精修主要修两样东西:一个是侧链的朝向,另一个就是 phi 角和 psi 角。
points.en: Refinement adjusts mainly two things: the orientation of side chains, and the phi and psi angles.

points.zh: outlier 指超出浅色允许区、落在 unfavorable 区域的那些 phi/psi。
points.en: An outlier is a phi/psi pair that falls outside the pale allowed region, into the unfavourable zone.

points.zh: 一般要求一个蛋白结构里 outlier 小于 1%,小于 1% 就说明这个结构符合生物界的自然原则,是一个比较好的结构。
points.en: The general requirement is that outliers make up less than 1% of a structure; below 1% the structure is considered consistent with natural principles and reasonably good.

points.zh: 老师自己的结构虽然已经修得比较好、也被验证网站接受了,但仍然还有两个 outlier。
points.en: The lecturer's own structure, though already well refined and accepted by the validation server, still has two outliers.

points.zh: 这两个点位置比较特殊:其中上面那个点其实已经比较贴近允许区,但它所在的肽键处在一个 loop 区——既不是 alpha helix 也不是 beta sheet 的无定形区域,软件在这里看不到二级结构。
points.en: The two points are in special positions: the upper one is actually quite close to the allowed region, but its peptide bond lies in a loop, an amorphous stretch that is neither alpha helix nor beta sheet, where the software sees no secondary structure.

points.zh: 解释是:氨基酸之间是相互制约、相互协调的,协调得好才使所有 phi/psi 都落在相应的良好区间;而柔性 loop 上的残基很容易摆动,也容易受到溶剂水分子的影响,所以更可能落在不良区域。
points.en: The explanation: residues constrain and coordinate one another, and it is that coordination that keeps all phi/psi in good regions; residues on a flexible loop swing easily and are readily influenced by solvent water molecules, so they are more likely to end up in a poor region.

points.zh: 现场演示:旋转中间那根键,phi 角和 psi 角会同时改变;只要稍微转一点点就能把这个残基送回理想位置,但回去以后又可能跟旁边的残基产生额外的互斥,所以老师没有进一步优化。
points.en: Live demonstration: rotating the central bond changes phi and psi simultaneously; a very small rotation brings the residue back to the ideal position, but doing so can create extra repulsion with the neighbouring residue, so the lecturer left it alone.

points.zh: 总结:phi/psi 必须符合拉氏图,才算一个 classical、符合传统标准的好蛋白结构;而且 phi/psi 的改变会影响其他原子间的非共价作用,蛋白里所有原子都是相互协调、相互制约的。
points.en: Summary: phi and psi must conform to the Ramachandran plot for a structure to count as classical and conventionally good; moreover changing phi/psi alters the non-covalent interactions between other atoms, since every atom in a protein constrains and coordinates with the others.

extra.tag: 验证指标的实际数值 · validation numbers
extra.zh: 现在通行的标准(MolProbity / PDB validation)比课上说的 1% 严得多:Ramachandran favored 应达到 98% 以上,outlier 应在 0.05% 以下,高分辨率结构基本要求 0 个。同时看的还有 clashscore(原子碰撞数)、侧链 rotamer outlier 比例,以及晶体学的 R 与 R_free(两者差值通常不宜超过约 5 个百分点)。
extra.en: Current standards (MolProbity and PDB validation) are considerably stricter than the 1% quoted: Ramachandran favoured should be at least 98%, outliers at most about 0.05%, and high-resolution structures are effectively expected to have none. Alongside these one checks the clashscore, the fraction of side-chain rotamer outliers, and for crystallography R and R_free, whose gap should generally stay within about five percentage points.

extra.tag: 热力学表述要更正 · thermodynamics correction
extra.zh: 课上说“让它维持高能量是一个熵减的过程,自然界不倾向”。严格说体系走向的是 Gibbs 自由能最低:delta G = delta H - T x delta S,不是单看能量最低或熵最大。蛋白折叠本身让多肽链的构象熵下降(delta S 链 < 0),之所以还能自发进行,是因为疏水作用释放有序水带来的溶剂熵增补偿有余。用“自由能最低”表述才不会出错。
extra.en: The lecture says maintaining a high-energy state is an entropy-decreasing process that nature disfavours. Strictly, a system minimises Gibbs free energy: delta G = delta H - T times delta S, not energy alone nor entropy alone. Folding itself lowers the chain's conformational entropy, and it proceeds spontaneously only because the solvent entropy released by the hydrophobic effect more than compensates. Phrasing it as minimising free energy avoids the error.

extra.tag: 别过度精修 · do not over-refine
extra.zh: 精修的目标不是“把所有 outlier 都推进红区”。在分辨率不高时,电子密度或 EM 密度本身不足以唯一确定主链角度,强行修成完美的拉氏图等于把模型的先验偏见塞进数据,属于 over-fitting,可以从 R_free 不降反升看出来。而且真正的 outlier 有时是有生物学意义的:酶活性中心的残基常处于应变构象 strained conformation,这份张力由结合能补偿,是催化的一部分,不该被抹平。
extra.en: Refinement is not about pushing every outlier into the favoured region. At modest resolution the electron or EM density does not uniquely determine backbone angles, and forcing a perfect Ramachandran plot injects the model's prior into the data, which is over-fitting and shows up as R_free failing to fall or rising. Genuine outliers can also be meaningful: active-site residues often sit in strained conformations paid for by binding energy, and that strain is part of catalysis, not something to be smoothed away.

extra.tag: loop 为什么不确定 · why loops are fuzzy
extra.zh: loop 区没有规则的氢键网络把主链锁住,所以 B 因子(温度因子)高、密度弱,常常有多个构象共存;在 NMR 的结构系综里同一段 loop 会画出一大把不同走向。因此对 loop 区的原子坐标,以及任何建立在 loop 坐标上的结论(比如某个位点是否参与结合),都要留余地。反过来,恰恰是这种柔性让 loop 常常成为底物结合、变构和抗体识别的部位。
extra.en: Loops have no regular hydrogen-bond network locking the backbone, so B-factors are high, density is weak, and multiple conformations often coexist; in an NMR ensemble the same loop is drawn with a spread of different paths. Coordinates in loops, and any conclusion built on them such as whether a site participates in binding, therefore deserve caution. Conversely, that very flexibility is why loops so often serve as substrate-binding, allosteric and antibody-recognition sites.

quiz.q_zh: 精修时把一个 Ramachandran outlier 强行拉回 favorable 区，为什么反而可能让模型变差?
quiz.q_en: During refinement, why can forcing a Ramachandran outlier back into the favoured region actually make the model worse?

options.zh: 会改变该残基的分子量，使模型的总质量计算不再准确
options.en: It changes the molecular weight of that residue, so the model's total mass is wrong

options.zh: 会改变该位置的氨基酸序列，使模型与实际的蛋白不再一致
options.en: It changes the amino acid sequence there, so the model no longer matches the real protein

options.zh: 主链转动会牵动相邻原子产生新的空间冲突，并偏离密度
options.en: Rotating the backbone drags nearby atoms into new clashes and away from the density

options.zh: 强行转动会拉断该区域已有的二硫键，破坏整体的折叠
options.en: Forcing the rotation snaps the disulfide bonds there and wrecks the overall fold

quiz.explain_zh: 这正是课上演示的现象：转一点点键角就把 phi/psi 送回理想区，但立刻和旁边残基产生互斥。更重要的是模型必须同时符合实验密度，只优化几何而牺牲密度拟合就是 over-fitting。另外三项都是概念错误：精修只动坐标，不改序列、不改分子量；outlier 多半出现在 loop 上，那里通常根本没有二硫键，而转动一个主链二面角也不会断开共价键。
quiz.explain_en: This is exactly what the lecture demonstrates: a tiny rotation restores ideal phi/psi but immediately creates repulsion with the neighbour. More importantly the model must also fit the experimental density, and optimising geometry at the cost of that fit is over-fitting. The other three are conceptual errors: refinement moves coordinates only, never the sequence and never the molecular weight, and outliers usually sit in loops that carry no disulfide, while turning one backbone dihedral does not break a covalent bond anyway.

quiz.q_zh: 在一个已经精修好的结构里，Ramachandran outlier 最常出现在什么位置?
quiz.q_en: In a well-refined structure, where do Ramachandran outliers most often appear?

options.zh: beta sheet 内部氢键完全饱和的中间链
options.en: Central strands of a beta sheet, saturated with hydrogen bonds

options.zh: 柔性 loop 与链末端等密度弱、B 因子高处
options.en: Loops and chain termini, where density is weak and B-factors high

options.zh: 侧链堆积最紧密、主链构象受到限制的疏水核心内部
options.en: The hydrophobic core interior, where side chains pack tightly

options.zh: alpha helix 中氢键最规整的中间螺旋段
options.en: The middle of an alpha helix, where the backbone angles are regular

quiz.explain_zh: 规则二级结构有周期性氢键网络把主链角度锁死，密度也最清楚，几乎不出 outlier；疏水核心堆积紧密同理，主链本来就被压在允许区里。loop 和末端缺乏这种约束，构象多样、密度弱、B 因子高，建模时最容易落到不良区域，课上那两个 outlier 就在 loop 上。
quiz.explain_en: Regular secondary structure has a periodic hydrogen-bond network that locks backbone angles, and its density is the clearest, so outliers are rare there; the same holds for the tightly packed core, where the backbone is already pinned inside the allowed region. Loops and termini lack that restraint, adopt multiple conformations and give weak density with high B-factors, so they are where modelling most often strays, which is exactly where the lecture's two outliers sit.

quiz.q_zh: 关于“蛋白质自发折叠到能量最低的构象”这句话，最准确的表述是?
quiz.q_en: Which is the most accurate restatement of the claim that a protein folds spontaneously to its lowest-energy conformation?

options.zh: 体系趋向 Gibbs 自由能最低，由焓变和熵变共同决定
options.en: The system minimises Gibbs free energy, set jointly by enthalpy and entropy changes

options.zh: 折叠一定会使整个体系的总熵增加，因此是熵驱动的自发过程
options.en: Folding always raises the total entropy, so it is a spontaneous entropy-driven process

options.zh: 折叠只是分子内部的事，无需考虑周围水分子的熵贡献
options.en: Folding is purely intramolecular; the surrounding water makes no relevant contribution

options.zh: 整个体系的内能必须达到绝对最低值，与熵的变化没有任何关系
options.en: The total energy must reach an absolute minimum, with entropy playing no part at all

quiz.explain_zh: 自发性判据是 delta G = delta H - T x delta S 小于零，不是单看能量或单看熵。说“折叠一定会使总熵增加、因此是熵驱动”很像课上“疏水作用是熵驱动”的说法，但那指的是溶剂(水)的熵增；多肽链本身的构象熵在折叠中是下降的，而且有些蛋白的折叠是焓驱动的，笼统断言总熵一定增加并不成立。说“折叠只是分子内部的事”则忽略了折叠的主要驱动力恰恰来自水。把内能绝对最低当判据，则漏掉了熵项。
quiz.explain_en: Spontaneity is judged by delta G = delta H - T delta S being negative, not by energy or entropy alone. Saying that folding always raises total entropy echoes the lecture's point that the hydrophobic effect is entropy-driven, but that refers to the entropy gain of the solvent; the chain's own conformational entropy falls on folding and some proteins fold enthalpy-driven, so a blanket claim that total entropy always rises is wrong. Calling folding purely intramolecular ignores that the main driving force comes precisely from water, and demanding an absolute internal-energy minimum simply drops the entropy term.

title_zh: 酰胺平面、二级结构的定义与 α 螺旋的几何
title_en: The amide plane, the definition of secondary structure, and α-helix geometry

points.zh: 肽键所在的那一组原子是共平面的，称为酰胺平面 amide plane（肽键平面）；一条肽链就是一串平面串起来。
points.en: The atoms of a peptide bond lie in one plane, the amide plane (peptide plane); a polypeptide is a chain of such planes strung together.

points.zh: 老师给的直观理解：φ 角和 ψ 角可以粗略看成相邻两个酰胺平面之间的二面角 dihedral angle，绕的就是平面之间那两根键。
points.en: The intuition given: φ and ψ can be read as the dihedral angles between two neighbouring amide planes, rotating about the two bonds that join them.

points.zh: φ/ψ 的改变会影响其他原子间的非共价相互作用 non-covalent interactions；蛋白里所有原子是相互协调、相互制约的，侧链间作用反过来也在维持 φ/ψ。
points.en: Changing φ/ψ perturbs non-covalent interactions elsewhere; all atoms in a protein constrain one another, and side-chain contacts in turn hold φ/ψ in place.

points.zh: 二级结构 secondary structure 有明确定义：局部的、有规律的构象；课上只把 α helix 和 β sheet 当作真正的二级结构。
points.en: Secondary structure has a strict definition: a local, regular conformation. In this lecture only α-helix and β-sheet count as genuine secondary structure.

points.zh: 老师说 α helix 和 β sheet 是构成蛋白高级结构的主体，声称占 95% 以上。
points.en: The teacher states that α-helix and β-sheet make up the bulk of higher-order protein structure, claiming over 95%.

points.zh: 人体内的 α helix 一定是右手螺旋 right-handed helix，原因是天然蛋白只用 L 型氨基酸 L-amino acids，L 构型决定了螺旋的旋向。
points.en: In humans the α-helix is always right-handed, because natural proteins are built from L-amino acids and the L configuration dictates the handedness.

points.zh: 某些细菌能掺入 D 型氨基酸 D-amino acids，因此可能出现左手 α helix；但人体内按右手记就够了。
points.en: Some bacteria incorporate D-amino acids and can therefore form left-handed α-helices; for human proteins, remember right-handed.

points.zh: 数值：α helix 每上升一整圈约 0.54 nm（螺距 pitch 5.4 Å），每个氨基酸沿轴上升约 0.15 nm = 1.5 Å。
points.en: Numbers: one full turn rises about 0.54 nm (pitch 5.4 Å) and each residue advances about 0.15 nm = 1.5 Å along the axis.

points.zh: 所有残基的侧链绝对朝向螺旋外部，主链氢键全部埋在螺旋内部、沿轴自上而下；侧链外向使 α helix 容易接触别的蛋白，所以抗体识别抗原的区域常常就是几段 α helix。
points.en: Every side chain points outward from the helix while the backbone H-bonds run down the inside along the axis; the outward side chains make α-helices good recognition surfaces, e.g. antibody–antigen contact regions.

extra.tag: 课上口误 · misstated in lecture
extra.zh: 课上反复说「每三到六个氨基酸上升一圈」，这其实是把 3.6 听成了「3 到 6」。标准答案是每圈 3.6 个残基 3.6 residues per turn。用老师自己给的两个数就能自洽：螺距 5.4 Å ÷ 每残基上升 1.5 Å = 3.6。
extra.en: The lecture repeatedly says 3 to 6 residues per turn; this is the number 3.6 mis-heard. The standard value is 3.6 residues per turn, and it follows from the teacher's own numbers: pitch 5.4 Å ÷ rise 1.5 Å per residue = 3.6.

extra.tag: 氢键编号 · H-bond register
extra.zh: 课上说「氨基与前面第三个氨基酸的羰基形成氢键」。经典 α helix 的氢键是 i → i+4：第 i 位残基的主链 C=O 与第 i+4 位残基的 N–H 成氢键（中间隔 3 个残基，形成 13 元环，故也写作 3.6₁₃）。i → i+3 是 3₁₀ helix，i → i+5 是 π helix，两者都存在但少见，常出现在 α helix 的两端。
extra.en: The lecture says the N–H bonds to the carbonyl three residues back. In a classical α-helix the H-bond is i → i+4: the backbone C=O of residue i to the N–H of residue i+4 (a 13-atom ring, hence 3.6₁₃). The i → i+3 pattern is the 3₁₀ helix and i → i+5 the π helix; both exist but are rare and usually cap the ends of α-helices.

extra.tag: 拉氏图坐标 · Ramachandran values
extra.zh: 接上一段讲的拉氏图，值得背下的坐标：右手 α helix 在 φ ≈ −57°、ψ ≈ −47°；反平行 β sheet 在 φ ≈ −140°、ψ ≈ +135° 附近；左手 α helix 在 φ ≈ +57°、ψ ≈ +47°，正常只有甘氨酸能舒服地待在那里。
extra.en: Coordinates worth memorising for the Ramachandran plot: right-handed α-helix at φ ≈ −57°, ψ ≈ −47°; antiparallel β-sheet around φ ≈ −140°, ψ ≈ +135°; left-handed α-helix at φ ≈ +57°, ψ ≈ +47°, a region normally occupied only by glycine.

extra.tag: 比例被夸大 · fraction overstated
extra.zh: 「α helix + β sheet 占 95% 以上」是口头夸张。球状蛋白中通常只有约 50%–60% 的残基处于规则二级结构中，其余是 turn 和 loop。真正接近 95% 的说法是：几乎所有规则二级结构都属于这两类（即除 α 和 β 外没有第三种主流规则构象）。
extra.en: The claim that α-helix plus β-sheet make up over 95% is loose. In globular proteins typically only about 50–60% of residues sit in regular secondary structure; the rest are turns and loops. What is nearly 95% true is that essentially all regular secondary structure belongs to these two classes.

quiz.q_zh: 老师给出 α helix 的螺距为 5.4 Å，每个残基沿轴上升 1.5 Å。由此推出每圈的残基数是多少？
quiz.q_en: The lecture gives an α-helix pitch of 5.4 Å and a rise of 1.5 Å per residue. How many residues per turn does that imply?
quiz.explain_zh: 5.4 Å ÷ 1.5 Å = 3.6，这正是教科书的 3.6 residues per turn。选「3.0」最诱人，因为老师口头说「最经典的是三个氨基酸上升一圈」，但那与他自己给的两个数字矛盾；3.0 对应的是 3₁₀ helix，不是标准 α helix。
quiz.explain_en: 5.4 Å ÷ 1.5 Å = 3.6, the textbook value of 3.6 residues per turn. The tempting answer is 3.0, because the lecture says three residues per turn, but that contradicts the two numbers he himself gives; 3.0 residues per turn describes the 3₁₀ helix, not a standard α-helix.

quiz.q_zh: 为什么人体蛋白中的 α helix 几乎总是右手螺旋？
quiz.q_en: Why are α-helices in human proteins almost always right-handed?

options.zh: 因为肽键有部分双键性质，ω 角被锁死，构象不能旋转
options.en: Because the peptide bond has partial double-bond character that locks ω rigid

options.zh: 因为天然氨基酸都是 L 型，L 构型使左手螺旋位阻更大
options.en: Because the amino acids are all L, and an L centre strains a left-handed helix

options.zh: 因为核糖体从 N 端向 C 端合成，延伸方向决定了旋向
options.en: Because the ribosome builds from N-terminus to C-terminus, setting the screw sense

options.zh: 因为主链 C=O 与 N–H 的氢键只能沿一个旋向搭起来
options.en: Because the backbone C=O to N–H hydrogen bond can form in only one screw sense

quiz.explain_zh: 旋向由单体的手性决定：L 型氨基酸的侧链在右手螺旋中彼此位阻最小，左手 α helix 会让侧链与主链羰基相撞。选「肽键 ω 角被锁死」很诱人，因为那确实是酰胺平面存在的原因，但它只解释了 ω 角被固定，完全不区分左右手；氢键几何和合成方向都不含手性信息。
quiz.explain_en: Handedness comes from the chirality of the monomer: with L-amino acids the side chains clash least in a right-handed helix, whereas a left-handed one drives side chains into the backbone carbonyls. The tempting wrong answer is the locked ω of the rigid peptide bond, which is indeed why the amide plane exists, but it only fixes ω and says nothing about left versus right; neither H-bond geometry nor synthesis direction carries any chirality.

quiz.q_zh: 关于 α helix 中的氢键和侧链，下列哪一项正确？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about the hydrogen bonds and side chains of an α-helix is correct?

options.zh: 氢键在半胱氨酸之间形成二硫键，螺旋结构与主链的氢键无关
options.en: Between cysteines as disulfide bonds, with backbone hydrogen bonds playing no role

options.zh: 氢键在主链 C=O 与 N–H 之间，平行于螺旋轴，侧链朝外
options.en: Between backbone C=O and N–H, nearly parallel to the axis, side chains out

options.zh: 氢键在侧链之间形成，垂直于螺旋轴，侧链全部朝向螺旋内部
options.en: Between side chains, running across the helix axis, with side chains pointing inward

options.zh: 氢键连接相邻的两条肽链，侧链在片层两面交替朝上朝下分布
options.en: Between two neighbouring chains, with side chains alternating above and below

quiz.explain_zh: α helix 是链内 intrachain 氢键，主链 C=O(i) 与 N–H(i+4)，方向几乎与轴平行，全部埋在螺旋内部；侧链一律朝外，这正是 α helix 适合做识别界面的原因。选「连接相邻两条肽链、侧链交替朝上朝下」描述的是 β sheet，是最容易混的一项。
quiz.explain_en: The α-helix uses intrachain backbone H-bonds, C=O(i) to N–H(i+4), running almost parallel to the axis and buried inside, while every side chain projects outward, which is why helices make good recognition surfaces. The option about linking two chains with alternating side chains describes a β-sheet and is the easiest confusion.

title_zh: 哪些氨基酸能进 α 螺旋：甘氨酸与脯氨酸这两个例外
title_en: Which residues can enter an α-helix: the glycine and proline exceptions

points.zh: 组成 α helix 的一般是侧链比较小、带电荷比较少的氨基酸；老师举的例子是丙氨酸 alanine、缬氨酸 valine、异亮氨酸 isoleucine。
points.en: α-helices are typically built from residues with small, largely uncharged side chains; the examples given are alanine, valine and isoleucine.

points.zh: 螺旋中相邻残基的侧链之间本来就有一定的碰撞和相互制约，正是这种侧向的相互作用帮着把螺旋固定住。
points.en: Neighbouring side chains along the helix do bump against and constrain one another, and that lateral interaction is part of what pins the helix in place.

points.zh: 第一个例外是甘氨酸 glycine：它的侧链只是一个氢原子，太小，与相邻残基几乎没有任何侧链间相互作用，也就没有制约。
points.en: The first exception is glycine: its side chain is a single hydrogen atom, too small to make any side-chain contact with its neighbours and therefore imposing no constraint.

points.zh: 失去这种制约后螺旋可能解构，不再能维持成一个 α helix；老师因此说 α helix 里不应该有甘氨酸。
points.en: Without that constraint the helix can come apart and no longer hold as an α-helix, which is why the lecture says glycine should not appear in one.

points.zh: 第二个例外是脯氨酸 proline：它是刚性结构，没有办法扭转，一旦出现就会直接破坏整个 α helix。
points.en: The second exception is proline: it is a rigid structure that cannot rotate, and its appearance destroys the whole α-helix.

points.zh: 老师的结论说得很绝对：α helix 里绝对不会存在脯氨酸。
points.en: The conclusion is stated absolutely: proline is never found inside an α-helix.

points.zh: 脯氨酸最常见的去处是接下来要讲的 β 转角 β-turn 和各种 loop 区域；「Pro 最常见的功能就是做 loop」。
points.en: Proline's usual home is the β-turn discussed next and various loop regions; its commonest role is to sit in a loop.

extra.tag: 脯氨酸的真正原因 · the real reason for proline
extra.zh: 课上只说「刚性、不能扭转」，考试要答两条：(1) 脯氨酸的氮原子在五元吡咯烷环里，是仲胺，主链上没有 N–H，因此无法作为氢键供体，α helix 的 i→i+4 氢键网络在那里断掉一环；(2) 环把 φ 角锁死在约 −60°，剥夺了主链的自由度。第一条才是决定性的。
extra.en: The lecture only says rigid and unable to rotate. An exam answer needs two points: (1) proline's nitrogen sits in the pyrrolidine ring as a secondary amine, so the backbone has no N–H and cannot donate a hydrogen bond, breaking one rung of the i→i+4 ladder; (2) the ring locks φ at about −60°, removing backbone freedom. The missing N–H is the decisive one.

extra.tag: 说法过于绝对 · stated too absolutely
extra.zh: 「绝对不会有 Pro / 绝对不能有 Gly」是记忆口号，不是事实。Gly 和 Pro 只是螺旋倾向 helix propensity 最低的两个残基，属于 helix breaker。实际结构中脯氨酸常出现在 α helix 的第一圈或 N 端帽 N-cap 处（那里本来就没有 i−4 的氢键伙伴，缺 N–H 不吃亏），在跨膜螺旋中则造成一个约 20° 的 kink（如 GPCR 的 proline kink）。
extra.en: Never and absolutely are mnemonics, not facts. Gly and Pro are simply the two residues with the lowest helix propensity, i.e. helix breakers. Proline is in fact common in the first turn or N-cap of a helix, where there is no i−4 partner to bond anyway, and in transmembrane helices it produces a characteristic kink of roughly 20°, as in GPCRs.

extra.tag: 甘氨酸的热力学解释 · the entropic argument
extra.zh: 甘氨酸不利于螺旋，更标准的说法不是「没有侧链制约」而是构象熵：没有 Cβ，甘氨酸在拉氏图上可及区域最大，展开态的构象熵极高，折成螺旋要付出的熵代价也最大。螺旋倾向排序大致是 Ala > Leu > Met > Glu > Gln ... > Gly > Pro，Ala 最好，Pro 最差。
extra.en: The better justification for glycine's helix-destabilising effect is conformational entropy rather than lack of side-chain contact: with no Cβ, glycine samples the largest region of the Ramachandran plot, so the unfolded state has high conformational entropy and folding into a helix costs the most. Helix propensity runs roughly Ala > Leu > Met > Glu > Gln ... > Gly > Pro, best to worst.

quiz.q_zh: 脯氨酸破坏 α helix，最根本的化学原因是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the most fundamental chemical reason proline disrupts an α-helix?

options.zh: 环状亚氨基使主链无 N–H，不能提供 i→i+4 氢键
options.en: Its ring nitrogen leaves the backbone no N–H to donate the i→i+4 hydrogen bond

options.zh: 吡咯环的侧链体积过大，与 i+4 位残基的侧链发生位阻
options.en: Its ring side chain is too bulky and clashes sterically with the residue at i+4

options.zh: 环上的氮带正电荷，与相邻残基的主链羰基静电排斥
options.en: Its ring nitrogen carries a positive charge that repels the backbone carbonyls

options.zh: 脯氨酸是唯一的 D 型氨基酸，其手性与右手螺旋不相容
options.en: Proline is the only D-amino acid, and its handedness suits a left-handed helix

quiz.explain_zh: 缺少主链 N–H 使氢键梯子断掉一格，再加上环把 φ 锁在 −60°，两者共同破坏螺旋。选「侧链太大」是最诱人的错误：脯氨酸的环并不比亮氨酸大，色氨酸那么大都能进螺旋，可见体积不是关键；而脯氨酸不带电荷，也不是 D 型氨基酸。
quiz.explain_en: The absent backbone N–H removes one rung of the H-bond ladder, and the ring additionally locks φ near −60°. The tempting wrong answer is bulk: proline's ring is no larger than leucine's side chain and tryptophan sits happily in helices, so size is not the issue; proline is neither charged nor a D-amino acid.

quiz.q_zh: 甘氨酸使 α helix 不稳定，最标准的解释是哪一条？
quiz.q_en: Which is the standard explanation for glycine destabilising an α-helix?

options.zh: 甘氨酸的氨基参与成环，主链缺少氢键供体 N–H
options.en: Its amino nitrogen is tied up in a ring, leaving no backbone N–H to donate

options.zh: 甘氨酸缺少 Cβ，可及构象最多，成螺旋熵代价大
options.en: It lacks a Cβ, samples the widest backbone freedom, so helix costs entropy

options.zh: 甘氨酸的侧链带负电荷，会中和整条螺旋的宏观偶极
options.en: Its side chain carries a negative charge that cancels the helix macrodipole

options.zh: 甘氨酸只能位于肽链的 N 端，无法进入螺旋中段
options.en: It can only sit at the chain's N-terminus, never in the middle of a helix

quiz.explain_zh: 甘氨酸没有 Cβ，在拉氏图上可及区域最大，因此展开态熵高、成螺旋要付的熵代价最大，螺旋倾向最低。选「侧链带负电」是无中生有：甘氨酸侧链就是一个氢原子，不带电荷；「氨基成环、缺少 N–H」说的是脯氨酸，甘氨酸的主链 N–H 完好无损。老师课上说的「没有侧链间制约」方向对，但严谨的答法是构象熵。
quiz.explain_en: Lacking a Cβ, glycine can access the widest area of the Ramachandran plot, so its unfolded state is entropically rich and helix formation is entropically expensive, giving it the lowest helix propensity. The charged-side-chain option is invented: glycine's side chain is a lone hydrogen. The ring-and-no-N–H option describes proline; glycine's backbone N–H is intact. The lecture's no-side-chain-constraint argument points the right way, but the rigorous statement is the entropy one.

title_zh: β 折叠：链间氢键、平行与反平行、疏水腔
title_en: β-sheet: interstrand hydrogen bonds, parallel versus antiparallel, and the hydrophobic cavity

points.zh: β sheet 在比较古早的文献里叫 β pleated sheet，即折叠成褶皱的片层。
points.en: In older literature the β-sheet is called a β pleated sheet, a sheet folded into pleats.

points.zh: 定义：两条（或多条）完全伸展 fully extended 的肽链，通过侧向的氢键连成一个片层结构。
points.en: Definition: two or more fully extended polypeptide strands joined side by side through lateral hydrogen bonds into a sheet.

points.zh: 分两类：平行 parallel（两条链走向一致）和反平行 antiparallel（两条链走向相反）。
points.en: Two classes: parallel, with both strands running the same way, and antiparallel, with them running opposite.

points.zh: 老师描述的几何差别：平行时氢键是斜过来的，反平行时氢键基本是 90° 垂直对齐的。
points.en: The geometric difference described: in parallel sheets the H-bonds come in at a slant, while in antiparallel sheets they line up nearly perpendicular.

points.zh: 老师认为考试里一般只需要认出「这是 β sheet」，平行还是反平行不太追究，但课本里有这个分类，要知道。
points.en: For the exam, the teacher says recognising it as a β-sheet is normally enough and the parallel/antiparallel distinction is rarely pressed, though the textbook classification should be known.

points.zh: β sheet 最重要的功能是形成疏水腔 hydrophobic cavity；示范结构里 β sheet 的一面全是亮氨酸 leucine、缬氨酸 valine、异亮氨酸 isoleucine、苯丙氨酸 phenylalanine 这类疏水残基。
points.en: The key function of a β-sheet is to build a hydrophobic cavity; in the demonstrated structure one face is entirely leucine, valine, isoleucine and phenylalanine.

points.zh: 很常见的经典安排是两层 β sheet 相对，围成一整个疏水腔，刚性很强，构成一个典型的结构域。
points.en: A classic arrangement is two layers of β-sheet facing each other and enclosing a whole hydrophobic cavity: very rigid, and a typical structural domain.

points.zh: 另一面可以是疏水的，也可以是亲水的，取决于序列。
points.en: The other face may be hydrophobic or hydrophilic, depending on the sequence.

extra.tag: 主链而不是侧链 · backbone, not side chain
extra.zh: 转录中有一句说 β sheet 靠「两条链侧链上的氢键」维持——这点必须纠正：β sheet 的氢键完全是主链 backbone 之间的，一条链的 N–H 与相邻链的 C=O，与侧链无关（老师前一句说的「侧向 lateral 氢键」才是对的，可能是口误或转写混淆）。侧链根本不参与，它们是垂直于片层交替伸向上下两面的。
extra.en: One line in the transcript says the sheet is held by hydrogen bonds on the side chains. This must be corrected: β-sheet hydrogen bonds are purely backbone-to-backbone, N–H of one strand to C=O of the adjacent strand, with no side-chain involvement. His earlier word, lateral, is the correct one. Side chains take no part; they project alternately above and below the sheet.

extra.tag: 交替朝向 · alternating faces
extra.zh: β 链上相邻残基的侧链交替指向片层的两面，所以「一面全疏水」是靠序列上每隔一个残基放一个疏水氨基酸（i, i+2, i+4 …）实现的。对比 α helix：那里周期是 3.6，所以两亲螺旋 amphipathic helix 的疏水残基是每隔 3–4 个出现一次。这个「二周期 vs 3.6 周期」是判读序列的常用工具。
extra.en: Along a β-strand, consecutive side chains point to opposite faces, so an all-hydrophobic face is produced by placing hydrophobic residues at every second position (i, i+2, i+4 …). Compare the α-helix, whose 3.6 periodicity means an amphipathic helix carries hydrophobic residues every three to four positions. This 2-residue versus 3.6-residue periodicity is a standard tool for reading sequences.

extra.tag: 稳定性与尺寸 · stability and dimensions
extra.zh: 反平行 β sheet 的氢键接近直线，因此单键更强、更稳定，常由 β 发夹 β-hairpin 形成，可以只有两条链；平行 β sheet 的氢键是扭曲的，稳定性较差，通常要 5 条链以上、且多埋在蛋白内部。尺寸：完全伸展的 β 链每个残基沿链方向约 3.3–3.5 Å，是 α helix（1.5 Å）的两倍多，这就是「完全伸展」的量化含义。
extra.en: Antiparallel hydrogen bonds are nearly linear and therefore stronger and more stable; such sheets often arise from a β-hairpin and can have just two strands. Parallel hydrogen bonds are distorted and less stable, so parallel sheets usually need five or more strands and are typically buried. Dimensions: a fully extended strand advances about 3.3–3.5 Å per residue, over twice the 1.5 Å of an α-helix, which is what fully extended means quantitatively.

extra.tag: 延伸到病理 · link to disease
extra.zh: β sheet 也可以跨分子形成：淀粉样纤维 amyloid fibril 的核心就是 cross-β 结构，链间氢键把不同的蛋白分子连成一根无限延伸的 β sheet（阿尔茨海默病 Aβ、朊病毒 prion、胰岛淀粉样多肽）。另一个考点是 β barrel：革兰阴性菌外膜的孔蛋白 porin 用一圈 β sheet 卷成桶，外面疏水、里面亲水，与球状蛋白正好相反。
extra.en: β-sheets can also form between molecules: the core of an amyloid fibril is a cross-β structure in which interstrand hydrogen bonds link separate protein molecules into one indefinitely extended sheet (Aβ in Alzheimer's, prions, islet amyloid polypeptide). A second exam point is the β-barrel: porins in the Gram-negative outer membrane roll a sheet into a barrel with a hydrophobic outside and a hydrophilic lumen, the inverse of a globular protein.

quiz.q_zh: 把 β sheet 中相邻两条链连在一起的是什么相互作用？
quiz.q_en: What interaction holds two adjacent strands of a β-sheet together?

options.zh: 相邻两条链上半胱氨酸侧链之间形成的二硫键
options.en: Disulfide bonds between cysteine side chains on the two adjacent strands

options.zh: 相邻两条链主链 N–H 与主链 C=O 之间形成的氢键
options.en: Hydrogen bonds between the backbone N–H and backbone C=O of the two strands

options.zh: 相邻两条链非极性侧链之间的疏水作用 hydrophobic effect
options.en: Hydrophobic attraction between the nonpolar side chains of the two strands

options.zh: 相邻两条链侧链上的羟基与羧基之间形成的氢键
options.en: Hydrogen bonds between side-chain hydroxyls and carboxylates of the two strands

quiz.explain_zh: β sheet 的骨架是主链间氢键，与侧链的化学性质完全无关——正因为如此，任何序列原则上都能形成 β sheet（这也是淀粉样纤维普遍存在的原因）。选「侧链疏水作用」很诱人，因为 β sheet 的确常常一面全疏水，但那是它折叠后堆积的驱动力，不是把两条链拴住的键。
quiz.explain_en: The scaffolding of a β-sheet is backbone hydrogen bonding, entirely independent of side-chain chemistry, which is why in principle almost any sequence can form one and why amyloid is so general. The hydrophobic option is tempting because a sheet often does have one all-hydrophobic face, but that drives the packing after folding, it is not the bond that ties the strands together.

quiz.q_zh: 某条 β 链的序列为 Val-Lys-Ile-Asp-Leu-Glu-Phe-Arg。关于这条链，下列推断哪一项最合理？
quiz.q_en: A β-strand has the sequence Val-Lys-Ile-Asp-Leu-Glu-Phe-Arg. Which inference about it is most reasonable?

options.zh: 带电残基与疏水残基各占一半，因此只能形成平行片层
options.en: Its charged and hydrophobic residues are equal, so it must form a parallel sheet

options.zh: 它是两亲的 β 链，疏水残基集中在片层的同一面上
options.en: It is amphipathic, with its hydrophobic residues all on one face of the sheet

options.zh: 疏水与亲水残基严格交替，使它无法形成规则二级结构
options.en: Its strict hydrophobic-hydrophilic alternation prevents any regular structure

options.zh: 疏水残基每隔三到四位出现，提示它更可能形成 α helix
options.en: Its hydrophobic residues recur every three to four positions, so it is helical

quiz.explain_zh: Val、Ile、Leu、Phe 位于第 1、3、5、7 位，Lys、Asp、Glu、Arg 位于第 2、4、6、8 位。β 链上侧链交替朝上下两面，所以这种「隔一个」的疏水模式正好把疏水残基全放到同一面，形成疏水腔的一壁。选 α helix 的那项是最诱人的干扰项：螺旋的疏水周期是 3–4，不是 2，本序列的周期恰好是 2，指向 β 链。
quiz.explain_en: Val, Ile, Leu and Phe occupy positions 1, 3, 5, 7 and Lys, Asp, Glu, Arg positions 2, 4, 6, 8. Because side chains alternate faces along a strand, this every-second-residue pattern puts all the hydrophobic residues on one face, forming one wall of a hydrophobic cavity. The α-helix option is the strongest distractor: a helix has a hydrophobic period of three to four, not two, and this sequence has a period of exactly two.

quiz.q_zh: 关于平行与反平行 β sheet，下列哪一项正确？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about parallel versus antiparallel β-sheets is correct?

options.zh: 只有反平行片层的侧链交替朝两面，因而能构成疏水腔
options.en: Only antiparallel sheets alternate side-chain faces, so only they make cavities

options.zh: 反平行片层的氢键接近直线，更稳定，两条链就能成片
options.en: Antiparallel bonds are nearly linear, more stable, and two strands suffice

options.zh: 平行片层的氢键接近直线，单个氢键比反平行的更强
options.en: Parallel bonds are nearly linear, so each one is stronger than in antiparallel

options.zh: 平行片层只能由同一条链回折成，反平行只能跨链形成
options.en: Parallel sheets form only within one chain, antiparallel only between chains

quiz.explain_zh: 反平行排列使 N–H···O=C 三点几乎共线，氢键最强；平行排列时几何被迫扭斜，单个氢键较弱，所以平行片层往往需要更多条链并埋在蛋白内部。选「平行片层的氢键接近直线」刚好把两者说反了，是最容易记混的一对；平行和反平行都可以由同一条链回折或由不同链形成，侧链也都在两条面上交替，都能构成疏水腔。
quiz.explain_en: The antiparallel arrangement puts N–H···O=C almost collinear, giving the strongest bonds, whereas parallel geometry forces a skew and weaker individual bonds, so parallel sheets tend to need more strands and to be buried. The option claiming parallel bonds are linear simply reverses this and is the classic mix-up; both types can arise within one chain or between chains, both alternate side-chain faces, and both can build hydrophobic cavities.

title_zh: β 转角、flexible loop 与无规卷曲
title_en: β-turns, flexible loops and random coil

points.zh: β 转角 β-turn 也被归为二级结构，但平时很少提；老师专门讲它，是因为它和 α helix 正好构成一对反例。
points.en: The β-turn is also classed as secondary structure though rarely emphasised; it is singled out here because it is the exact counterpart of the α-helix.

points.zh: 对照关系：α helix 里基本不能有甘氨酸 glycine 和脯氨酸 proline；而 β 转角里大多数情况下恰恰含有这两个氨基酸。
points.en: The contrast: an α-helix essentially excludes glycine and proline, whereas a β-turn in most cases contains precisely those two.

points.zh: 脯氨酸的作用：它自带一个固定的折角，氨基在这边就把羧基折到下边去，成肽键时天然产生一个转角。
points.en: Proline's role: it carries a built-in bend, folding the carboxyl down relative to the amino group, so forming a peptide bond there produces a natural turn.

points.zh: 甘氨酸的作用：侧链极小，不对相邻氨基酸产生空间位阻 steric hindrance，因此很容易被容纳进转角。
points.en: Glycine's role: its minimal side chain imposes no steric hindrance on its neighbours, so it is easily accommodated in a turn.

points.zh: 典型的 β 转角产生 180° 的方向反转；如果在这么紧的空间里塞四个大的（尤其是疏水的）侧链，它们之间会严重排斥，不是能量最低的状态。
points.en: A typical β-turn reverses direction by 180°; packing four large, especially hydrophobic, side chains into that tight space causes severe repulsion and is not the lowest-energy state.

points.zh: 示范：结构中一段确实转了 180° 的区域，但既没有甘氨酸也没有脯氨酸，所以不算 β 转角，只是 unstructured 区。
points.en: Demonstration: a region in the structure does turn by 180° but contains neither glycine nor proline, so it is not a β-turn, merely an unstructured region.

points.zh: 判据被点明：β turn 一定有某种力（刚性的或相互作用）在主动支撑它定型；unstructured 区没有特定的维持力，它的形状是被别的因素被动决定的。
points.en: The criterion is made explicit: a β-turn is actively held by some force, rigidity or interaction, whereas an unstructured region has no defining force and its shape is imposed passively.

points.zh: 术语习惯：结构生物学口语里更常说 flexible loop 灵活环区，unstructured 这个词在文献里少见；老师说国内基本都叫 flexible loop。
points.en: Terminology: structural biologists mostly say flexible loop; unstructured is uncommon in the literature, and the teacher notes flexible loop is the usual term in practice.

points.zh: 无规卷曲 random coil：完全没有结构、柔性地飘在水里的一段；它同样由一级结构决定——这段序列一定不含能形成 α helix 或 β sheet 的序列。另外还有 Ω 环 omega loop（肽链直走—鼓一个包—再直走），老师说蛋白里极少见、RNA 里多，不必深究。
points.en: Random coil: a completely unstructured, flexible segment floating in water, still dictated by primary structure in the sense that its sequence contains nothing capable of forming an α-helix or β-sheet. The omega loop, a straight run bulging out and straightening again, is mentioned as rare in proteins and common in RNA, and not pursued.

extra.tag: β转角的精确定义 · precise definition
extra.zh: 课上只给了「180° 转弯 + Gly/Pro」。标准定义是四个残基 i、i+1、i+2、i+3，第 i 位的 C=O 与第 i+3 位的 N–H 形成一个氢键（Cα(i) 与 Cα(i+3) 距离 < 7 Å）。最常见的两型：type I 转角 i+1 位常是脯氨酸；type II 转角的 i+2 位必须是甘氨酸，因为该位置的构象要求只有没有 Cβ 的残基才能占据。这解释了老师说的「Gly 和 Pro 都在里面」的分工。
extra.en: The lecture gives only 180° plus Gly/Pro. The standard definition is four residues i, i+1, i+2, i+3 with a hydrogen bond from the C=O of i to the N–H of i+3 and Cα(i)–Cα(i+3) under 7 Å. The two commonest kinds: type I often has proline at i+1; type II requires glycine at i+2 because the conformation demanded there can only be adopted by a residue without a Cβ. That is the division of labour behind the teacher's Gly-and-Pro statement.

extra.tag: 课上说法有误 · lecture is off here
extra.zh: Ω 环并不是蛋白里极罕见的东西。Ω loop 是 Leszczynski 与 Rose（1986）在蛋白结构中定义并统计出来的常见非规则元件（首尾 Cα 距离近、中间鼓出一个套索），平均每个蛋白有若干个，且常常构成酶的活性位点盖子和抗体互补决定区。老师把它与 RNA 的茎环 stem-loop 混在一起了。
extra.en: Omega loops are not vanishingly rare in proteins. The Ω-loop was defined and catalogued in protein structures by Leszczynski and Rose (1986) as a common irregular element, a lasso whose first and last Cα are close together, occurring several times in an average protein and often forming enzyme active-site lids and antibody CDRs. The lecture conflates it with the RNA stem-loop.

extra.tag: 常见误解 · common misconception
extra.zh: 「无规卷曲 random coil」这个名字骗人。在一个已折叠的蛋白里，所谓无规卷曲区其实有确定、可重复的构象（晶体结构里能解出坐标），只是没有周期性的规律，所以叫「无规则」而不是「随机」。真正意义上的 random coil 指的是变性后的多肽链，那才是构象在系综中随机采样。
extra.en: The name random coil misleads. Within a folded protein, a so-called random-coil region has a definite, reproducible conformation with coordinates resolvable in a crystal structure; it merely lacks a repeating regular pattern, so irregular is meant, not random. A genuine random coil is a denatured chain, whose conformation really is sampled at random across an ensemble.

extra.tag: loop 为什么重要 · why loops matter
extra.zh: 老师说 turn 和 loop「很少提到」，但功能上它们往往是最关键的：抗体的抗原结合位点 CDR 全部是 loop，酶的底物特异性主要由活性口袋周围的 loop 决定，蛋白酶切位点、磷酸化位点、蛋白降解信号也多在柔性 loop 上。在晶体结构里这些区域 B 因子最高、甚至无电子密度而缺失——「结构里看不见」不等于「不存在」，通常正相反，说明它很灵活。
extra.en: The lecture treats turns and loops as seldom discussed, yet functionally they are often the decisive parts: antibody CDRs are entirely loops, enzyme substrate specificity is set mainly by the loops around the active-site pocket, and protease sites, phosphorylation sites and degradation signals sit mostly on flexible loops. In crystal structures these regions have the highest B-factors and may be missing for lack of density — invisible in the structure does not mean absent, usually the opposite, it means mobile.

quiz.q_zh: 在一段蛋白序列中，哪一组氨基酸出现最提示这里可能是一个 β 转角？
quiz.q_en: Which set of residues in a stretch of sequence most suggests a β-turn?

options.zh: 甘氨酸 Gly 与脯氨酸 Pro
options.en: Glycine and proline

options.zh: 半胱氨酸 Cys 与甲硫氨酸 Met
options.en: Cysteine and methionine

options.zh: 缬氨酸 Val 与异亮氨酸 Ile
options.en: Valine and isoleucine

options.zh: 丙氨酸 Ala 与亮氨酸 Leu
options.en: Alanine and leucine

quiz.explain_zh: 脯氨酸提供固定的折角、甘氨酸提供 180° 反转所需的构象自由度并且不产生位阻，二者正是 β 转角的标志性残基。选 Ala/Leu 最诱人：它们侧链不大、看起来「随和」，但它们恰恰是螺旋倾向最高的残基，出现在序列里提示的是 α helix 而不是转角。Val/Ile 是 β 链倾向最高的残基，提示的是 β sheet。
quiz.explain_en: Proline supplies a fixed bend and glycine the backbone freedom for a 180° reversal without steric clash, making them the signature residues of a β-turn. Ala/Leu is the strongest distractor: their side chains are modest and look accommodating, but they are the residues with the highest helix propensity and signal an α-helix, not a turn. Val/Ile have the highest β-strand propensity and signal a sheet.

quiz.q_zh: 在一个晶体结构中，某段肽链方向反转了大约 180°，但序列中既无甘氨酸也无脯氨酸，且该段的 B 因子明显偏高。最恰当的描述是？
quiz.q_en: In a crystal structure a stretch of chain reverses direction by about 180°, but its sequence contains neither glycine nor proline and its B-factors are notably high. What is the best description?

options.zh: 一段靠链间氢键固定的反平行 β sheet
options.en: Antiparallel β-sheet fixed by interstrand bonds

options.zh: 一个由 i→i+3 氢键固定的 type II β 转角
options.en: A type II β-turn fixed by an i→i+3 hydrogen bond

options.zh: 一段每圈约三个残基的 3₁₀ 螺旋
options.en: A 3₁₀ helix with about three residues per turn

options.zh: 一段没有固定氢键的柔性环 flexible loop
options.en: A flexible loop with no fixed hydrogen bonding

quiz.explain_zh: 「转了 180°」只是几何结果，不足以定义 β 转角；β 转角要求有 i→i+3 氢键这种主动维持的力，且典型地含 Gly/Pro。这里两个特征都不满足，加上高 B 因子说明它柔性大，属于 flexible loop。选「type II β 转角」是最诱人的错误——恰恰相反，type II 转角在 i+2 位必须是甘氨酸，而这段没有甘氨酸。
quiz.explain_en: Turning by 180° is only a geometric outcome and does not define a β-turn; a β-turn requires an actively maintaining force, the i→i+3 hydrogen bond, and typically Gly or Pro. Neither is present here, and the high B-factors indicate mobility, so it is a flexible loop. The type II β-turn option is the tempting one and is precisely excluded: a type II turn must have glycine at i+2, and there is no glycine.

title_zh: α 角蛋白、二硫键与烫发的化学
title_en: α-keratin, disulfide bonds and the chemistry of a perm

points.zh: 插曲：经典生物化学不包含光合作用一章，没学过是正常的；但老师提醒口试时若被问到会很被动，建议还是补上 C3/C4 循环和 Z 型电子传递（他自己也说这一章很难）。
points.en: Aside: classical biochemistry does not include a photosynthesis chapter, so not having studied it is normal, but the teacher warns that being asked about it in an oral exam is fatal and advises covering the C3/C4 cycles and the Z-scheme of electron transfer, which he calls very hard.

points.zh: 按二级结构组成可以给蛋白分类：有些蛋白几乎全部由 α helix 组成，最典型的例子是角蛋白 keratin，分 α 角蛋白和 β 角蛋白。
points.en: Proteins can be classified by their secondary-structure content: some consist almost entirely of α-helices, the classic case being keratin, which comes in α- and β-forms.

points.zh: α 角蛋白 α-keratin 全部由 α helix 相互缠绕形成；最典型的实例是人的头发。
points.en: α-keratin is built entirely from α-helices wound around one another; the textbook example is human hair.

points.zh: α 角蛋白上有很多半胱氨酸 cysteine，这些 cysteine 使相邻的 α helix 之间形成交联的二硫键 disulfide bond，这就是头发机械强度的来源。
points.en: α-keratin is rich in cysteine, and those cysteines cross-link adjacent helices through disulfide bonds, which is where hair gets its mechanical strength.

points.zh: 烫发第一步：涂还原剂 reducing agent，把头发里 α helix 之间的二硫键全部打开，这时头发变得非常软。
points.en: Perming step one: apply a reducing agent that opens all the disulfide bonds between the helices, at which point the hair becomes very soft.

points.zh: 烫发第二步：按想要的形状定型之后再涂氧化剂 oxidizing agent，让打开的二硫键在人为改造过的新位置重新形成，发型就固定下来了。
points.en: Perming step two: after shaping the hair, apply an oxidising agent so the opened disulfides re-form in the newly imposed positions, locking in the style.

points.zh: 新长出来的头发不受影响：它按自身固有的方式重新形成二硫键，所以呈现原本的状态——这也是为什么烫发会「长出来」。
points.en: Newly grown hair is unaffected because its disulfides form in the original pattern, so it shows the natural shape, which is why a perm grows out.

points.zh: 气味来源：这些氧化还原试剂大多含硫，很臭；实验室里巯基乙醇 β-mercaptoethanol 尤其臭，DTT 相对好一些，DTT 专门用来还原二硫键、有微量毒性，但烫发用的肯定不是 DTT。
points.en: Source of the smell: these redox reagents mostly contain sulfur and stink; in the lab β-mercaptoethanol is the worst while DTT is milder. DTT is the standard reagent for reducing disulfides and is slightly toxic, but it is certainly not what is used on hair.

extra.tag: 角蛋白结构更正 · keratin structure corrected
extra.zh: 老师后面说 α 角蛋白是「三条小电线拧成一个左手螺旋」。标准结构是：两条右手 α helix 相互缠绕成一个左手的 coiled coil 卷曲螺旋（二聚体，不是三条），靠七肽重复 heptad repeat a-b-c-d-e-f-g 中 a、d 两位的疏水残基咬合；再由二聚体组装成原纤维、微纤维、直到发丝。三股螺旋是胶原蛋白的特征，别把两者的股数记串。
extra.en: The lecture later describes α-keratin as three wires twisted into a left-handed helix. The standard structure is two right-handed α-helices wound into a left-handed coiled coil, a dimer not a trimer, held by hydrophobic residues at the a and d positions of a heptad repeat a-b-c-d-e-f-g; dimers then assemble into protofilaments, microfibrils and finally the hair shaft. The three-stranded helix belongs to collagen, so do not swap the strand counts.

extra.tag: 烫发的实际试剂 · the actual perm reagents
extra.zh: 第一剂通常是巯基乙酸铵 ammonium thioglycolate（碱性，故有氨味），第二剂即「中和剂」是过氧化氢 H₂O₂ 或溴酸钠 sodium bromate。直发膏用的是同一化学过程，只是定型方向不同。相对的，β 角蛋白 β-keratin 是 β sheet 构成的，见于蚕丝丝心蛋白 silk fibroin、羽毛、爬行动物鳞片。
extra.en: The first lotion is usually ammonium thioglycolate, alkaline, which is why it smells of ammonia; the second, the neutraliser, is hydrogen peroxide or sodium bromate. Chemical straighteners use the same chemistry with a different shaping step. By contrast β-keratin is built from β-sheets and is found in silk fibroin, feathers and reptile scales.

extra.tag: 为什么会长回去 · why hair reverts
extra.zh: 更准确的说法：哪几对半胱氨酸能配对，是由一级结构上 Cys 的位置以及毛囊挤出发丝时的几何决定的。烫发并没有改变序列，只是把配对关系临时换了一组；毛囊继续按老程序合成、老几何配对，所以新发段回到原状。同理，头发的天然卷直程度主要由毛囊的截面形状和二硫键交联密度决定，是遗传性状。
extra.en: More precisely: which cysteines pair is set by their positions in the primary structure and by the geometry with which the follicle extrudes the shaft. A perm changes neither, only the pairing, temporarily; the follicle keeps synthesising and pairing as before, so newly grown hair returns to type. Likewise natural curliness is governed mainly by follicle cross-section and cross-link density, and is heritable.

extra.tag: 考点连接 · link to cell biology
extra.zh: 二硫键的形成需要氧化环境：真核细胞里它们在内质网 ER 腔中由蛋白二硫键异构酶 PDI 催化形成，胞质 cytosol 因为有谷胱甘肽 glutathione 维持还原环境，正常不含稳定的二硫键。这就是为什么分泌蛋白和细胞外蛋白（抗体、胰岛素）富含二硫键，而胞内蛋白很少。实验对应：SDS-PAGE 上样缓冲液里加 DTT 或 β-ME，就是为了拆掉这些键让蛋白彻底变性。
extra.en: Disulfide formation needs an oxidising environment: in eukaryotes they are formed in the ER lumen by protein disulfide isomerase, while the cytosol is kept reducing by glutathione and normally holds no stable disulfides. Hence secreted and extracellular proteins such as antibodies and insulin are disulfide-rich while cytosolic proteins are not. The lab counterpart is adding DTT or β-mercaptoethanol to SDS-PAGE sample buffer precisely to break these bonds and fully denature the protein.

quiz.q_zh: 烫发时两剂药水的化学作用顺序是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the chemical sequence of the two lotions used in a perm?

options.zh: 先用还原剂打开二硫键，塑形后用氧化剂在新位置重建
options.en: A reductant opens the disulfides, then an oxidant re-forms them in new places

options.zh: 先用碱水解主链肽键，塑形后再让肽键在新位置连接
options.en: Alkali hydrolyses the backbone peptide bonds, then they rejoin in new places

options.zh: 先破坏氢键使 α helix 变成 β sheet，塑形后再让它复原
options.en: Hydrogen bonds break, turning α-helix to β-sheet, then the bonds are restored

options.zh: 先用氧化剂打开二硫键，塑形后用还原剂在新位置重建
options.en: An oxidant opens the disulfides, then a reductant re-forms them in new places

quiz.explain_zh: 二硫键 R–S–S–R 是氧化态，要打开必须还原成两个 –SH；重新交联则必须氧化。所以顺序一定是先还原后氧化。选「先氧化后还原」把方向记反了，是最常见的错。选「水解肽键」更严重：如果真的水解了主链，头发就断了而不是变卷——烫发全程不动共价的主链，只动侧链上的二硫键。
quiz.explain_en: A disulfide R–S–S–R is the oxidised state, so opening it requires reduction to two free thiols and re-cross-linking requires oxidation: reductant first, oxidant second. The oxidant-first option reverses this and is the commonest error. The peptide-hydrolysis option is worse: cutting the backbone would break the hair rather than curl it, and a perm never touches the covalent backbone, only the side-chain disulfides.

quiz.q_zh: 为什么烫过的头发在几个月后靠近头皮的一段会恢复原来的形状？
quiz.q_en: Why does permed hair return to its original shape near the scalp after a few months?

options.zh: 因为角质层中的蛋白酶把角蛋白降解后又重新排列
options.en: Proteases in the cuticle degrade the keratin and rearrange the shaft

options.zh: 因为新长出的角蛋白按原序列和毛囊几何重新交联
options.en: New keratin cross-links by the unchanged sequence and follicle shape

options.zh: 因为二硫键在体温和体液中会缓慢地自发水解断开
options.en: The disulfide bonds slowly hydrolyse by themselves at body temperature

options.zh: 因为洗发水中的表面活性剂把弯曲的发干逐渐洗直
options.en: Surfactants in shampoo progressively straighten the curled hair shaft

quiz.explain_zh: 毛干是死细胞里的角蛋白，不会自我重塑；变化的只是毛囊持续挤出新的一段。新段的序列和成型过程都没被改动，所以是天然形状。选「二硫键自发水解」很像那么回事，但二硫键在细胞外相当稳定，正是因为稳定它才能给头发提供长期的机械强度——如果它自发水解，烫发也就不可能定型几个月。
quiz.explain_en: The hair shaft is keratin in dead cells and does not remodel itself; what changes is that the follicle keeps extruding new shaft. Neither the sequence nor the shaping of that new segment was altered, so it grows in its natural shape. The spontaneous-hydrolysis option sounds plausible, but disulfides are quite stable extracellularly, which is exactly why they give hair lasting mechanical strength; if they hydrolysed on their own, a perm could not hold for months.

title_zh: 胶原蛋白：三股螺旋、羟基化氨基酸与「劣质蛋白」
title_en: Collagen: the triple helix, hydroxylated residues, and why it is a poor dietary protein

points.zh: 胶原蛋白 collagen 是人体结缔组织 connective tissue 的主要蛋白；它不是一个有固定形状的球状蛋白，而是纤维状的结构材料。
points.en: Collagen is the principal protein of connective tissue: not a globular protein with a fixed shape but a fibrous structural material.

points.zh: 老师给的结构图像：三股左手螺旋拧成一股右手的超螺旋，像三根细电线拧成一根大电线，整根大电线是右手旋的。
points.en: The picture given: three left-handed helices twisted into one right-handed superhelix, like three thin wires twisted into a thick cable that is itself right-handed.

points.zh: 与 α 角蛋白的对照：α 角蛋白是几股螺旋拧成一个左手螺旋，胶原蛋白则是拧成右手螺旋——旋向正好相反。
points.en: Contrast with α-keratin: keratin's helices twist into a left-handed supercoil, collagen's into a right-handed one, opposite senses.

points.zh: 关键限定：胶原蛋白虽然由螺旋组成，但它不是经典的 α helix。
points.en: Key qualification: although collagen is helical, it is not a classical α-helix.

points.zh: 原因在于它含有两种特殊的修饰氨基酸：羟脯氨酸 hydroxyproline 和羟赖氨酸 hydroxylysine。
points.en: The reason is that it contains two specially modified residues: hydroxyproline and hydroxylysine.

points.zh: 正因为有这两种修饰氨基酸，胶原蛋白能容忍大量的甘氨酸和脯氨酸，而普通的 α helix 恰恰不能容忍这两个。
points.en: Because of these modifications collagen tolerates large amounts of glycine and proline, exactly the two residues an ordinary α-helix cannot accommodate.

points.zh: 生活中的常见误区被点破：胶原蛋白不是优质蛋白，而是劣质蛋白。
points.en: A popular misconception is corrected: collagen is not a high-quality protein but a poor one.

points.zh: 理由：它富含甘氨酸和脯氨酸/羟脯氨酸，而人体除了在转角处以外并不大量需要这两种氨基酸，因此摄取胶原蛋白不能有效补充人体所需的氨基酸。
points.en: The reason given: it is loaded with glycine and proline/hydroxyproline, which the body needs in bulk only at turns, so eating collagen does not efficiently supply the amino acids the body requires.

extra.tag: 三股螺旋的真相 · what the triple helix really is
extra.zh: 课上说「三股左手 α helix」，这里要精确化：胶原蛋白的每一股是左手的聚脯氨酸 II 型螺旋 polyproline II helix，每圈约 3 个残基、伸展得多，与 α helix（右手、3.6 残基/圈）完全不同；三股再缠成右手超螺旋。序列是严格的 (Gly-X-Y)ₙ 重复，X 常为脯氨酸 Pro、Y 常为 4-羟脯氨酸 4-Hyp。甘氨酸每隔两位必须出现一次，因为三股螺旋轴心极其拥挤，只有氢原子这么小的侧链塞得进去。任何一个 Gly 被突变成别的残基都会破坏整根纤维——这就是成骨不全症 osteogenesis imperfecta（脆骨病）的分子基础。
extra.en: The lecture says three left-handed α-helices; the precise version is that each strand is a left-handed polyproline II helix with about three residues per turn and much more extended, entirely unlike an α-helix (right-handed, 3.6 per turn), and the three wind into a right-handed superhelix. The sequence is a strict (Gly-X-Y)ₙ repeat with X often proline and Y often 4-hydroxyproline. Glycine must appear at every third position because the axis of the triple helix is so crowded that only a hydrogen-sized side chain fits. Mutating a single Gly to anything else wrecks the whole fibre, which is the molecular basis of osteogenesis imperfecta.

extra.tag: 维生素C 的连接 · the vitamin C connection
extra.zh: 羟脯氨酸不是由 tRNA 直接掺入的，而是脯氨酸掺入肽链后由脯氨酰-4-羟化酶 prolyl-4-hydroxylase 翻译后修饰而来；该酶需要 Fe²⁺、α-酮戊二酸 α-ketoglutarate、O₂ 和抗坏血酸 ascorbate（维生素 C）作为辅因子，维生素 C 的作用是把酶中被氧化的 Fe³⁺ 还原回 Fe²⁺。缺维生素 C → 羟脯氨酸不足 → 三股螺旋链间氢键网络不稳、熔点下降 → 胶原纤维脆弱 → 坏血病 scurvy（牙龈出血、伤口不愈、血管脆）。这是生化口试里出镜率极高的一条因果链。
extra.en: Hydroxyproline is not inserted by tRNA; proline is incorporated first and then modified post-translationally by prolyl-4-hydroxylase, an enzyme requiring Fe²⁺, α-ketoglutarate, O₂ and ascorbate, vitamin C's role being to re-reduce the enzyme's oxidised Fe³⁺ back to Fe²⁺. No vitamin C means too little hydroxyproline, an unstable interchain hydrogen-bond network with a lowered melting temperature, fragile collagen fibres and scurvy: bleeding gums, wounds that will not heal, fragile vessels. This causal chain is a perennial oral-exam favourite.

extra.tag: 劣质蛋白的教科书理由 · the textbook reason collagen is incomplete
extra.zh: 老师的理由方向对但不是标准表述。营养学上判定「完全/优质蛋白 complete protein」的标准是是否含有全部必需氨基酸 essential amino acids 且比例合适。胶原蛋白几乎完全不含色氨酸 tryptophan（这是它区别于几乎所有其他蛋白的特点，历史上就靠这一点鉴定），且缺乏半胱氨酸、酪氨酸、蛋氨酸，因此是不完全蛋白 incomplete protein。附带一条：口服的胶原蛋白同样会被消化成氨基酸和小肽吸收，不会「定向」补到皮肤上。
