extra.en: The teacher's reasoning points the right way but is not the standard formulation. Nutritionally, a complete or high-quality protein is defined by containing all essential amino acids in adequate proportion. Collagen contains essentially no tryptophan at all, a peculiarity that historically served to identify it, and is poor in cysteine, tyrosine and methionine, making it an incomplete protein. A corollary: ingested collagen is digested to amino acids and small peptides like any other protein and is not routed to the skin.

extra.tag: 还有一种交联 · a second kind of cross-link
extra.zh: 胶原纤维的强度不像角蛋白那样靠二硫键（它几乎不含半胱氨酸），而是靠赖氨酰氧化酶 lysyl oxidase 把赖氨酸/羟赖氨酸的侧链氨基氧化成醛，再自发缩合成共价交联，随年龄增长交联增多、组织变硬。该酶依赖铜 Cu²⁺，所以铜缺乏也会导致结缔组织病变；这与「维生素 C—羟化」是两条独立的通路，考试常放在一起比较。
extra.en: Collagen fibres are not strengthened by disulfides as keratin is, since collagen has almost no cysteine; instead lysyl oxidase oxidises the side-chain amines of lysine and hydroxylysine to aldehydes that condense spontaneously into covalent cross-links, which accumulate with age and stiffen the tissue. That enzyme requires copper, so copper deficiency also causes connective-tissue disease. This is a pathway separate from vitamin C-dependent hydroxylation, and the two are often compared in exams.

quiz.q_zh: 胶原蛋白的序列是 (Gly-X-Y)ₙ 重复，甘氨酸必须每隔两位出现一次。原因是什么？
quiz.q_en: Collagen's sequence is a (Gly-X-Y)ₙ repeat with glycine obligatory at every third position. Why?

options.zh: 三股螺旋的中心轴极其拥挤，只有氢原子侧链塞得进去
options.en: The triple-helix axis is so crowded only a hydrogen side chain fits

options.zh: 甘氨酸是脯氨酰羟化酶的底物，羟脯氨酸由它转化而来
options.en: Glycine is the hydroxylase substrate from which hydroxyproline is made

options.zh: 甘氨酸的侧链带负电荷，与相邻链的正电残基相吸引
options.en: Glycine's side chain is negative and attracts the neighbouring strands

options.zh: 只有甘氨酸的主链能提供链间氢键所需的 N–H 供体
options.en: Only glycine's backbone supplies the N–H needed for interchain bonding

quiz.explain_zh: 三条链缠得极紧，每条链上朝向中心轴的那个位置只剩下容纳一个氢原子的空间，所以那一位必须是甘氨酸。选「只有甘氨酸能提供 N–H」很诱人，因为氢键确实维系三股链，但主链 N–H 每个残基（脯氨酸除外）都有，不是甘氨酸的特权；而羟化的底物是脯氨酸和赖氨酸，不是甘氨酸，甘氨酸的侧链也只是一个氢原子，不带电荷。
quiz.explain_en: The three strands pack so tightly that the position facing the central axis has room for only a hydrogen atom, so it must be glycine. The N–H option is tempting because hydrogen bonds do hold the three strands together, but every residue except proline has a backbone N–H, so this is not glycine's privilege; the hydroxylase substrates are proline and lysine, not glycine, and glycine's side chain is a lone uncharged hydrogen.

quiz.q_zh: 坏血病 scurvy 中结缔组织脆弱的分子机制是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the molecular mechanism of the fragile connective tissue in scurvy?

options.zh: 维生素 C 缺乏使胶原蛋白基因的转录水平大幅度下降
options.en: Vitamin C loss sharply lowers transcription of the collagen gene cluster

options.zh: 维生素 C 缺乏使脯氨酰羟化酶失活，羟脯氨酸严重不足
options.en: Vitamin C loss inactivates prolyl hydroxylase, so hydroxyproline is low

options.zh: 维生素 C 缺乏使 tRNA 无法把羟脯氨酸掺入新生胶原链
options.en: Vitamin C loss stops tRNA inserting hydroxyproline into the new chains

options.zh: 维生素 C 缺乏使胶原蛋白链间的二硫键无法氧化形成
options.en: Vitamin C loss prevents collagen's interchain disulfides from being made

quiz.explain_zh: 维生素 C 是脯氨酰-4-羟化酶的辅因子，负责把酶活性中心被氧化的 Fe³⁺ 还原回 Fe²⁺；酶失活则羟脯氨酸不足，链间氢键网络削弱，三股螺旋的熔点降到体温以下，纤维塌掉。选「tRNA 掺入羟脯氨酸」是最诱人的错误：羟脯氨酸根本不是由 tRNA 掺入的，它是翻译后修饰产物，没有对应的密码子。选「二硫键」那项也错，胶原蛋白几乎不含半胱氨酸，靠的是赖氨酰氧化酶介导的醛交联。
quiz.explain_en: Vitamin C is the cofactor of prolyl-4-hydroxylase, re-reducing the enzyme's oxidised Fe³⁺ to Fe²⁺; without it hydroxyproline is scarce, the interchain hydrogen-bond network weakens, the triple helix's melting point falls below body temperature and the fibres collapse. The tRNA option is the strongest distractor: hydroxyproline is never inserted by tRNA, it is a post-translational modification with no codon of its own. The disulfide option is also wrong, since collagen has almost no cysteine and is cross-linked instead by lysyl oxidase-derived aldehyde links.

quiz.q_zh: 从营养学角度说胶原蛋白是「不完全蛋白 incomplete protein」，最标准的理由是？
quiz.q_en: From a nutritional standpoint, what is the standard reason collagen counts as an incomplete protein?

options.zh: 它是纤维状蛋白，人的消化酶无法把它水解成氨基酸
options.en: It is fibrous, and human digestive enzymes cannot hydrolyse it at all

options.zh: 它含羟脯氨酸这种非标准氨基酸，肠道对它无法吸收
options.en: It contains hydroxyproline, a non-standard residue the gut cannot absorb

options.zh: 它的分子量太大，无法通过肠壁进入血液被机体利用
options.en: Its molecular weight is too great to be absorbed across the gut wall

options.zh: 它几乎不含色氨酸，其他几种必需氨基酸含量也偏低
options.en: It has essentially no tryptophan and little of several other essentials

quiz.explain_zh: 完全蛋白的判据是含齐全部必需氨基酸；胶原蛋白色氨酸含量几乎为零，属于典型的限制性氨基酸缺乏。选「分子量太大不能通过肠壁」是常见的直觉错误：所有膳食蛋白都要先被消化成氨基酸和二/三肽才吸收，分子量与吸收无关，胶原蛋白经加热变成明胶后同样能被完全消化。
quiz.explain_en: Completeness is judged by whether all essential amino acids are present; collagen's tryptophan content is essentially zero, a textbook limiting-amino-acid deficiency. The molecular-weight option is a common intuitive error: every dietary protein is digested to amino acids and di/tripeptides before absorption, so size is irrelevant, and collagen denatured to gelatin is digested perfectly well.

title_zh: 超二级结构、结构域与三级结构的包含关系
title_en: Supersecondary structure, domains, and how they nest inside tertiary structure

points.zh: 超二级结构 supersecondary structure 的定义：由若干个二级结构彼此相互作用形成的、有规律的组合。
points.en: Definition of supersecondary structure: a regular combination formed by several elements of secondary structure interacting with one another.

points.zh: 关键判据（老师强调「一定要记住」）：超二级结构还没有形成一个明确的功能结构域，也就是还没达到三级结构的层次。
points.en: The decisive criterion, emphasised as must-remember: a supersecondary structure has not yet formed a defined functional domain, i.e. it has not reached the tertiary level.

points.zh: 常见命名：αα、βαβ、ββ、Rossmann 折叠、β 曲折等等，都是上个世纪搞生化的人取的名字。
points.en: The common names, αα, βαβ, ββ, the Rossmann fold, the β-meander and so on, were coined by biochemists of the last century.

points.zh: 老师的态度：这类组合在生物体里非常多，但现在基本不再提这个概念，可以摒弃。
points.en: The teacher's position: such combinations are extremely common in nature but the concept is no longer used much and can be dropped.

points.zh: 三级结构 tertiary structure 的判据：一般认为达到三级结构就存在一个明确的功能结构域，能行使一定的功能了。
points.en: The criterion for tertiary structure: at this level there is a defined functional domain that can carry out a function.

points.zh: 结构域 domain 的定义：由两个或以上相对独立的三维结构单元构成，并且执行特定功能，才称为结构域；概念上已经很接近三级结构。
points.en: Definition of a domain: two or more relatively independent three-dimensional units that carry out a specific function; conceptually it is already close to tertiary structure.

points.zh: 结构域之间通常由没有太多结构的、松散的肽段连接起来。
points.en: Domains are usually joined by loose, largely unstructured stretches of peptide.

points.zh: 实例：DNA 聚合酶的 fingers、thumb、palm 三个区域，每一个都是一个独立的结构域，中间靠松散的肽段相连。
points.en: Example: the fingers, thumb and palm regions of DNA polymerase are each a separate domain, linked by loose peptide.

points.zh: 包含关系：三级结构指球状蛋白整条多肽链在二级结构、结构域组装完成后的整体结构；结构域包含在三级结构里，一个三级结构可以包含几个不同的结构域（聚合酶就是 3 个）。至于「全 α 蛋白」「全 β 蛋白」这类分类，老师认为没有意义，不用看。
points.en: The nesting relation: tertiary structure is the overall structure of a globular protein's whole chain once its secondary structures and domains are assembled, and domains sit inside it, one tertiary structure being able to contain several different domains, three in the polymerase case. Classifications such as all-α and all-β proteins are dismissed as not worth studying.

extra.tag: Rossmann 折叠是什么 · what the Rossmann fold is
extra.zh: 转录里的「Rossman 反折叠」是语音识别把 Rossmann fold 弄花了。它是 β-α-β-α-β 的超二级结构，六条平行 β 链形成片层、两侧被 α helix 夹住，专门结合 NAD⁺/NADP⁺ 等二核苷酸辅因子；在第一个 β-α 交接处有一段富甘氨酸的 GxGxxG 指纹序列，用来兜住焦磷酸基团。看到这个序列基序几乎就能预言这是一个脱氢酶。β 曲折 β-meander 指的是相邻 β 链依次首尾相接形成的反平行片层，还有一个常考的是希腊钥匙 Greek key。
extra.en: The transcript's garbled Rossman is the Rossmann fold. It is a β-α-β-α-β supersecondary unit in which six parallel strands form a sheet sandwiched by helices, and it binds dinucleotide cofactors such as NAD⁺ and NADP⁺; a glycine-rich GxGxxG fingerprint at the first β-α junction cradles the pyrophosphate. Spotting that motif in a sequence is almost enough to predict a dehydrogenase. The β-meander is an antiparallel sheet made of consecutive strands joined end to end, and the Greek key is the other commonly examined arrangement.

extra.tag: 结构域的量化判据 · an operational test for a domain
extra.zh: 老师的定义偏描述性。可操作的判据有三条：(1) 大小通常约 40–200 个残基；(2) 能独立折叠——把编码它的那段基因单独表达出来，蛋白往往仍能折叠成同样的结构并保留功能，这是实验上鉴定结构域的金标准；(3) 是进化重组的基本单位，通过外显子/结构域重排 domain shuffling 在不同蛋白间反复出现（如 SH2、SH3、免疫球蛋白折叠）。
extra.en: The lecture's definition is descriptive. Three operational tests exist: (1) size is typically 40–200 residues; (2) it folds independently — express just that segment of the gene and the protein usually still folds to the same structure and keeps its activity, which is the experimental gold standard; (3) it is the unit of evolutionary recombination, recurring across unrelated proteins by domain shuffling, as with SH2, SH3 and the immunoglobulin fold.

extra.tag: 衔接四级结构 · link to quaternary structure
extra.zh: 课上到三级结构就停了，把层级补全：一级 primary = 氨基酸序列；二级 secondary = 局部规则构象；三级 tertiary = 一条多肽链的完整三维结构；四级 quaternary = 多条独立多肽链（亚基 subunits）之间的空间排布，如血红蛋白 α₂β₂。要害区分：结构域是一条链的一部分，永远不跨链；亚基是一条完整的链。「一个蛋白有三个结构域」和「一个蛋白由三个亚基组成」是完全不同的陈述，这是高频混淆点。
extra.en: The lecture stops at tertiary, so complete the hierarchy: primary is the amino-acid sequence, secondary the local regular conformation, tertiary the full three-dimensional structure of one polypeptide chain, and quaternary the spatial arrangement of several separate chains or subunits, as in haemoglobin's α₂β₂. The crucial distinction: a domain is part of one chain and never spans two, while a subunit is a whole chain. Saying a protein has three domains and saying it has three subunits are entirely different claims, and this is a frequent confusion.

extra.tag: motif 的两个含义 · two meanings of motif
extra.zh: 中文的「基序/模体 motif」在考试里有两个意思，答题前要辨明：结构基序 structural motif 指 βαβ、螺旋-转角-螺旋 helix-turn-helix 这类空间排布（即超二级结构）；序列基序 sequence motif 指 GxGxxG、锌指的 C₂H₂ 这类保守序列模式。两者常常对应但不等价——同一个结构基序可以由完全不相关的序列实现，这正是「结构比序列保守」这条通则的来源。
extra.en: Motif has two meanings in exams and the sense must be pinned down before answering: a structural motif is a spatial arrangement such as βαβ or helix-turn-helix, i.e. supersecondary structure, while a sequence motif is a conserved sequence pattern such as GxGxxG or the C₂H₂ of a zinc finger. The two often correspond but are not equivalent, since the same structural motif can be built from wholly unrelated sequences, which is the origin of the rule that structure is more conserved than sequence.

quiz.q_zh: 区分超二级结构与结构域，最关键的判据是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the decisive criterion distinguishing a supersecondary structure from a domain?

options.zh: 超二级结构由主链氢键维持，结构域由二硫键交联维持
options.en: Supersecondary units are held by hydrogen bonds; domains by disulfide bonds

options.zh: 超二级结构总位于蛋白质表面，结构域总埋在分子内部
options.en: Supersecondary units sit on the surface; domains are buried in the interior

options.zh: 超二级结构只由 α helix 构成，结构域必须同时含 α 与 β
options.en: Supersecondary units contain only α-helices; domains contain both α and β

options.zh: 超二级结构只是二级结构的组合，结构域能独立折叠且有功能
options.en: Supersecondary units only combine elements; domains fold alone and function

quiz.explain_zh: 判据是「有没有形成明确的功能单元」，不是组成成分或键的类型。选「超二级结构只含 α helix」最诱人，因为 αα、βαβ 这些名字看起来像在按组成分类，但 βαβ 明明同时含 α 和 β，仍然只是超二级结构——可见组成不是判据；键的类型和空间位置更与此无关。
quiz.explain_en: The criterion is whether a defined functional unit has been formed, not composition or bond type. The α-helix-only option is the most tempting because names like αα and βαβ look like a compositional classification, yet βαβ plainly contains both α and β and is still only supersecondary, showing composition is not the test; bond type and surface location are irrelevant.

quiz.q_zh: DNA 聚合酶的 fingers、thumb、palm 分别是一个结构域，它们同属一条多肽链。下列描述正确的是？
quiz.q_en: The fingers, thumb and palm of DNA polymerase are each a domain, and all lie on one polypeptide chain. Which description is correct?

options.zh: 一个由三个亚基组成的四级结构
options.en: A quaternary structure built from three subunits

options.zh: 三个各自独立的三级结构
options.en: Three separate and independent tertiary structures

options.zh: 一个包含三个结构域的三级结构
options.en: One tertiary structure containing three domains

options.zh: 一个由三段组成的超二级结构
options.en: A supersecondary structure made of three parts

quiz.explain_zh: 三级结构描述的是一条完整多肽链的整体三维构象，结构域是它内部相对独立的功能单元，所以「一个三级结构包含三个结构域」。选「三个亚基的四级结构」是最经典的混淆：四级结构要求是多条独立的多肽链，而这里只有一条链，结构域之间靠松散肽段共价相连，不构成四级结构。
quiz.explain_en: Tertiary structure describes the overall three-dimensional conformation of one complete chain, and domains are the relatively independent functional units within it, hence one tertiary structure containing three domains. The three-subunit quaternary option is the classic confusion: quaternary structure requires several separate chains, whereas here there is a single chain whose domains are joined covalently by loose linkers.

quiz.q_zh: 在一段未知蛋白序列中发现了 GxGxxG 这一富甘氨酸的保守序列，位于一个 β-α-β 单元的交接处。最合理的推测是？
quiz.q_en: An unknown protein sequence contains the glycine-rich conserved pattern GxGxxG at the junction of a β-α-β unit. What is the most reasonable inference?

options.zh: 一段跨膜螺旋区，富甘氨酸的序列使主链能穿过磷脂双分子层
options.en: A transmembrane segment whose glycines let the backbone cross the bilayer

options.zh: Rossmann 折叠的辅因子结合环，结合 NAD(P)
options.en: A Rossmann-fold cofactor loop, so the protein most likely binds NAD(P)

options.zh: 一段信号肽的核心，富甘氨酸序列构成信号肽酶识别的切割位点
options.en: A signal peptide whose glycines form the signal peptidase cleavage site

options.zh: 此处一定形成一个 β 转角，甘氨酸提供反转所需的构象柔性
options.en: It must be a β-turn, the glycines giving the flexibility for the reversal

quiz.explain_zh: GxGxxG 位于 β-α-β 交接处正是 Rossmann 折叠的经典指纹，甘氨酸的柔性使这段主链能紧紧兜住 NAD(P) 的焦磷酸基团，提示脱氢酶或其他二核苷酸结合酶。选「一定形成 β 转角」很诱人，因为甘氨酸确实是转角的标志残基，但这里的上下文（β-α-β 单元的交接、周期性的 GxG 重复）指向的是辅因子结合环，而不是任意的 180° 转角；跨膜区应富含疏水残基而不是甘氨酸，信号肽在 N 端且切割位点由小侧链的 Ala-X-Ala 而非甘氨酸富集区决定，都不符。
quiz.explain_en: GxGxxG at a β-α-β junction is the textbook fingerprint of a Rossmann fold, where glycine's flexibility lets the backbone wrap tightly around the pyrophosphate of NAD(P), pointing to a dehydrogenase or other dinucleotide-binding enzyme. The must-be-a-β-turn option is tempting because glycine really is the signature residue of turns, but the context here, a β-α-β junction with a periodic GxG repeat, indicates a cofactor-binding loop rather than an arbitrary 180° reversal. A transmembrane segment would be hydrophobic rather than glycine-rich, and a signal peptide sits at the N-terminus with an Ala-X-Ala cleavage site, not a glycine-rich box; neither fits.

title_zh: 一级结构决定高级结构：RNase A 复性实验与折叠的热力学驱动力
title_en: Primary structure dictates higher-order structure: the RNase A refolding experiment and the thermodynamics of folding

points.zh: 核心结论：蛋白质的一级结构 primary structure（氨基酸序列）决定它的高级结构 higher-order structure，折叠信息全部写在序列里。
points.en: Core conclusion: the primary structure (amino acid sequence) dictates the higher-order structure; all the folding information is written in the sequence itself.

points.zh: 证明实验用的是 RNase A（核糖核酸酶 A ribonuclease A）：先把它变性 denature，再复性 renature，活性可以恢复约 95%。
points.en: The proof is the RNase A (ribonuclease A) experiment: denature it, then renature it, and roughly 95% of the activity comes back.

points.zh: 活性能自发恢复说明折叠是自发过程，不需要外加信息，天然构象 native conformation 是序列在给定溶剂条件下的必然结果。
points.en: Spontaneous recovery of activity shows folding is a spontaneous process needing no extra information; the native conformation is the necessary consequence of the sequence under given solvent conditions.

points.zh: 折叠的根本动力是整个体系的熵增 entropy increase，即体系趋于更混乱，而不是蛋白质分子本身变得更有序这一项。
points.en: The fundamental driving force of folding is the entropy increase of the whole system — the system as a whole becomes more disordered — not the ordering of the protein chain itself.

points.zh: 刚翻译出来的多肽链入水后，肽键 peptide bond 与极性基团能形成氢键 hydrogen bond，把大量水分子束缚在周围，这些水叫有序水分子 ordered water。
points.en: A newly translated polypeptide entering water forms hydrogen bonds through its peptide bonds and polar groups, immobilising many water molecules around it — these are the 'ordered' waters.

points.zh: 疏水相互作用 hydrophobic effect 把疏水侧链埋进内部，同时把这些有序水分子释放回自由水，水的熵大幅上升，驱动折叠。
points.en: The hydrophobic effect buries nonpolar side chains inside and releases those ordered waters back into bulk solvent; the large gain in water entropy drives folding.

points.zh: 反过来，破坏这种平衡（加热、变性剂）就会引起剧烈的去折叠 unfolding，这是后面测 TM 值的物理基础。
points.en: Conversely, disturbing this balance (heat, denaturants) triggers a cooperative unfolding transition — the physical basis of the TM measurement that follows.

extra.tag: 课上未点名 · experiment not named
extra.zh: 这个实验是 Anfinsen 实验（Christian Anfinsen，1972 年诺贝尔化学奖），结论叫 Anfinsen's dogma / 热力学假说 thermodynamic hypothesis。RNase A 有 124 个氨基酸、4 对二硫键 disulfide bonds；用尿素 urea + β-巯基乙醇 β-mercaptoethanol 完全变性还原后，先除去还原剂再除尿素，活性恢复接近 100%；顺序反过来（在尿素还在时先氧化）只得到约 1% 活性的“乱配二硫键 scrambled”产物。考试常考这个先后顺序。
extra.en: This is the Anfinsen experiment (Christian Anfinsen, Nobel Prize in Chemistry 1972); the conclusion is Anfinsen's dogma, the thermodynamic hypothesis. RNase A has 124 residues and 4 disulfide bonds; after full denaturation/reduction with urea plus β-mercaptoethanol, removing the reductant before the urea restores near-full activity, whereas reoxidising while urea is still present gives 'scrambled' disulfides with only about 1% activity. Exams like this ordering.

extra.tag: 老师表述含糊 · phrasing to sharpen
extra.zh: 老师说“侧边会被肽键形成氢键束缚水分子”，这句 ASR 有点乱。准确说法是：束缚有序水（形成 clathrate 笼状水壳）的主要是非极性侧链 nonpolar side chains，因为水无法与它们氢键，只能在其表面重排；折叠把这些侧链埋起来，笼状水被释放。主链肽键的氢键则主要在二级结构内部相互满足。
extra.en: The lecture's line about peptide bonds trapping water is garbled. Precisely: it is the nonpolar side chains that force water into ordered clathrate-like shells, because water cannot hydrogen-bond to them and must reorganise around them; folding buries those side chains and releases the cage water. Backbone peptide-bond hydrogen bonds are instead largely satisfied internally within secondary structure.

extra.tag: 公式要记 · the equation
extra.zh: 把它写成 ΔG = ΔH − TΔS：折叠时蛋白链自身构象熵 conformational entropy 是下降的（ΔS_chain < 0，不利），但溶剂熵 ΔS_solvent 大幅上升，总和使 ΔG < 0。天然态相对变性态的净稳定性其实很小，通常只有约 20–60 kJ/mol，相当于几个氢键，所以蛋白质是“勉强稳定”的 marginally stable。
extra.en: Write it as ΔG = ΔH − TΔS: the chain's own conformational entropy falls on folding (ΔS_chain < 0, unfavourable), but solvent entropy rises far more, making the overall ΔG negative. The net stability of the native state over the unfolded state is small — typically only about 20–60 kJ/mol, a few hydrogen bonds' worth — so proteins are only marginally stable.

quiz.q_zh: RNase A 变性后复性能恢复 95% 活性，这个实验最直接支持的结论是什么？
quiz.q_en: Refolding denatured RNase A recovers about 95% of activity. Which conclusion does this experiment most directly support?

options.zh: 二硫键是维持所有蛋白质三级结构的主要作用力
options.en: Disulfide bonds are the main force holding every protein's tertiary fold

options.zh: 折叠是放热过程，蛋白加溶剂的总熵在折叠中减小
options.en: Folding is exothermic and lowers the entropy of protein plus solvent

options.zh: 蛋白质天然构象的信息完全编码在其氨基酸序列中
options.en: The native conformation is encoded entirely in the amino acid sequence

options.zh: 蛋白质在细胞内的折叠必须依赖分子伴侣才能完成
options.en: Folding inside the cell cannot be completed without molecular chaperones

quiz.explain_zh: 在试管里没有任何伴侣蛋白和细胞机器，仅凭序列和溶剂条件就恢复了活性，说明折叠信息内在于序列（Anfinsen's dogma）。选「必须依赖分子伴侣」很有诱惑力，因为体内确实常需要伴侣蛋白，但这个实验恰恰是在没有伴侣蛋白的条件下做的，因此它不能、也没有证明伴侣蛋白是必需的——伴侣蛋白提高效率、防止聚集，不提供折叠信息。
quiz.explain_en: In a test tube with no chaperones and no cellular machinery, activity returned from sequence and solvent alone, so the folding information is intrinsic to the sequence (Anfinsen's dogma). The chaperone option is tempting because chaperones really are needed in vivo, but this experiment was performed without them, so it cannot and does not show they are required — chaperones raise efficiency and prevent aggregation, they do not supply folding information.

quiz.q_zh: 关于疏水作用 hydrophobic effect 驱动蛋白质折叠，下列哪项描述是正确的？
quiz.q_en: Which statement correctly describes how the hydrophobic effect drives protein folding?

options.zh: 折叠使体系总熵减小，靠焓的大幅下降来补偿而自发进行
options.en: Folding lowers total entropy and is paid for by a large drop in enthalpy

options.zh: 非极性侧链与水形成强氢键，把这些链段牵引进疏水核心
options.en: Nonpolar side chains hydrogen-bond strongly to water and are drawn inward

options.zh: 非极性侧链之间的强吸引力直接把整条多肽链拉拢在一起
options.en: Strong attraction between nonpolar side chains pulls the chain together

options.zh: 埋藏非极性侧链释放有序水，溶剂熵增使 ΔG 下降
options.en: Burying nonpolar side chains frees ordered water, raising solvent entropy

quiz.explain_zh: 疏水效应本质上是熵驱动的溶剂效应：非极性表面迫使周围水形成有序笼状结构，把它们埋进核心后这些水被释放，溶剂熵上升。选「侧链之间强吸引力」是常见误解——疏水侧链之间只有较弱的 van der Waals 力，真正的「推力」来自水而不是来自侧链之间的吸引。选「与水形成强氢键」自相矛盾，疏水基团正是不能与水形成氢键的那一类。
quiz.explain_en: The hydrophobic effect is essentially an entropy-driven solvent effect: nonpolar surfaces force surrounding water into ordered cage-like shells, and burying them releases that water, raising solvent entropy. The side-chain-attraction option is the classic misconception — nonpolar side chains attract each other only weakly through van der Waals forces; the real push comes from water, not from side-chain attraction. The hydrogen-bonding option contradicts itself, since nonpolar groups are precisely those that cannot hydrogen-bond to water.

title_zh: 测蛋白质稳定性：TM 值、nanoDSF 与热位移实验 TSA
title_en: Measuring protein stability: TM, nanoDSF, and the thermal shift assay

points.zh: TM 值即熔解温度 melting temperature，指一半蛋白质发生热变性去折叠时的温度；TM 越高，蛋白能耐受越高温度，稳定性越好。
points.en: TM is the melting temperature — the temperature at which half of the protein has thermally unfolded; a higher TM means the protein tolerates more heat and is more stable.

points.zh: 曲线叫熔解曲线 melting curve，但与 qPCR/PCR 里的 melting curve 含义不同：那是 DNA 双链解链，这里是蛋白质去折叠。
points.en: The curve is a melting curve, but it is not the same as the melting curve in PCR/qPCR: that one reports DNA duplex separation, this one reports protein unfolding.

points.zh: 老师用的仪器是 NanoTemper 公司的设备，毛细管 capillary 吸取少量蛋白溶液，边升温边读信号。
points.en: The instrument used is from NanoTemper: a capillary takes up a few microlitres of protein solution and the signal is read while the temperature is ramped.

points.zh: 读出的物理量与芳香族氨基酸 aromatic amino acids（280 nm 吸收）有关：这些残基埋在蛋白内部与暴露在溶液中时，光谱性质不同，去折叠因此可被检测。
points.en: The readout relies on the aromatic amino acids (the 280 nm absorbers): their spectral properties differ when buried in the protein core versus exposed to solvent, so unfolding is detectable.

points.zh: 该方法叫 nanoDSF（Nano 表示微量），也叫 TSA = Thermal Shift Assay 热位移实验；DSF 中文名是差示扫描荧光法。
points.en: The method is nanoDSF ('nano' for the small sample volume), also called TSA, thermal shift assay; DSF stands for differential scanning fluorimetry.

points.zh: 叫“位移”是因为在不同缓冲条件、不同配体存在下，同一蛋白的 TM 会向左或向右 shift，从而报告条件或配体对稳定性的影响。
points.en: It is called a 'shift' assay because the same protein's TM shifts left or right under different buffers or with different ligands, reporting how those conditions affect stability.

points.zh: 另一种经典做法是在 qPCR 仪上用 SYPRO Orange 荧光染料：蛋白去折叠暴露疏水区，染料结合后发出荧光信号，原理与 nanoDSF 不完全相同。
points.en: The classical alternative runs on a qPCR machine with the dye SYPRO Orange: unfolding exposes hydrophobic patches, the dye binds and fluoresces — a different principle from nanoDSF.

points.zh: 老师推荐这个实验：操作简单、上样量小，可以在一定程度上定量证明蛋白质的稳定性。
points.en: The teacher recommends the assay: easy to run, tiny sample requirement, and it gives a semi-quantitative demonstration of protein stability.

extra.tag: 课上说法需修正 · lecture says otherwise
extra.zh: 老师说 nanoDSF“测的是 OD280 吸光”。实际 nanoDSF 测的是**内源荧光** intrinsic fluorescence：用约 280 nm 激发色氨酸 Trp（和 Tyr），同时记录 330 nm 与 350 nm 的发射强度，报告 F350/F330 比值。Trp 埋在疏水核心时发射峰蓝移（偏 330 nm），暴露到水中时红移（偏 350 nm），所以比值随去折叠而跳变。它确实“靠 280 nm 吸收的那类残基”，但读的是发射不是吸收。
extra.en: The lecture says nanoDSF measures OD280 absorbance. In fact nanoDSF measures intrinsic fluorescence: excitation near 280 nm on tryptophan (and tyrosine), with emission recorded simultaneously at 330 nm and 350 nm and reported as the F350/F330 ratio. Buried Trp emits blue-shifted (toward 330 nm) and solvent-exposed Trp red-shifted (toward 350 nm), so the ratio jumps as the protein unfolds. It does rely on the same residues that absorb at 280 nm, but it reads emission, not absorbance.

extra.tag: A280 归属 · which residues
extra.zh: 280 nm 吸收几乎全部来自色氨酸 Trp（ε 最大）和酪氨酸 Tyr，二硫键 cystine 有很小贡献；苯丙氨酸 Phe 在 280 nm 基本无吸收（它吸在 257 nm 附近）。老师顺口提到脯氨酸又自己否掉了——脯氨酸不是芳香族，没有 280 nm 吸收。若一个蛋白不含 Trp/Tyr，A280 定量和 nanoDSF 都会失灵。
extra.en: Absorbance at 280 nm comes almost entirely from tryptophan (largest ε) and tyrosine, with a small contribution from cystine disulfides; phenylalanine barely absorbs at 280 nm (its band is near 257 nm). The lecture briefly said proline and then corrected itself — proline is not aromatic and has no 280 nm absorbance. A protein lacking Trp and Tyr defeats both A280 quantitation and nanoDSF.

extra.tag: 名字别混 · easily confused names
extra.zh: DSF = differential scanning fluorimetry 差示扫描荧光法（测荧光）；DSC = differential scanning calorimetry 差示扫描量热法（直接测热容变化，可给出 ΔH，是热力学金标准但耗样量大）。两者中文只差一个字，考试和文献里都要分清。
extra.en: DSF is differential scanning fluorimetry (a fluorescence readout); DSC is differential scanning calorimetry, which measures heat capacity directly, yields ΔH, and is the thermodynamic gold standard but consumes far more sample. The two acronyms differ by one letter and must not be confused.

extra.tag: 实际用途 · why it matters
extra.zh: TSA 的经典应用是配体筛选：配体只结合天然态时，结合能稳定天然态，使 TM 向右移，ΔTM 与结合亲和力正相关。这就是药物发现里 fragment screening 的常用一级筛选，也用来优化缓冲液（pH、盐、添加剂）以挑出让蛋白最稳定的条件。
extra.en: The classic use of TSA is ligand screening: a ligand that binds only the folded state stabilises it, shifting TM to the right, and ΔTM correlates with binding affinity. This is a standard primary screen in fragment-based drug discovery, and the same assay is used to optimise buffer conditions (pH, salt, additives) by finding where the protein is most stable.

quiz.q_zh: 在一个 TSA 实验中，加入某小分子后蛋白的 TM 从 46 °C 升到 53 °C。最合理的解释是什么？
quiz.q_en: In a TSA experiment, adding a small molecule raises the protein's TM from 46 °C to 53 °C. What is the most reasonable interpretation?

options.zh: 该小分子上调了细胞内表达量，使蛋白浓度更高
options.en: The molecule raised the expression level, so more protein is present in the sample

options.zh: 该小分子与荧光染料竞争疏水位点，使信号延后出现
options.en: The molecule competes with the dye for hydrophobic sites, so the signal appears later

options.zh: 该小分子选择性结合天然态，使折叠构象被额外稳定
options.en: The molecule binds the native state selectively, extra-stabilising the folded form

options.zh: 该小分子作为变性剂结合去折叠态，加速了热变性
options.en: The molecule binds the unfolded state as a denaturant, accelerating thermal melting

quiz.explain_zh: 配体若只（或更强地）结合天然态，按热力学耦合，天然态被额外稳定，去折叠需要更高温度，TM 右移，这正是 TSA 用于配体筛选的原理。“与染料竞争疏水位点”那一项是一个真实存在的假阳性/假阴性来源，尤其在 SYPRO Orange 体系中，但它一般表现为信号幅度改变或基线升高，而不是整条曲线规整地右移；而且 nanoDSF 用内源荧光，根本不加染料，仍能看到位移。
quiz.explain_en: If a ligand binds the folded state exclusively or more tightly, thermodynamic coupling means the folded state is extra-stabilised, unfolding requires more heat, and TM shifts up — exactly why TSA is used for ligand screening. The dye-competition option names a genuine artefact source, especially with SYPRO Orange, but competing for the dye's hydrophobic sites usually changes signal amplitude or baseline rather than shifting a clean transition; and nanoDSF uses intrinsic fluorescence with no dye at all yet still shows the shift.

quiz.q_zh: nanoDSF 与基于 SYPRO Orange 的传统 DSF，在检测原理上的关键区别是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the key difference in detection principle between nanoDSF and conventional SYPRO Orange DSF?

options.zh: nanoDSF 跟踪核酸解链的荧光变化，SYPRO Orange 跟踪蛋白去折叠的荧光
options.en: nanoDSF follows the fluorescence of nucleic acid melting, SYPRO Orange that of protein unfolding

options.zh: nanoDSF 跟踪蛋白自身 Trp 的内源荧光，SYPRO Orange 靠染料结合疏水面
options.en: nanoDSF follows the protein's own Trp fluorescence, SYPRO Orange a dye binding exposed patches

options.zh: nanoDSF 需先把蛋白固定在芯片表面测定，SYPRO Orange 测量溶液中游离的蛋白
options.en: nanoDSF needs the protein immobilised on a chip, SYPRO Orange works on protein free in solution

options.zh: nanoDSF 与传统 DSF 的检测原理完全一致，差别只在仪器的厂家与价格档次
options.en: nanoDSF and conventional DSF detect by the identical principle and differ only in vendor and price

quiz.explain_zh: nanoDSF 是 label-free 的，靠色氨酸随环境极性变化的发射波长位移（F350/F330）；SYPRO Orange 则是环境敏感染料，游离在水中时几乎不发光，结合到去折叠暴露的疏水表面后才强烈发光。“两者原理完全一致”那一项有迷惑性，因为两者输出的曲线长得很像、都给 TM，但检测对象不同，这直接决定了适用性：含去垢剂 detergent 的样品会让 SYPRO Orange 失效，nanoDSF 则通常不受影响；反之不含 Trp 的蛋白 nanoDSF 无信号。
quiz.explain_en: nanoDSF is label-free, exploiting the shift in tryptophan emission wavelength with environment polarity (F350/F330); SYPRO Orange is an environment-sensitive dye that is nearly dark in water and lights up only on binding hydrophobic surfaces exposed by unfolding. The 'identical principle' option is tempting because both produce similar-looking curves and both report TM, but the different detection target has practical consequences: detergent-containing samples defeat SYPRO Orange while nanoDSF usually tolerates them, whereas a protein without tryptophan gives nanoDSF no signal.

title_zh: Levinthal 悖论、累积选择与能量地形：朊病毒为什么是“更稳定但没活性”
title_en: Levinthal's paradox, cumulative selection, and the energy landscape: why a prion is 'more stable but inactive'

points.zh: Levinthal's Paradox 莱文塔尔悖论：主链二面角 Phi (φ) 和 Psi (ψ) 的可能组合数极其庞大，若随机逐一试遍，折叠所需时间将长得不可思议，但真实蛋白在毫秒到秒级就折好了。
points.en: Levinthal's paradox: the backbone dihedral angles phi and psi allow an astronomically large number of combinations, so a random search would take an absurdly long time, yet real proteins fold in milliseconds to seconds.

points.zh: 悖论的提法是：折叠这么快，怎么保证每一次都折成正确的那一种构象？
points.en: The paradox is posed as: if folding is that fast, how is the correct conformation reached every time?

points.zh: 目前较被接受的回应是“累积选择 cumulative selection”：折叠确实是自发、随机开始的，但不是每一步都重来。
points.en: The accepted response is 'cumulative selection': folding does start spontaneously and randomly, but each attempt does not start from scratch.

points.zh: 设想一条链能折成 A、B、C、D、E、F 多种形式，只有 A 是正确折叠，A 的能量最低因而被保留下来，不再发生大的变动。
points.en: Imagine a chain that can fold into forms A through F; only A is correct, A has the lowest energy, so A is retained and no longer changes appreciably.

points.zh: B–F 这些错误折叠能量较高，容易再次解开重折，或在分子伴侣 chaperone 等蛋白协助下被纠正回正确构象。
points.en: The misfolded forms B to F sit at higher energy, so they readily unfold and refold again, or are corrected back to the right conformation with help from chaperones and other proteins.

points.zh: 老师用能量图解释朊病毒 prion：纵坐标是能量，正常蛋白处于一个局部能量最低点 local minimum，可以稳定存在。
points.en: The teacher draws an energy diagram for prions: energy on the vertical axis, with the normal protein sitting in a local minimum where it can persist stably.

points.zh: 朊病毒构象则处在全局能量最低点 global minimum；一旦正常蛋白遇到它，就倾向于从 local 翻越到 global，构象被“传染”。
points.en: The prion conformation occupies the global minimum; once the normal protein meets it, it tends to convert from the local minimum to the global one — the conformation is 'infectious'.

points.zh: 关键记忆点：朊病毒把蛋白变到了一个更稳定的状态，但那个更稳定的状态并不是有活性的状态。
points.en: Key take-home: the prion drives the protein into a more stable state, but that more stable state is not the functional one.

extra.tag: 现代表述 · modern framing
extra.zh: 教科书今天更常用“折叠漏斗 folding funnel / 能量地形 energy landscape”来解答 Levinthal 悖论：能量面不是平的高原，而是一个漏斗，越接近天然态构象熵越低、能量也越低，所以随机运动被地形本身“漏斗化”地导向天然态，不需要遍历所有构象。局部的小坑就是动力学陷阱 kinetic traps，对应错误折叠中间体。
extra.en: Textbooks now usually answer Levinthal with the folding funnel / energy landscape picture: the energy surface is not a flat plateau but a funnel in which conformational entropy and energy both fall towards the native state, so random motion is steered downhill by the landscape itself and no exhaustive search is needed. Small side wells in the funnel are kinetic traps corresponding to misfolded intermediates.

extra.tag: 术语要分清 ·热力学 vs 动力学
extra.zh: 老师的 local/global minimum 图正好点出了热力学稳定性 thermodynamic stability 与动力学稳定性 kinetic stability 的区别：天然态往往只是动力学上可及、被高能垒保护的局部最低点；淀粉样纤维 amyloid 才常是全局最低点。Anfinsen 的“天然态 = 能量最低”严格说是在“可及构象空间内”成立，朊病毒和淀粉样病正是这条规则的著名例外。
extra.en: The local/global minimum sketch is exactly the distinction between thermodynamic and kinetic stability: the native state is often only a kinetically accessible local minimum protected by a high barrier, while amyloid fibres are frequently the true global minimum. Anfinsen's 'native state equals lowest energy' strictly holds only within the accessible conformational space, and prions and amyloid diseases are the famous exceptions.

extra.tag: 课上未展开 · prion specifics
extra.zh: 朊病毒的分子实体是 PrP 蛋白：正常型 PrP^C 富含 α-螺旋 α-helix，致病型 PrP^Sc 富含 β-折叠 β-sheet，能抗蛋白酶 K 消化并聚集成淀粉样纤维。一级结构完全相同，只有构象不同——这是“一级结构决定高级结构”这条规则最有名的反例，Prusiner 因此获 1997 年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。相关疾病：羊瘙痒病 scrapie、疯牛病 BSE、人的 CJD。
extra.en: The molecular entity is the PrP protein: normal PrP^C is α-helix rich, pathogenic PrP^Sc is β-sheet rich, resistant to proteinase K digestion, and aggregates into amyloid fibrils. The primary structure is identical and only the conformation differs — the most famous counterexample to 'sequence dictates structure', for which Prusiner received the 1997 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine. Associated diseases include scrapie, BSE, and human CJD.

quiz.q_zh: 下列哪一项最准确地说明了 Levinthal's paradox 的现代解答？
quiz.q_en: Which statement best captures the modern resolution of Levinthal's paradox?

options.zh: 构象搜索并非穷举，漏斗形能量地形把随机运动导向天然态
options.en: Search is not exhaustive; the funnel-shaped landscape steers motion to the native state

options.zh: 分子伴侣为每条新生肽链提供了唯一正确的折叠路径信息
options.en: Chaperones supply each nascent chain with the information for the one correct folding pathway

options.zh: 折叠其实需要数小时之久，足以逐一试遍所有可能的构象
options.en: Folding actually takes hours, which is long enough to try out every possible conformation

options.zh: 肽键的部分双键性质锁死了全部主链二面角，只剩一种构象
options.en: Partial double-bond character locks every backbone dihedral, leaving a single conformation

quiz.explain_zh: 漏斗模型指出构象搜索是有偏的：每形成一段正确的局部结构就降低能量并缩小后续搜索空间，所以毫秒级折叠不矛盾。“伴侣蛋白提供折叠路径信息”那一项是最常见的误解——伴侣蛋白不提供折叠信息（Anfinsen 实验已证明信息在序列里），它们只是防止聚集、给错误折叠的链再次尝试的机会。“肽键锁死全部主链二面角”那一项混淆了肽键本身的部分双键性质（该键确实不能自由旋转）与 φ/ψ 的可变性（φ/ψ 是可以转的，正是悖论的来源）。
quiz.explain_en: The funnel model shows the search is biased: every correct local structure formed lowers the energy and shrinks the remaining search space, so millisecond folding is no contradiction. The chaperone option is the commonest misconception — chaperones supply no folding information (Anfinsen showed it resides in the sequence); they prevent aggregation and give misfolded chains another attempt. The dihedral-locking option confuses the partial double-bond character of the peptide bond itself, which genuinely cannot rotate, with the freely variable phi and psi angles that generate the paradox in the first place.

quiz.q_zh: 按老师的能量图，朊病毒致病构象相对于正常蛋白构象的关系是：
quiz.q_en: According to the energy diagram used in the lecture, how does the pathogenic prion conformation relate to the normal conformation?

options.zh: 其一级结构发生了点突变，由此引起构象整体改变
options.en: Its primary structure carries a point mutation that changes the conformation

options.zh: 与正常构象的能量完全相同，差别只在折叠速度更快一些
options.en: Identical in energy to the normal conformation, differing only in its folding rate

options.zh: 能量更低、热力学上更稳定，但缺乏正常生物学活性
options.en: Lower in energy and more stable thermodynamically, yet lacking normal activity

options.zh: 能量更高、稳定性更差，因而更容易被蛋白酶降解
options.en: Higher in energy and less stable, and therefore degraded readily by proteases

quiz.explain_zh: PrP^Sc 处在全局能量最低点，热力学上比 PrP^C 更稳定，并且能作为模板把 PrP^C 拉过能垒，但富 β-折叠的聚集态没有正常功能。“能量更高、易被蛋白酶降解”那一项恰好说反了：正因为它极稳定，PrP^Sc 抗蛋白酶 K 消化，这还是实验室鉴定它的标准手段。“一级结构发生点突变”那一项也是常见混淆——朊病毒的一级结构与正常蛋白相同，改变的只是构象，这正是它作为“中心法则例外”的意义所在（遗传性 CJD 里确有 PRNP 突变，但那只是提高转化倾向，不是传染性构象本身的定义）。
quiz.explain_en: PrP^Sc occupies the global minimum, is thermodynamically more stable than PrP^C, and can template the conversion of PrP^C over the barrier, yet the β-sheet-rich aggregate has no normal function. The 'higher energy, protease-labile' option states the opposite of the truth: precisely because it is so stable, PrP^Sc resists proteinase K digestion, which is the standard laboratory test for it. The point-mutation option is the other common confusion — the prion has the same primary structure as the normal protein and differs only in conformation, which is exactly why it matters as an exception (inherited CJD does involve PRNP mutations, but those merely raise the conversion tendency and do not define the infectious conformation).

title_zh: 折叠的帮手：二硫键异构酶与分子伴侣（热休克蛋白 HSP）
title_en: Folding helpers: disulfide isomerase and molecular chaperones (heat shock proteins)

points.zh: 紧接 Levinthal 悖论：蛋白质的正确折叠往往不是它自己独立完成的，需要分子伴侣 molecular chaperone 或异构酶参与共同催化。
points.en: Following on from Levinthal's paradox: correct folding is often not achieved by the chain alone but is catalysed with the help of molecular chaperones or isomerases.

points.zh: 蛋白质二硫键异构酶 protein disulfide isomerase (PDI) 的作用是促进蛋白形成正确配对的二硫键 disulfide bond。
points.en: Protein disulfide isomerase (PDI) promotes formation of the correctly paired disulfide bonds.

points.zh: 分子伴侣是一类热休克蛋白 heat shock protein，缩写 HSP，名字来自 heat（加热）+ shock（细胞受到热击）。
points.en: Molecular chaperones are a class of heat shock proteins, abbreviated HSP, named from heat plus shock — the cell being heat-shocked.

points.zh: 为什么加热会诱导它们：升温会让一部分 TM 值较低、不太稳定的蛋白发生变构/部分变性，细胞需要 HSP 把它们重新折回正确构象。
points.en: Why heat induces them: raising the temperature partially denatures the less stable, lower-TM proteins, and the cell needs HSPs to refold them correctly.

points.zh: 后来发现 HSP 家族不必等到热击才表达，细胞在正常条件下也有本底表达 basal expression，日常帮助新生蛋白折叠。
points.en: It was later found that HSPs need not wait for a heat shock: they are also expressed at a basal level under normal conditions and routinely assist folding of nascent proteins.

points.zh: 老师做冷冻电镜 cryo-EM 时看到大量 HSP：形态非常典型，七个单体围成一圈的七聚体 heptamer，整体是桶状；桶内是一个疏水腔 hydrophobic cavity（电镜图中间无密度处），未折叠的肽链被容纳进去在隔离环境中折叠。
points.en: In cryo-EM the teacher saw many HSPs with a very characteristic shape: seven subunits arranged in a ring, a heptamer forming a barrel, enclosing a hydrophobic cavity (the empty-looking centre in the map) into which the unfolded chain is taken up to fold in an isolated environment.

points.zh: 为什么会纯化到它：目的蛋白难表达、无法自身正确折叠，大肠杆菌 E. coli 大量产生 HSP 想帮忙但能力不够。
points.en: Why it copurified: the target protein was hard to express and could not fold correctly on its own, so E. coli produced large amounts of HSP in an attempt to help, which was not enough.

points.zh: 共纯化机理很实际：未折叠的目的蛋白呈线状，一端被标签 tag 挂在亲和柱上、另一端还留在伴侣蛋白腔里，把伴侣蛋白一起拉下来；而线状未折叠蛋白不稳定易降解，4 °C 放一晚上目的蛋白就消失，只剩下极稳定的伴侣蛋白。
points.en: The copurification mechanism is very practical: the unfolded target is an extended chain whose tagged end binds the affinity column while its other end is still inside the chaperone, dragging the chaperone down with it; and since the extended chain is unstable and readily degraded, after a night at 4 °C the target is gone and only the very stable chaperone remains.

points.zh: 经验法则：跑胶时若在 50–55 kDa 出现一条非常清晰的单体条带，要警惕它是伴侣蛋白；伴侣蛋白几乎存在于所有生命体（昆虫表达系统里也拿到过）。
points.en: Rule of thumb: a very sharp monomer band at 50–55 kDa on a gel should raise the suspicion of a chaperone; chaperones exist in essentially all organisms, and the same band has turned up in insect expression systems.

extra.tag: 补齐名字 · name the players
extra.zh: 老师电镜里那个七聚体桶几乎肯定是 GroEL（大肠杆菌 Hsp60 家族，真核同源物 chaperonin/TRiC）。准确结构是：14 个亚基，两个背靠背堆叠的七元环 two stacked heptameric rings，顶上再扣一个七聚体的盖子 GroES（Hsp10，约 10 kDa）。单体约 57 kDa——正好落在老师说的 50–55 kDa 附近，所以那条“可疑条带”通常就是 GroEL。另一个常见污染是 DnaK（Hsp70，约 70 kDa）。
extra.en: The heptameric barrel seen in the teacher's cryo-EM is almost certainly GroEL (the E. coli Hsp60 family; the eukaryotic counterpart is the chaperonin TRiC). Precisely, it has 14 subunits arranged as two stacked heptameric rings, capped by the heptameric lid GroES (Hsp10, about 10 kDa). The subunit is about 57 kDa, right around the 50–55 kDa band the teacher warns about, so that suspicious band is usually GroEL. The other frequent contaminant is DnaK (Hsp70, about 70 kDa).

extra.tag: 机制要点 · ATP 驱动
extra.zh: 伴侣蛋白不是被动的容器，它是 ATP 酶：GroEL/GroES 每一轮折叠循环水解 ATP，腔壁在 ATP 结合后由疏水翻转为亲水，从而把底物释放进腔内并驱动其重新尝试折叠；Hsp70 也靠 ATP/ADP 循环调节对疏水肽段的亲和力。要点是伴侣蛋白**不提供构象信息**，只是防止聚集 aggregation 并提供反复尝试的机会——这与 Anfinsen 实验并不矛盾。
extra.en: Chaperones are not passive containers but ATPases: each GroEL/GroES cycle hydrolyses ATP, and ATP binding flips the cavity wall from hydrophobic to hydrophilic, releasing the substrate into the chamber and driving another folding attempt; Hsp70 likewise modulates its affinity for exposed hydrophobic segments through an ATP/ADP cycle. Crucially, chaperones supply no conformational information — they prevent aggregation and grant repeated attempts, which is entirely consistent with the Anfinsen experiment.

extra.tag: PDI 定位 · where disulfides form
extra.zh: PDI 位于真核细胞的内质网 ER 腔（那里是氧化环境），细胞质是还原环境，一般不形成稳定二硫键——这就是为什么带二硫键的分泌蛋白在大肠杆菌**细胞质**里表达常常折叠失败。原核对应体系在周质 periplasm：DsbA 负责氧化成键，DsbC 负责异构（“改错”）。工程上常用 SHuffle 或 Origami 这类还原酶缺陷菌株解决这个问题。另一类折叠催化酶是肽基脯氨酰顺反异构酶 PPIase（如 cyclophilin），催化脯氨酸前肽键的 cis/trans 转换。
extra.en: PDI resides in the oxidising lumen of the eukaryotic ER; the cytoplasm is reducing and normally cannot maintain disulfides, which is why disulfide-containing secreted proteins so often fail to fold when expressed in the E. coli cytoplasm. The prokaryotic equivalent sits in the periplasm: DsbA oxidises to form bonds and DsbC isomerises to correct mispairings. Engineered reductase-deficient strains such as SHuffle or Origami are the usual workaround. A second class of folding catalyst is peptidyl-prolyl cis-trans isomerase (PPIase, e.g. cyclophilin), which catalyses cis/trans switching of the bond preceding proline.

extra.tag: 实验室后续 · practical follow-up
extra.zh: 如果确实怀疑 50–55 kDa 那条带是 GroEL，标准做法是纯化时在洗涤缓冲液中加 5–10 mM ATP 加 Mg²⁺（有时加少量变性剂或 K⁺），触发一轮 ATP 循环把底物释放掉，GroEL 就随流穿走；或者用质谱 mass spec 直接鉴定这条带，不要靠分子量猜。
extra.en: If a 50–55 kDa band is genuinely suspected to be GroEL, the standard fix is to include 5–10 mM ATP with Mg²⁺ (sometimes with a little denaturant or K⁺) in the wash buffer, triggering an ATP cycle that releases the substrate so GroEL washes through; alternatively identify the band directly by mass spectrometry rather than guessing from molecular weight.

quiz.q_zh: 在大肠杆菌中用 His-tag 纯化目的蛋白时，反复出现一条 50–55 kDa 的强污染带，且 4 °C 过夜后目的蛋白条带消失、只剩这条带。最可能的解释是：
quiz.q_en: His-tag purification from E. coli repeatedly gives a strong 50–55 kDa contaminant, and after a night at 4 °C the target band is gone while this band remains. The most likely explanation is:

options.zh: 该条带是目的蛋白的二聚体，分子量恰好约为单体的两倍
options.en: The band is the dimer of the target, at about twice the monomer molecular weight

options.zh: 大肠杆菌自身富含组氨酸的蛋白非特异地结合到了镍柱上
options.en: Histidine-rich E. coli proteins bound the nickel column non-specifically and eluted

options.zh: 目的蛋白未折叠，以伸展态被 GroEL 结合而共纯化，随后降解
options.en: The unfolded target was held in an extended state by GroEL, copurified, then degraded

options.zh: His-tag 在纯化过程中被蛋白酶切除，目的蛋白因此不再结合镍柱
options.en: A protease removed the His-tag during purification, so the target no longer binds nickel

quiz.explain_zh: 这正是老师描述的场景：未折叠的目的蛋白一端带标签挂在柱上、另一端仍在 GroEL 腔内，把伴侣蛋白一起带下来；伸展的未折叠链不稳定，储存过夜即被降解，剩下极稳定的 GroEL。“组氨酸富集蛋白非特异结合镍柱”那一项有一定道理（镍柱确实有非特异结合），但那通常是一组杂带而不是单一极清晰的强条带，也解释不了“目的蛋白过夜消失”这个关键现象。
quiz.explain_en: This is exactly the scenario described: the unfolded target is held on the column by its tag at one end while its other end is still inside GroEL, dragging the chaperone down with it; the extended chain is unstable and is degraded overnight, leaving the extremely stable GroEL behind. The non-specific-binding option has some truth, since nickel columns do retain histidine-rich proteins, but that normally yields a set of faint bands rather than one very sharp strong one, and it does not explain the key observation that the target disappears overnight.

quiz.q_zh: 关于分子伴侣与 Anfinsen 实验的关系，下列说法正确的是：
quiz.q_en: Which statement correctly relates molecular chaperones to the Anfinsen experiment?

options.zh: 伴侣蛋白的存在说明一级结构本身不足以决定高级结构
options.en: The existence of chaperones shows primary structure cannot dictate higher-order folds

options.zh: 伴侣蛋白不提供折叠信息，只防止聚集并给链反复尝试的机会
options.en: Chaperones give no folding information; they block aggregation and allow fresh attempts

options.zh: 伴侣蛋白携带构象模板，直接决定了底物蛋白的最终三级结构
options.en: Chaperones carry a conformational template that fixes the substrate's tertiary structure

options.zh: 伴侣蛋白共价修饰底物侧链，从而把正确的构象锁定下来
options.en: Chaperones covalently modify substrate side chains to lock in the correct conformation

quiz.explain_zh: 伴侣蛋白结合暴露的疏水表面，用 ATP 循环把底物关进疏水腔隔离开来，避免细胞内高浓度下的分子间聚集，从而提高正确折叠的产率和速度——信息仍在序列里。“一级结构不足以决定高级结构”那一项是最常见的错误推论：细胞内需要伴侣蛋白是动力学问题（拥挤、聚集竞争），不是信息问题；Anfinsen 在稀溶液、无伴侣条件下照样折出活性蛋白，正好说明了这一点。
quiz.explain_en: Chaperones bind exposed hydrophobic surfaces and use ATP cycles to sequester the substrate in a hydrophobic chamber, preventing intermolecular aggregation at the high concentrations found in cells and so raising the yield and rate of correct folding — the information still lies in the sequence. The 'primary structure is insufficient' option is the most common false inference: the cellular need for chaperones is kinetic (crowding, competition from aggregation), not informational, as Anfinsen's chaperone-free dilute refolding of active protein demonstrates.

title_zh: 四级结构的优越性：稳定性、遗传经济性、协同与别构效应
title_en: Why quaternary structure exists: stability, genetic economy, cooperativity and allostery

points.zh: 四级结构 quaternary structure 本身放到血红蛋白 hemoglobin / 肌红蛋白 myoglobin 那一节再详讲，这里先讲生命体为什么要有四级结构。
points.en: Quaternary structure itself is deferred to the hemoglobin/myoglobin section; here the question is why organisms evolved quaternary structure at all.

points.zh: 优势一，增强整体结构稳定性：像聚合酶 polymerase 那样由几个三级结构互相支撑，只有正确组装时才是最稳定的状态。
points.en: Advantage one, enhanced overall stability: as in a polymerase, several tertiary units brace each other, and only the correctly assembled form is the most stable state.

points.zh: 优势二，遗传经济性 genetic economy：一个基因编码的亚基可以重复使用组装成多聚体，不必为每个功能单元编码一条长基因。
points.en: Advantage two, genetic economy: subunits from one gene can be reused to assemble a multimer, avoiding the need to encode one long gene per functional unit.

points.zh: 老师的例子：血红蛋白是四聚体 tetramer，一次能运 4 个氧分子；肌红蛋白是单体，只能结合 1 个氧分子。
points.en: The teacher's example: hemoglobin is a tetramer carrying four O2 molecules at once, while myoglobin is a monomer binding only one.

points.zh: 优势三，也是最重要的：只有形成四级结构才会产生协同效应 cooperativity 和别构效应 allosteric effect。
points.en: Advantage three, and the most important: cooperativity and allosteric effects arise only once quaternary structure is present.

points.zh: 记忆要点：当我们说某个蛋白“有协同效应/有别构效应”时，一定是在描述它的四级结构层面的性质。
points.en: Take-home point: saying a protein 'shows cooperativity' or 'is allosteric' is a statement about its quaternary level.

points.zh: 因此许多具协同或别构调控的酶 enzyme 都有明确的四级结构，这两件事在考试里是绑定出现的。
points.en: Accordingly, most enzymes under cooperative or allosteric control have a well-defined quaternary structure — the two facts travel together in exams.

extra.tag: 课上说法需修正 · 遗传经济性
extra.zh: 老师说“血红蛋白只需要一条基因就能翻译出一个四聚体”，这在人类血红蛋白 HbA 上并不成立：HbA 是 α₂β₂，由 HBA 和 HBB **两个不同基因**编码，属异源四聚体 heterotetramer。遗传经济性的正确论证不是“基因数少”，而是：编码一条短链、重复用它组装，比编码一条四倍长的单链更省 DNA，且翻译错误率随链长上升——短亚基能让错误的产物被丢弃而不是整条报废，同时便于装配质控。
extra.en: The lecture says one gene yields the hemoglobin tetramer, which is not true for human HbA: it is α₂β₂, encoded by two distinct genes, HBA and HBB, making it a heterotetramer. The correct genetic-economy argument is not 'fewer genes' but that encoding one short chain and reusing it costs less DNA than encoding a single chain four times as long, and since translational error accumulates with chain length, short subunits let a faulty copy be discarded rather than ruining the whole assembly, while also permitting assembly-level quality control.

extra.tag: 严谨一点 · 协同的真正条件
extra.zh: 协同结合 cooperative binding 的真正必要条件是**多个可相互沟通的结合位点**，通常由多亚基提供，所以老师“协同=四级结构”的口诀在考试里适用。但要知道两个细节：(1) 别构 allostery 的定义是“一个位点的结合改变另一个位点的性质”，单体酶也可以有别构位点，例如葡萄糖激酶 glucokinase 就是单体却表现出动力学协同性 kinetic cooperativity（慢构象转换机制，Monod 的 mnemonic 模型）；(2) 肌红蛋白是单体，所以它的氧结合曲线是双曲线 hyperbolic，血红蛋白是四聚体，曲线是 S 形 sigmoidal——这是四级结构带来协同性最直观的证据。
extra.en: The real requirement for cooperative binding is multiple binding sites that can communicate, normally provided by multiple subunits, so the lecture's 'cooperativity equals quaternary structure' rule works for exam purposes. Two refinements are worth knowing: allostery is defined as binding at one site altering the properties of another, and a monomer can have an allosteric site — glucokinase is monomeric yet shows kinetic cooperativity through a slow conformational transition (Monod's mnemonic model); and myoglobin, being monomeric, gives a hyperbolic O2 binding curve while tetrameric hemoglobin gives a sigmoidal one, the most direct evidence that quaternary structure creates cooperativity.

extra.tag: 还有两条优势 · not mentioned
extra.zh: 课上没提的两个额外好处：(1) 形成活性位点于亚基界面 subunit interface，使活性依赖于正确组装，本身就是一层调控（如某些酶必须二聚化才有活性）；(2) 减少表面暴露的疏水面积，多聚化把界面疏水面埋起来，降低聚集倾向。此外亚基界面也是许多药物作用点（如别构抑制剂）。
extra.en: Two further benefits the lecture omits: active sites can be built at subunit interfaces, so activity requires correct assembly and this becomes a layer of regulation in itself (some enzymes are active only as dimers); and oligomerisation buries hydrophobic interface area that would otherwise be solvent-exposed, lowering aggregation propensity. Subunit interfaces are also a favourite drug target, notably for allosteric inhibitors.

quiz.q_zh: 肌红蛋白的氧结合曲线是双曲线，而血红蛋白是 S 形曲线。这一差别的结构基础是：
quiz.q_en: Myoglobin gives a hyperbolic O2 binding curve while hemoglobin gives a sigmoidal one. The structural basis of this difference is:

options.zh: 血红蛋白与肌红蛋白的序列高度同源，因而结合氧更为紧密
options.en: Hemoglobin is highly homologous to myoglobin in sequence, so it binds oxygen tighter

options.zh: 肌红蛋白不含血红素辅基，只能靠侧链直接结合氧分子
options.en: Myoglobin carries no heme prosthetic group and binds oxygen through side chains alone

options.zh: 血红蛋白的亚基界面可传递构象变化，从而产生协同结合
options.en: Its subunit interfaces transmit conformational change, producing cooperative binding

options.zh: 血红蛋白的血红素铁为 Fe³⁺，而肌红蛋白的血红素铁为 Fe²⁺
options.en: Hemoglobin's heme iron is ferric Fe(III) while myoglobin's heme iron is ferrous Fe(II)

quiz.explain_zh: S 形曲线是协同性的标志：第一个亚基结合氧后引发 T→R 构象转变，提高其余亚基的亲和力，这需要多亚基界面来传递信号；肌红蛋白单体没有可沟通的第二个位点，只能给双曲线。“Fe³⁺ 与 Fe²⁺”那一项是常见混淆：两者的功能态血红素都是 Fe²⁺，氧化成 Fe³⁺（高铁血红蛋白 methemoglobin）反而完全不能结合氧，与曲线形状无关。
quiz.explain_en: A sigmoidal curve is the signature of cooperativity: oxygen binding at the first subunit triggers the T-to-R transition that raises affinity at the others, which requires subunit interfaces to transmit the signal, whereas monomeric myoglobin has no second site to communicate with and can only give a hyperbola. The ferric/ferrous option is a common confusion: both proteins carry Fe(II) in the functional state, and oxidation to Fe(III) (methemoglobin) abolishes O2 binding entirely rather than changing the curve shape.

quiz.q_zh: 下列哪一项**不是**蛋白质形成四级结构的普遍优势？
quiz.q_en: Which of the following is NOT a general advantage of forming quaternary structure?

options.zh: 亚基之间彼此支撑，显著提高整体结构的稳定性与刚性
options.en: Subunits brace one another, appreciably raising overall stability and rigidity

options.zh: 重复使用短亚基，比编码一条超长多肽更节省遗传信息
options.en: Reusing short subunits saves genetic information versus one long polypeptide

options.zh: 提高单个活性位点的催化速率常数 kcat 的上限
options.en: It raises the upper limit on the catalytic constant kcat at one active site

options.zh: 为协同效应与别构调控提供不可缺少的结构基础
options.en: It provides the structural basis required for cooperativity and allostery

quiz.explain_zh: kcat 由单个活性位点的化学步骤决定，寡聚化本身不会提高单位点的内在催化速率；四聚化增加的是每分子的位点数（表观总活性）和可调控性。“为协同与别构提供结构基础”那一项很诱人被误选为“不是优势”，因为协同看上去只是血红蛋白的特例，但它恰恰是老师强调的最重要的一条：只有四级结构才能产生协同与别构，这是代谢调控的结构前提。
quiz.explain_en: kcat is set by the chemistry at a single active site, and oligomerisation does not by itself raise the intrinsic per-site rate; tetramerisation increases the number of sites per molecule (apparent total activity) and the scope for regulation. The cooperativity/allostery option is tempting to pick as the non-advantage because cooperativity looks like a hemoglobin special case, but it is precisely the point the lecture stresses most: only quaternary structure gives cooperativity and allostery, the structural prerequisite for metabolic regulation.

title_zh: 同源蛋白与序列同源性：流感 ABCD、镰刀型贫血、Hb 与 Mb 的“结构像、序列不像”
title_en: Homologous proteins and sequence homology: influenza A-D, sickle cell anemia, and Hb versus Mb — similar structure, dissimilar sequence

points.zh: 同源蛋白 homologous protein：在不同物种 species（界门纲目科属种的最低一级）中存在的相似蛋白，行使相似的功能。
points.en: Homologous proteins are similar proteins found in different species (the lowest rank of the taxonomic hierarchy) that carry out similar functions.

points.zh: 它们之间的序列可以很像也可以不太像，这个相似程度叫序列同源性 sequence homology；相似度高就叫高同源性。
points.en: Their sequences may be very alike or not; the degree of resemblance is called sequence homology, and high resemblance is described as high homology.

points.zh: 例子：Sarbecovirus 属下各病毒的 RBD 彼此高度相似但有细微差别，属于典型的同源蛋白；许多病毒的聚合酶 polymerase 也有明显同源性。
points.en: Example: the RBDs of the various viruses within the sarbecovirus subgenus are highly similar with fine differences — textbook homologous proteins; the polymerases of many viruses are likewise clearly homologous.

points.zh: 反例：流感病毒 influenza 是 RNA 病毒，遗传稳定性低，一代代传下去同源性逐渐下降，因而分为 Influenza A、B、C、D 四型。
points.en: Counterexample: influenza is an RNA virus with low genetic stability, so homology erodes over successive passages, giving the four types Influenza A, B, C, and D.

points.zh: 这四型中有些蛋白功能高度相似、长相也一样，但序列同源性其实很低，可能只有百分之三四十——说明结构/功能相似不等于序列相似。
points.en: Among these four types some proteins have highly similar functions and shapes yet sequence identity as low as thirty to forty percent, showing that similar structure and function need not mean similar sequence.

points.zh: 镰刀型贫血病 sickle cell anemia 的例子：基因突变使红细胞中的血红蛋白某个带电荷的氨基酸变成不带电荷的氨基酸，失去了一个重要的相互作用。
points.en: The sickle cell anemia example: a gene mutation converts a charged amino acid in red-cell hemoglobin into an uncharged one, losing an important interaction.

points.zh: 后果是患者的红细胞携氧能力大大下降——一个氨基酸的改变足以摧毁蛋白功能，是一级结构决定功能的经典证据。
points.en: The consequence is a large drop in the oxygen-carrying capacity of the patient's red cells — a single residue change destroying protein function, the classic evidence that primary structure determines function.

points.zh: 血红蛋白与肌红蛋白就是一对同源蛋白：三级结构 tertiary structure 高度相似，但相同的氨基酸很少，一级结构同源性很低。
points.en: Hemoglobin and myoglobin are such a pair: their tertiary structures are highly similar while very few residues are identical, so primary-structure homology is low.

points.zh: 老师的解释：可以认为它们是从不同的起点独立进化出来，却不约而同收敛到同一种最高效的构象，功能相似而组成氨基酸不同。
points.en: The teacher's reading: they can be seen as having evolved independently from different starting points and converged on the same maximally efficient conformation, similar in function but different in composition.

extra.tag: 课上说法需修正 · Hb 与 Mb 并非独立进化
extra.zh: 老师说 Hb 和 Mb 是“独立进化出来的”，这与现代分子进化的共识相反。二者同属珠蛋白家族 globin superfamily，是由同一个古老祖先基因经基因复制 gene duplication 后分化而来的**旁系同源 paralogs**，属真正的分歧进化 divergent evolution。序列一致性虽只有约 15–25%，但结构（经典的 globin fold，八段螺旋 A–H）和关键功能残基（近端组氨酸 His F8、远端组氨酸 His E7）严格保守——保守的功能位点正是共同起源而非趋同的证据。真正的趋同进化 convergent evolution 例子是丝氨酸蛋白酶中的 chymotrypsin 与 subtilisin：催化三联体相同但整体折叠完全不同。
extra.en: The lecture calls hemoglobin and myoglobin independently evolved, which is the opposite of the modern consensus. Both belong to the globin superfamily and are paralogs arising by gene duplication from a common ancestral gene — genuine divergent evolution. Sequence identity is only about 15–25%, yet the fold (the classic globin fold of eight helices A–H) and the key functional residues (proximal His F8, distal His E7) are strictly conserved, and conserved functional positions are evidence of common ancestry rather than convergence. The real convergent-evolution example is chymotrypsin versus subtilisin: identical catalytic triad, completely different overall folds.

extra.tag: 定义要精确 · homology 是二元的
extra.zh: 考试常考的严谨点：homology 同源性指“来自共同祖先”，是**有或没有的二元性质**，不能说“40% 同源”；能定量的是 sequence identity 序列一致性或 similarity 相似性。所以老师说的“百分之三四十的同源性”严格应为“百分之三四十的序列一致性”。此外 orthologs 直系同源（物种分化产生，通常功能相同）与 paralogs 旁系同源（基因复制产生，常功能分化）要能分开：Hb 与 Mb 是 paralogs，人和小鼠的 Mb 是 orthologs。
extra.en: A precision point examiners like: homology means descent from a common ancestor and is a binary property — one cannot be '40% homologous'. What is quantifiable is sequence identity or similarity. So the lecture's 'thirty to forty percent homology' should strictly be 'thirty to forty percent sequence identity'. Also distinguish orthologs (produced by speciation, usually same function) from paralogs (produced by gene duplication, often functionally diverged): Hb and Mb are paralogs, whereas human and mouse myoglobin are orthologs.

extra.tag: 课上说法需修正 · 镰刀型贫血的机制
extra.zh: 具体分子细节课上没给出：突变在**β-珠蛋白 β-globin 第 6 位**，谷氨酸 Glu（带负电）→ 缬氨酸 Val（疏水），突变型称 HbS。关键在于机制不是“单个血红蛋白分子携氧能力下降”：新暴露的疏水贴片在**脱氧状态**下插入相邻 HbS 分子的疏水口袋，使分子聚合成长纤维，把红细胞拉成镰刀形；镰变细胞僵硬、易溶血、堵塞微血管，贫血和疼痛危象由此而来。所以老师那句“携氧能力大大下降”只对表型成立，对分子机制不准确——记住关键词是 polymerization of deoxy-HbS。
extra.en: The molecular detail the lecture omits: the mutation is at position 6 of β-globin, glutamate (negatively charged) to valine (hydrophobic), giving HbS. Crucially the mechanism is not a fall in the oxygen capacity of an individual hemoglobin molecule: the newly exposed hydrophobic patch inserts, in the deoxygenated state, into a hydrophobic pocket on a neighbouring HbS molecule, polymerising them into long fibres that distort the erythrocyte into a sickle; the rigid cells haemolyse and occlude microvessels, producing the anaemia and pain crises. So the lecture's 'oxygen-carrying capacity drops greatly' describes the phenotype but not the molecular mechanism — the keyword is polymerisation of deoxy-HbS.

extra.tag: 顺带一提 · 杂合子优势
extra.zh: 镰刀型贫血是隐性遗传，杂合子 HbAS 携带者症状轻微，却对恶性疟原虫 Plasmodium falciparum 感染有明显抵抗力，这就是该等位基因在疟疾流行区维持高频率的原因——平衡选择 balancing selection 的教科书案例，常作为遗传学与生化交叉的考点。
extra.en: Sickle cell disease is recessive, and heterozygous HbAS carriers have mild symptoms but marked resistance to Plasmodium falciparum malaria, which is why the allele persists at high frequency in malaria-endemic regions — the textbook case of balancing selection and a favourite crossover question between genetics and biochemistry.

quiz.q_zh: 血红蛋白与肌红蛋白序列一致性只有约 15–25%，但三级结构几乎重合。最准确的进化学解释是：
quiz.q_en: Hemoglobin and myoglobin share only about 15–25% sequence identity yet have nearly superimposable tertiary structures. The most accurate evolutionary interpretation is:

options.zh: 序列一致性如此之低，说明二者不可能拥有共同祖先
options.en: Sequence identity that low shows they cannot descend from a common ancestor

options.zh: 二者是同一个基因在不同组织中的可变剪接产物
options.en: They are alternative splice products of a single gene in different tissues

options.zh: 二者由同一个祖先基因经基因复制而分化，属于分歧进化
options.en: They diverged from a single ancestral gene by duplication — divergent evolution

options.zh: 二者从彼此无关的起点独立演化出相同折叠，属于趋同进化
options.en: They evolved the same fold independently from unrelated origins — convergent evolution

quiz.explain_zh: 结构比序列保守得多是分子进化的普遍规律：只要折叠和功能位点（His F8、His E7、疏水血红素口袋）被选择保留，表面残基可以大量替换。“趋同进化”那一项是课上给出的说法，也是最诱人的错误：趋同进化要求折叠本身独立起源（如 chymotrypsin 与 subtilisin），而 Hb/Mb 共享同一 globin fold 和同一套功能残基，正是共同起源的标志。
quiz.explain_en: Structure being far more conserved than sequence is a general rule of molecular evolution: as long as the fold and the functional positions (His F8, His E7, the hydrophobic heme pocket) are retained by selection, surface residues can be replaced wholesale. The convergence option is what the lecture said and the most tempting error: convergence requires the fold itself to have arisen independently, as with chymotrypsin and subtilisin, whereas Hb and Mb share one globin fold and one set of functional residues — the signature of common descent.

quiz.q_zh: 镰刀型贫血中 β 链 Glu6→Val 突变导致病理的直接分子机制是：
quiz.q_en: The direct molecular mechanism by which the β-chain Glu6-to-Val mutation causes sickle cell pathology is:

options.zh: 新暴露的疏水侧链使脱氧态 HbS 相互聚合成纤维
options.en: The exposed hydrophobic side chain makes deoxy HbS polymerise into fibres

options.zh: 突变阻止 β 链与 α 链组装，血红蛋白只能以单体存在
options.en: The mutation blocks assembly of β with α chains, leaving hemoglobin monomeric

options.zh: 突变引入了提前终止密码子，使 β 链被截短而失活
options.en: The mutation introduces a premature stop codon that truncates the β chain

options.zh: 突变破坏了血红素的 Fe²⁺ 配位，使氧不能结合到铁上
options.en: The mutation disrupts Fe(II) coordination in the heme so oxygen cannot bind

quiz.explain_zh: Glu6 位于分子表面，突变成 Val 后造成一个疏水贴片；在脱氧构象下这个贴片能插入邻近分子的疏水口袋，引发聚合、纤维化和镰变，进而溶血与血管阻塞。“破坏 Fe²⁺ 配位”那一项很像老师“携氧能力下降”的表述，但第 6 位远离血红素口袋，并不直接干扰 Fe²⁺ 配位；携氧能力下降是细胞层面的后果（红细胞被破坏），不是单分子层面的原因。“提前终止密码子”那一项描述的是 β-地中海贫血 β-thalassemia 那一类的突变类型，机制不同。
quiz.explain_en: Glu6 sits on the molecular surface, and replacing it with valine creates a hydrophobic patch that, in the deoxy conformation, inserts into a pocket on a neighbouring molecule, driving polymerisation, fibre formation and sickling, hence haemolysis and vaso-occlusion. The Fe(II)-coordination option resembles the lecture's 'oxygen capacity drops' phrasing, but position 6 is far from the heme pocket and does not perturb Fe(II) coordination; reduced oxygen carriage is a cell-level consequence of red-cell destruction, not the single-molecule cause. The premature-stop option describes the class of mutation seen in β-thalassemia, a different mechanism.

title_zh: 血红素、卟啉环与 Fe²⁺ 配位：组氨酸、氧气和一氧化碳中毒
title_en: Heme, the porphyrin ring and Fe(II) coordination: histidine, oxygen, and carbon monoxide poisoning

points.zh: 血红蛋白和肌红蛋白结合氧气靠的不是多肽本身，而是辅基血红素 heme，其环状部分化学名叫卟啉 porphyrin，即卟啉环。
points.en: Hemoglobin and myoglobin bind oxygen not through the polypeptide itself but through the prosthetic group heme, whose ring is chemically a porphyrin.

points.zh: 卟啉环中心有一个二价铁离子 Fe²⁺，即亚铁 ferrous；这一点非常重要。三价铁 Fe³⁺ 是氧化态更高的形式。
points.en: At the centre of the porphyrin sits a divalent iron ion, Fe(II), the ferrous form — a crucial point; Fe(III) is the more highly oxidised form.

points.zh: 因为是亚铁、还没到最高氧化态，它仍有多余的电子，可以再形成额外的配位键 coordination bond——配位键是金属形成的一种特殊化学键，强度相当可观（本课不要求推导成键细节）。
points.en: Because it is ferrous and not yet fully oxidised, the iron still has electrons available to form additional coordination bonds — a coordination bond being a special kind of bond formed by a metal, and quite a strong one (the course does not require the bonding details).

points.zh: 卟啉环平面的上方有一个组氨酸 histidine，其侧链咪唑环上的氮原子 N 与铁形成一个配位键——血红蛋白和肌红蛋白都是如此。
points.en: Above the plane of the porphyrin sits a histidine whose imidazole side-chain nitrogen forms a coordination bond to the iron — the same in both hemoglobin and myoglobin.

points.zh: 平面另一侧（下方）是铁与氧气 O2 或一氧化碳 CO 形成额外配位键的位置，这就是氧结合位点。
points.en: On the other side of the plane, the iron forms an additional coordination bond to O2 or to carbon monoxide — this is the oxygen binding site.

points.zh: 在水溶液中（游离血红素），CO 结合卟啉环的能力远远强于 O2，这是一氧化碳中毒的化学基础。
points.en: In aqueous solution with free heme, CO binds the porphyrin far more strongly than O2 does, which is the chemical basis of carbon monoxide poisoning.

points.zh: 原因在电子几何：CO 近似为碳氧三键的线性分子，碳只成了三条键，因而在分子一端留有一对孤对电子，这对电子正好指向铁离子，朝向最有利于形成配位键，所以 Fe²⁺ 与 CO 的配位能力非常强。
points.en: The reason is electronic geometry: CO is a linear molecule with an approximate carbon-oxygen triple bond, and since carbon has made only three bonds it retains a lone pair at one end that points straight at the iron — an orientation ideal for coordination, so Fe(II) binds CO very strongly.

points.zh: 氧气则不同：O2 的电子分布在一个平面上，成键几何与 CO 不一样，因此结合方式和强度都不同（下一段继续）。
points.en: Oxygen is different: its electrons are distributed in a plane and its binding geometry differs from CO, so the mode and strength of binding differ (continued in the next section).

extra.tag: 课上说法需修正 · CO 的杂化
extra.zh: 老师说 CO 的碳是 **sp3 杂化**——不对。CO 是线性双原子分子，碳为 **sp 杂化**：两个 sp 杂化轨道，一个参与 σ 键、另一个容纳那对指向外侧的孤对电子，剩下两个 p 轨道形成两条 π 键。正是这个 sp 孤对沿分子轴指向金属，才使 CO 成为强 σ 给体；同时 CO 的空 π* 轨道接受金属 d 电子回馈（π 反馈键 π-backbonding），这才是 CO 与 Fe²⁺ 结合特别强的完整原因。老师的“电子正好在线性分子一端”这个直觉是对的，只是杂化标签说错了。
extra.en: The lecture calls CO's carbon sp3-hybridised, which is wrong. CO is a linear diatomic and its carbon is sp-hybridised: two sp orbitals, one forming the sigma bond and the other holding the outward-pointing lone pair, with the remaining two p orbitals making two pi bonds. It is this axial sp lone pair that makes CO a strong sigma donor, while CO's empty pi* orbitals accept back-donation of metal d electrons (pi-backbonding) — together the full reason CO binds Fe(II) so tightly. The intuition that the electrons sit at one end of a linear molecule is right; only the hybridisation label is wrong.

extra.tag: 考试必背数字 · the key numbers
extra.zh: 游离血红素对 CO 的亲和力约为对 O2 的 20000 倍；而在血红蛋白里只有约 200–250 倍。差别来自蛋白质环境：远端组氨酸 distal His (E7) 在结合位点上方形成空间位阻并与结合的 O2 形成氢键，既压低了 CO 的线性最优取向（迫使 Fe–C–O 弯曲），又稳定了弯曲结合的 O2。这就是蛋白质「调教」辅基化学性质的经典例子——若没有远端 His，人体内源性代谢产生的少量 CO 就足以让血红蛋白永久失能。
extra.en: Free heme binds CO roughly 20000-fold more tightly than O2, whereas within hemoglobin the ratio falls to about 200–250. The difference comes from the protein environment: the distal histidine (E7) sits over the binding site, sterically penalising CO's preferred linear geometry by forcing the Fe–C–O unit to bend, while hydrogen-bonding to and stabilising the bent bound O2. This is the classic case of a protein tuning the chemistry of its prosthetic group — without the distal His, the small amount of CO produced by normal human metabolism would be enough to disable hemoglobin permanently.

extra.tag: 配位数要记 · six coordinate
extra.zh: Fe²⁺ 在血红素中是**六配位、八面体 octahedral**：四个配位来自卟啉环四个吡咯氮 pyrrole N（在平面内），第五个来自平面上方的**近端组氨酸 proximal His (F8)**，第六个是平面下方的 O2/CO 结合位。老师只提了「上方一个 His」，要补的是它有专名 His F8，以及上方还有一个不配位的 His E7（远端）。此外，铁必须保持 Fe²⁺ 才能结合 O2；氧化成 Fe³⁺ 就成为高铁血红蛋白 methemoglobin，完全丧失载氧能力，体内靠 methemoglobin reductase（细胞色素 b5 还原酶）把它还原回来。
extra.en: The Fe(II) in heme is six-coordinate and octahedral: four bonds to the pyrrole nitrogens of the porphyrin in the plane, a fifth to the proximal histidine (His F8) above the plane, and the sixth below the plane as the O2/CO site. The lecture mentions only 'a histidine above', so add that it has a name, His F8, and that a second, non-coordinating histidine, the distal His E7, also sits on the binding face. Note too that the iron must stay ferrous to bind O2: oxidation to Fe(III) gives methemoglobin, which cannot carry oxygen at all and is reduced back in vivo by methemoglobin reductase (cytochrome b5 reductase).

extra.tag: 临床连结 · why CO kills
extra.zh: CO 中毒之所以致命有两重原因，课上只讲了第一重：(1) COHb 占据结合位点，直接减少载氧量；(2) 更隐蔽的是，已结合 CO 的亚基会把其余亚基锁在高亲和力的 R 态，使血红蛋白的氧解离曲线**左移**，剩余的氧也不肯在组织中释放。所以 CO 中毒患者的 PaO2（溶解氧分压）可以完全正常，脉搏血氧仪 pulse oximeter 也可能读出假性正常的 SpO2——必须测 COHb。治疗是高浓度氧或高压氧，靠质量作用把 CO 竞争下来。
extra.en: CO poisoning kills for two reasons, of which the lecture gives only the first: COHb occupies binding sites and directly reduces oxygen carriage; and, more insidiously, a subunit with CO bound locks the remaining subunits in the high-affinity R state, shifting the oxygen dissociation curve to the left so that even the oxygen still carried is not released to the tissues. Hence a poisoned patient can have an entirely normal arterial PaO2, and a pulse oximeter may read a falsely reassuring SpO2 — COHb must be measured directly. Treatment is high-concentration or hyperbaric oxygen, competing the CO off by mass action.

quiz.q_zh: 关于血红素中 Fe²⁺ 的配位环境，下列描述正确的是：
quiz.q_en: Which description of the coordination environment of Fe(II) in heme is correct?

options.zh: 四个配位来自吡咯氮，第五个来自组氨酸，第六个留给 O2
options.en: Four bonds to pyrrole nitrogens, a fifth to histidine, a sixth left for O2

options.zh: 六个配位全部来自卟啉环的环氮，O2 结合在环边缘而不在铁上
options.en: All six bonds come from porphyrin nitrogens; O2 binds the ring edge, not iron

options.zh: 铁必须先被氧化成 Fe³⁺，才能在第六配位点结合氧气
options.en: The iron must be oxidised to Fe(III) before it can bind O2 at the sixth site

options.zh: 铁通过与半胱氨酸的硫配位，被牢固固定在蛋白骨架上
options.en: The iron is held on the protein by coordination to a cysteine sulfur atom

quiz.explain_zh: 血红素铁是六配位八面体：平面内四个吡咯氮，轴向上方 His F8，下方留给氧或 CO。“必须先氧化为 Fe³⁺”那一项是极常见的错误——恰恰相反，只有 Fe²⁺ 才能可逆结合 O2，氧化成 Fe³⁺ 后形成高铁血红蛋白，完全失去载氧能力。“半胱氨酸硫配位”那一项描述的是细胞色素 P450（近端配体是半胱氨酸硫醇盐），与血红蛋白的组氨酸配位不同，这是两类血红素蛋白的经典对比。
quiz.explain_en: Heme iron is six-coordinate and octahedral: four pyrrole nitrogens in the plane, His F8 axially above, and the site below reserved for O2 or CO. The Fe(III) option is a very common error — the opposite is true, since only Fe(II) binds O2 reversibly and oxidation to Fe(III) gives methemoglobin, which cannot carry oxygen. The cysteine option describes cytochrome P450, whose proximal ligand is a cysteine thiolate rather than hemoglobin's histidine, the classic contrast between these two families of heme proteins.

quiz.q_zh: 游离血红素对 CO 的亲和力约为对 O2 的 20000 倍，而血红蛋白中这一比值降到约 200。造成这一下降的主要原因是：
quiz.q_en: Free heme binds CO about 20000-fold more tightly than O2, but in hemoglobin the ratio falls to roughly 200. The main reason for this drop is:

options.zh: 远端组氨酸位阻迫使 Fe–C–O 弯曲，同时氢键稳定 O2
options.en: Distal histidine sterics bend Fe–C–O while hydrogen-bonding the bound O2

options.zh: 血红蛋白中部分铁被氧化为 Fe³⁺，选择性降低 CO 亲和力
options.en: Part of the iron is oxidised to Fe(III), selectively lowering CO affinity

options.zh: 四聚体的协同效应使 CO 结合表现为负协同，亲和力下降
options.en: Cooperativity within the tetramer makes CO binding negatively cooperative

options.zh: 近端组氨酸把铁拉出卟啉平面，从而削弱 CO 的电子给予能力
options.en: The proximal histidine pulls iron out of plane, weakening CO's electron donation

quiz.explain_zh: 蛋白口袋对两种配体不是中性的：远端 His E7 悬在第六配位位上方，CO 偏好沿轴线性结合，被位阻显著削弱；而 O2 本来就以弯曲方式结合，还能接受 His E7 的氢键而被额外稳定。一削一扬，把 20000 倍压到约 200 倍，人才不至于被自身代谢产生的 CO 毒死。“近端组氨酸把铁拉出平面”那一项混入了真实存在的结构现象（脱氧态铁确实偏离平面约 0.6 Å，是 T→R 变构的触发器），但那与协同性有关，不是 CO/O2 选择性的来源。
quiz.explain_en: The protein pocket is not neutral between the two ligands: the distal His E7 hangs over the sixth coordination site, and since CO prefers to bind linearly along the axis it is markedly penalised sterically, whereas O2 binds bent anyway and gains extra stabilisation from a hydrogen bond to His E7. Penalising one and favouring the other compresses 20000-fold to about 200-fold, which is why endogenously produced CO does not poison us. The proximal-histidine option invokes a real structural phenomenon — the iron does sit about 0.6 Å out of plane in the deoxy state, the trigger for the T-to-R transition — but that concerns cooperativity, not CO/O2 selectivity.

title_zh: CO、氰化物中毒与远端组氨酸的位阻保护
title_en: CO and cyanide poisoning; steric protection by the distal histidine

points.zh: O2 是 sp2 杂化、接近平面的结构，电子密度分布在分子两侧，必须先发生一定程度的偏移（弯折）才能把电子对朝向 Fe2+，因此形成配位键 coordination bond 的能力较弱。
points.en: O2 is sp2-hybridised and nearly planar, with its electron density spread to both sides; it must tilt so that a lone pair points at Fe2+, so its coordination to heme iron is comparatively weak.

points.zh: CO 是线性分子，碳只形成三条键、保留一对孤对电子 lone pair，且该电子对正对着分子一端，可以直接指向铁离子，取向最有利于配位。
points.en: CO is linear; the carbon forms only three bonds and keeps a lone pair pointing straight out along the molecular axis, an ideal orientation for coordinating the iron.

points.zh: 结果是游离血红素 free heme 中 Fe2+ 结合 CO 的能力约为结合 O2 的 25000 倍。
points.en: As a result, free heme iron binds CO roughly 25 000-fold more tightly than O2.

points.zh: 但在真正的血红蛋白 hemoglobin 里，这个比值只剩约 250 倍。
points.en: In intact hemoglobin, however, that ratio falls to only about 250-fold.

points.zh: 原因是氧结合位点的上方还有一个 histidine 残基，它的位阻效应 steric hindrance 迫使配体只能以扭转的斜角结合，正好惩罚了 CO 偏好的笔直取向。
points.en: The reason is a histidine residue sitting above the O2 site; its steric hindrance forces ligands to bind at a bent angle, penalising exactly the straight-on geometry CO prefers.

points.zh: 没有氧结合时该 histidine 更靠近铁；氧进来时它稍稍挪开，让 O2 以弯曲几何 bent geometry 把电子对朝向铁形成配位键。
points.en: With no O2 bound the histidine lies closer to the iron; when O2 arrives it shifts slightly, letting O2 bind in a bent geometry that directs its electron pair at the iron.

points.zh: CO 中毒 CO poisoning：CO 占住血红素后血液不能再运输氧气，人因窒息而死；老师强调这是蛋白已经尽力优化但仍无法完全避免的。
points.en: CO poisoning: once CO occupies the heme, blood can no longer carry O2 and the person asphyxiates; the protein has minimised but not abolished the problem.

points.zh: 氰基 cyanide 同理是极强的配体，与铁形成配位键的能力远超氧气，因此氰化钠一类化合物剧毒、几乎无法抢救。
points.en: Cyanide works on the same principle: it is a far stronger iron ligand than O2, which is why sodium cyanide and related compounds are extremely toxic.

extra.tag: 课上口误 · lecture misstatement
extra.zh: 老师把敌敌畏 dichlorvos 说成含氰基的化合物。敌敌畏是有机磷杀虫剂 organophosphate，毒理机制是不可逆抑制乙酰胆碱酯酶 acetylcholinesterase，与血红素铁无关；含氰的是氰化钠/氰化钾。另外他说 CN 基团“带正电”也说反了：氰离子 CN− 带负电，是典型的强场配体 strong-field ligand。
extra.en: The lecture calls dichlorvos a cyanide-type compound. Dichlorvos is an organophosphate that irreversibly inhibits acetylcholinesterase and has nothing to do with heme iron; the cyanide poisons are NaCN/KCN. He also calls the cyano group positively charged — CN− is an anion and a classic strong-field ligand.

extra.tag: 氰化物的真正靶点 · real target
extra.zh: 氰化物的致死靶点主要不是血红蛋白，而是线粒体细胞色素 c 氧化酶 cytochrome c oxidase（复合物 IV）中的 Fe3+，阻断电子传递链 electron transport chain。Hb 的 Fe2+ 对 CN− 亲和力并不高；临床解毒正是利用这一点：用亚硝酸盐把部分 Hb 氧化成高铁血红蛋白 methemoglobin（Fe3+）把 CN− 从线粒体“抢”回血液，再用硫代硫酸盐或羟钴胺 hydroxocobalamin 清除。所以“没有解药”并不准确。
extra.en: Cyanide's lethal target is mostly not hemoglobin but the Fe3+ of mitochondrial cytochrome c oxidase (complex IV), blocking the electron transport chain. Ferrous Hb binds CN− poorly — which is the basis of the antidote: nitrite converts some Hb to methemoglobin (Fe3+) that pulls CN− out of mitochondria, then thiosulfate or hydroxocobalamin clears it. 'No antidote' is not correct.

extra.tag: 近端与远端His · proximal vs distal
extra.zh: 考试要分清两个组氨酸：近端组氨酸 proximal His F8 从卟啉环下方与铁形成第 5 配位，始终结合；远端组氨酸 distal His E7 在氧侧，不与铁配位，只提供位阻并与结合的 O2 形成氢键（这个氢键额外稳定 O2、进一步拉近 O2 与 CO 的差距）。去氧时铁的第 6 配位位置是空的，并非被 His 占据。
extra.en: Distinguish the two histidines: proximal His F8 is the permanent fifth ligand from below the porphyrin; distal His E7 sits on the O2 side, does NOT coordinate the iron, and only provides steric hindrance plus a hydrogen bond to bound O2 (which further stabilises O2 relative to CO). In deoxy heme the sixth coordination site is empty, not occupied by a histidine.

extra.tag: CO中毒的处理 · treatment
extra.zh: CO 与 Hb 的结合虽强但是可逆的：治疗是吸入 100% 纯氧、必要时高压氧 hyperbaric oxygen，通过质量作用把 CO 竞争下来。COHb 还会使剩余亚基的氧解离曲线左移，进一步妨碍卸氧，这是 CO 中毒比单纯“少了几个位点”更危险的原因。
extra.en: CO binding is strong but reversible: treatment is 100% oxygen and, if needed, hyperbaric oxygen, competing CO off by mass action. Carboxyhemoglobin also left-shifts the dissociation curve of the remaining subunits, impairing unloading — which is why CO poisoning is worse than simply losing a few sites.

quiz.q_zh: 在游离血红素中 CO 的结合能力约为 O2 的 25000 倍，而在血红蛋白中只有约 250 倍。最主要的原因是什么？
quiz.q_en: CO binds free heme about 25 000-fold better than O2, but only about 250-fold better in hemoglobin. What is the main reason?

options.zh: 蛋白环境削弱了卟啉环的共轭，整体配位能力随之下降
options.en: The protein weakens porphyrin conjugation, lowering coordinating power overall

options.zh: 珠蛋白把血红素铁氧化成 Fe3+，从而降低了对 CO 的亲和力
options.en: Globin oxidises the heme iron to Fe3+, which lowers its affinity for CO

options.zh: 远端组氨酸的位阻迫使配体弯曲，惩罚 CO 偏好的直线取向
options.en: Distal histidine sterics force bent binding, penalising CO's linear geometry

options.zh: 血液中的 CO 大量被血浆蛋白结合，游离浓度因此被稀释
options.en: Most CO in blood is bound by plasma proteins, diluting the free concentration

quiz.explain_zh: 正确答案是位阻：远端 His E7 使配体只能以斜角结合，CO 想要的笔直取向被挡住，因此亲和力被压低约 100 倍。“珠蛋白把铁氧化成 Fe3+”那一项很诱人，因为 Fe3+ 确实不结合 O2，但功能性血红蛋白的铁始终是 Fe2+，一旦被氧化成高铁血红蛋白 methemoglobin 它连氧都不能运，那就不是“降低 CO 优势”而是彻底失活了。
quiz.explain_en: The answer is sterics: distal His E7 allows only bent binding, blocking the linear geometry CO wants and cutting its advantage roughly 100-fold. The Fe3+ option is tempting because ferric heme really does not bind O2, but functional hemoglobin keeps its iron ferrous; oxidation to methemoglobin would abolish O2 transport entirely rather than selectively disfavour CO.

quiz.q_zh: 为什么 O2 与血红素铁形成配位键的能力天然弱于 CO？
quiz.q_en: Why is O2 intrinsically a weaker ligand for heme iron than CO?

options.zh: O2 呈近平面构型，电子分布在两侧，须偏转才能指向铁
options.en: O2 is near-planar with density on both sides, so it must tilt to aim at iron

options.zh: O2 整体带负电荷，与同样带负电荷的卟啉环相互排斥
options.en: O2 carries a net negative charge and is repelled by the anionic porphyrin

options.zh: O2 分子的体积太大，无法进入血红素铁上方的远端口袋
options.en: The O2 molecule is too bulky to fit the distal pocket above the heme iron

options.zh: O2 不含孤对电子，只能靠范德华力与铁发生相互作用
options.en: O2 has no lone pairs and can interact with iron only by van der Waals forces

quiz.explain_zh: 关键是几何：O2 的电子对不是沿分子轴笔直伸出，而是分布在近平面结构的两侧，必须发生偏转才能有效指向 Fe2+，配位效率因此不如线性的 CO。“不含孤对电子”那一项错在 O2 确实有孤对电子且形成真正的配位键，不是范德华作用；O2 的体积也远小于血红素口袋，不存在进不去的问题。
quiz.explain_en: The point is geometry: O2's electron pairs do not project straight along the molecular axis but sit to either side of a near-planar structure, so it must tilt to aim one at Fe2+ — less efficient than linear CO. The 'no lone pairs' option is wrong because O2 does form a genuine coordination bond, and O2 is far smaller than the heme pocket, so access is not the issue.

title_zh: 变构效应的定义与肌红蛋白氧合方程的推导
title_en: Defining allostery; deriving the myoglobin oxygen-binding equation

points.zh: 变构（别构）效应 allosteric effect 的定义：在寡聚体 oligomer 中，一个亚基（可以理解为某一个三级结构/功能结构域）发生构象改变后，会继而引起相邻亚基的构象也改变。
points.en: Allosteric effect: in an oligomer, a conformational change in one subunit (one tertiary/functional domain) propagates and changes the conformation of neighbouring subunits.

points.zh: 血红蛋白 hemoglobin 是四聚体 tetramer，是变构效应最典型的例子；肌红蛋白 myoglobin (Mb) 是单体，用来作对照。
points.en: Hemoglobin, a tetramer, is the classic allosteric example; myoglobin (Mb) is a monomer used as the comparison.

points.zh: 肌红蛋白结合氧写成可逆反应 Mb + O2 ⇌ MbO2，用平衡常数 K 判断反应进行到什么程度。
points.en: Myoglobin binding is written as the reversible reaction Mb + O2 ⇌ MbO2, and how far it proceeds is described by an equilibrium constant K.

points.zh: 老师写的形式是“未反应的比已反应的”，即 K = [Mb]·pO2 / [MbO2]。
points.en: The lecture writes K as unreacted over reacted, i.e. K = [Mb]·pO2 / [MbO2].

points.zh: 记号约定：生化里中括号 [ ] 表示浓度 concentration；氧气是气体，用分压 partial pressure pO2 表示，分压越高表示组织内氧越多。
points.en: Notation: in biochemistry square brackets mean concentration; oxygen, being a gas, is expressed as partial pressure pO2 — higher pO2 means more oxygen available.

points.zh: 氧饱和度 Y (fractional saturation) 定义为带氧的肌红蛋白占总肌红蛋白的比例：Y = [MbO2] / ([Mb] + [MbO2])。
points.en: Fractional saturation Y is the proportion of myoglobin carrying oxygen: Y = [MbO2] / ([Mb] + [MbO2]).

points.zh: 直接测定血液中的蛋白浓度非常困难，而测氧分压（临床上用光学方法）相对简单，所以要把 Y 式中的蛋白浓度项全部用 pO2 替换。
points.en: Measuring protein concentrations in blood is very hard, while measuring oxygen partial pressure optically is easy — so the concentration terms in Y are substituted out using the K expression.

points.zh: 联立两式并整理，得到 Y = pO2 / (K + pO2)，这是一条只含一个可测变量 pO2 的曲线。
points.en: Combining the two expressions gives Y = pO2 / (K + pO2), a curve in the single measurable variable pO2.

points.zh: 老师指出人的氧饱和度通常在 98% 以上，即绝大部分载氧蛋白都处于带氧状态，这是临床上最重要的指标之一。
points.en: The lecture notes that human oxygen saturation is normally above 98%, i.e. nearly all the carrier protein is oxygenated — one of the most important clinical readouts.

extra.tag: K其实是解离常数 · K is Kd
extra.zh: 能给出 Y = pO2/(K + pO2) 这个形式的 K，是解离常数 dissociation constant Kd（反应物在上、产物在下）。而通常约定的平衡常数 Keq 是产物比反应物，两者互为倒数：Keq = 1/Kd。老师口头说“原料比产物就是平衡常数”，方向与通用约定相反，答题时要写清楚用的是哪一个。
